article.articleHeadline: Vệ sinh cá nhân: Thói quen đơn giản giúp phòng nhiều bệnh truyền nhiễm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Personal hygiene: Simple habits help prevent many infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Personal hygiene is highlighted as a simple yet crucial measure to reduce the spread of infectious diseases in Vietnam. To interrupt transmission, the article notes three components: source, route, and susceptible hosts, with hands as the main conduit. Regular handwashing with soap under running water for at least 30 seconds removes most pathogens responsible for diarrhea and respiratory infections, and routine cleaning of frequently touched surfaces is advised. It emphasizes preserving natural barriers through oral/nasal hygiene (daily saline rinses) and skin care, plus bathing to prevent secondary infections. Community responsibility is stressed: covering coughs/sneezes, disposing of tissues, and washing hands afterward. Five daily habits include handwashing at key times, not sharing personal items, clean clothing, environmental cleaning, and respiratory hygiene. Dengue, spread by Aedes mosquitoes, requires bite avoidance and vector control, while vaccination against measles, chickenpox, and influenza complements hygiene. Article by Dr. Nguyen Minh Hien, Hanoi.

triage.headline_ja: 個人衛生：多くの感染症予防に役立つ簡単な習慣
triage.triage_reason: 特定の疾病アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、一般的な衛生啓発・予防に関する解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事象を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のアウトブレイクではなく、麻疹・水痘・インフルエンザ・デング熱などを含む一般的な感染症予防のための衛生教育記事。具体的な患者数・地域的発生情報は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: Ebola Death Figure Rises To 1,887
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) since May 15, 2026: as of Aug 6, 2026, 4,120 confirmed cases and 1,887 deaths (case fatality rate 45.8%). The rare Bundibugyo virus strain underscores concerns about spread to Kinshasa, though no cases have been detected among river-boat passengers quarantined near Kinshasa; over 200 passengers were quarantined at Maluku (65 km from Kinshasa) after a traveler died with Ebola-like symptoms. The National Institute of Biomedical Research reported all tested suspected cases were negative for Bundibugyo. Kinshasa authorities urged calm. WHO Director-General Tedros urged urgent strengthening of the response. The outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026. A joint $518 million continental preparedness and response plan by WHO and Africa CDC was launched on June 5, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ死者数1,887人に増加

triage.notes: 既にPHEIC宣言済み・WHO/Africa CDCによる5.18億ドルの対応計画が進行中の大規模継続イベント。キンシャサ近郊での検疫は陰性確認済みだが引き続き監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: How drug-resistant TB evades detection in standard tests
article.articleSummary: Rifampicin-resistant TB is not reliably detected by standard tests that screen only the 81-base-pair RRDR of rpoB. Non-RRDR mutations outside RRDR cause resistance, enabling ineffective treatment and ongoing transmission. A review by IIT-Guwahati and IIT-Madras cites non-RRDR mutations in North-East India, Eswatini, Myanmar, Peru, and South Africa; in Eswatini, about 30% of drug-resistant TB cases carried such mutations missed by routine tests. Resistance can arise from changes to rifampicin binding or from co-occurring mutations that boost bacterial fitness. Moving beyond RRDR, whole-genome sequencing (WGS) and targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS) detect broader resistance; Deeplex Myc-TB has identified V170F and I491F mutations in sputum and stool. In rural labs, MAS-PCR and HRMA offer faster, cheaper alternatives, while nanopore sequencing promises portable, real-time detection. For high-burden countries like India, adopting non-RRDR diagnostics is essential to halt silent spread.

triage.headline_ja: 薬剤耐性結核はどのように標準検査から逃れるのか

triage.notes: 記事は結核の薬剤耐性検出における技術的課題（非RRDR変異）をレビューする学術的内容であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。南アフリカ、ペルー、エスワティニは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി; മഠത്തുംഭാഗത്ത് ഭീതിയൊഴിഞ്ഞില്ല | ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി; മഠത്തുംഭാഗത്ത് ഭീതിയൊഴിഞ്ഞില്ല
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever; fear has not subsided in the stomach and chest region.
article.articleSummary: As of 10 August 2026, dengue fever fears persist in Mathathumbhagam, Eranjoli panchayat, Talassery. A housewife was the first patient; after recovery, her husband fell ill, and six people in Mathathumbhagam have been reported with dengue. Although some patients recovered, community anxiety remains. Vector-control efforts, including Kudumbashree volunteers and health workers, have begun to eliminate dengue sources, but awareness is still limited. Earlier dengue cases had been reported in nearby areas such as Vadakkumbad and Vaathilpeedik. Confirmed dengue cases occurred in June and July. Mosquitoes breed where stagnant water accumulates, including in vessels and containers near homes. Despite monsoon-cleanup efforts to clear roads and drains, water-filled vessels persist. Health workers are conducting home visits; ward sanitation committee meetings chaired by the medical officer have urged continued household cleanliness and community education.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱；マタトゥンバガム地区で不安収まらず
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域（Kerala州の一村落）における小規模なデング熱発生であり、既存の風土病パターン内の事象で、社会的関心も限定的。特段の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは見られない。
triage.notes: デング熱はKerala州で毎年流行する風土病であり、患者数も少数（村落内で数名程度）。地元メディアの地域ニュースであり、国レベル・国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には至らない。ベクター対策や住民啓発は既に地域行政により実施中。

article.articleHeadline: 吃涼麵踩雷！這款「豪華海陸總匯」驗出沙門氏桿菌　門市地址曝
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eating cold noodles hits a snag! Salmonella detected in this "Luxurious Surf and Turf"; store locations revealed.
article.articleSummary: Taipei City Health Bureau announced results from 40 cold noodle product tests at traditional shops and chain outlets, finding 39 compliant samples but 1 positive for Salmonella enterica: the product is Luxurious Surf and Turf Cold Noodles. The retailer is FuDa Retail Co., Ltd., Shilin Shidong II Branch, Taipei, and the manufacturer is HeMi International Foods Co., Ltd., located in Bade District, Taoyuan. The positive sample was collected on June 11 and the case has been referred to Taoyuan City Health Bureau for follow-up. Salmonella contamination violates safety rules requiring negative results. Health authorities warn that high summer temperatures accelerate microbial growth in ready-to-eat cold noodles, which are typically not heat-treated; products sold refrigerated should be kept below 7°C, and consumers should eat promptly or refrigerate leftovers to reduce spoilage and microbial proliferation. The incident illustrates cross-regional regulatory coordination between Taipei and Taoyuan.

triage.headline_ja: 冷やし麺で食中毒リスク！「豪華海陸總匯」からサルモネラ菌検出、販売店舗の住所が公表
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の一製品検査でサルモネラ菌が1件検出された食品安全事案であり、既に規制当局が対応中。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にParatyphoid/Typhoidが付与されているが、記事内容はサルモネラ菌（Salmonella enterica）による食品汚染の検査結果報告であり、チフス・パラチフスの流行事例ではない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: Palace urges vigilance vs leptospirosis, orders DOH to be proactive
article.articleSummary: Philippines, August 10, 2026: Widespread flooding in Metro Manila and other regions driven by the enhanced southwest monsoon (habagat) prompts vigilance against leptospirosis. Malacañang says President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. has directed the Department of Health to take proactive measures against illnesses tied to prolonged rainfall and flooding. Exposed individuals should wash with clean water and soap and seek medical consultation at health centers. Free consultation and doxycycline are available at health centers, though doxycycline is not recommended for pregnant women and children 12 and under without medical assessment. The DOH has established Dengue Fast Lanes in hospitals to facilitate treatment for dengue suspects. Authorities are preparing clean-water containers (jerry cans) and chlorine tablets to ensure safe drinking water. Boil water for two minutes after it reaches a rolling boil. Do not wait for fever, jaundice, or decreased urine output before seeking medical attention for possible leptospirosis.

triage.headline_ja: 大統領府がレプトスピラ症への警戒を要請、DOHに積極的対応を指示
triage.triage_reason: 洪水に伴うレプトスピラ症・デング熱リスクについて大統領府が保健省に対応を指示するなど政府の関心が高く、住民の継続的な病原体暴露が懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 季節性のモンスーンによる洪水に伴う予防的な政府対応であり、具体的な感染者数・死亡者数は記事に記載されていない。続報で症例数増加の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi Dengue case: दिल्ली में डेंगू के 1,389 और H1N1 के 1,344 मामले, जानें लक्षण-इलाज और बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Delhi dengue cases: 1,389 dengue cases in Delhi and 1,344 H1N1 cases; know the symptoms, treatment, and prevention.
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 1,389 dengue cases in hospitals: 1,179 residents of Delhi and 210 from outside the territory; no dengue deaths so far. H1N1 cases total 1,344 in Delhi with no fatalities. Dengue is a viral infection transmitted by mosquitoes; onset usually 4–10 days after bite, presenting fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle/joint pain, nausea, rash, and swollen glands. Most recover in 1–2 weeks, but warning signs requiring urgent care include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, rapid breathing, bleeding, excessive thirst, or pale/clammy skin. No specific dengue cure; management focuses on rest, fluids, and paracetamol; avoid aspirin and ibuprofen due to bleeding risk. Preventive measures: long clothing, mosquito repellents, window screens, nets, coils or vaporizers, and eliminating standing water. For H1N1 (influenza A): sudden fever, dry cough, headache, body aches, sore throat; antivirals may help if started within 48 hours; antibiotics are ineffective. High-risk groups: pregnant women, young children, elderly, chronic illness, and immunocompromised individuals.

triage.headline_ja: デリーのデング熱事例：デリーでデング熱1,389件、H1N1が1,344件確認—症状・治療・予防法について
triage.triage_reason: デリーにおける季節性のデング熱・H1N1感染症の定例的な症例報告であり、死亡例もなく、既知の疾患・既知の流行パターンの範囲内で特段の異常性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Technical Advisory Group recommends Ervebo vaccine to be evaluated in vaccine trial for Bundibugyo virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, the WHO Technical Advisory Group on Candidate Vaccine Prioritization (TAG-CVP) recommended Ervebo, the licensed Ebola vaccine, be prioritized for inclusion in a randomized clinical trial during the Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The guidance follows a 16 May Public Health Emergency of International Concern declaration for the Ebola outbreak and a 31 July review after animal studies suggested cross‑protection against BVD. Members judged no safety concerns for using Ervebo in outbreak contacts within a research framework, but efficacy against BVD disease and transmission remains unproven. A specific Bundibugyo vaccine would still be preferred if available. If efficacy data emerge, production and access would need rapid scaling. The article does not report case counts.

article.articleHeadline: 重庆感染科专家刘敏提醒：猴痘就在身边，怀疑感染了该去哪治？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chongqing Infectious Disease Expert Liu Min Reminds: Monkeypox Is Nearby; If You Suspect Infection, Where Should You Seek Treatment?
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox is no longer an 'African disease' in China. Mainland China’s first imported case was detected in Chongqing in September 2022, with a local outbreak in August 2024. From 2023–2026 monthly reports show ongoing cases: January 28, March 28, April 32, May 86; most locally acquired belong to lineage IIb; no deaths reported. Transmission is via close skin-to-skin contact and sexual contact, with men who have sex with men and HIV-positive individuals disproportionately affected (over 40%). Incubation is 5–21 days (commonly 6–13). Signs include fever ≥38.5°C, lymphadenopathy, and a vesiculopustular rash beginning on the face/oral region and possibly involving genitals/anal area, lasting 2–4 weeks. Diagnosis relies on PCR from lesion samples; rapid testing is available at Chongqing Public Health Medical Rescue Center. No domestically approved vaccine yet; vaccines exist in Hong Kong, Macau, and Thailand; a Chinese mRNA vaccine entered US/China trials in 2026. Prevention emphasizes avoiding close skin contact and high-risk sexual behavior; most patients recover with supportive care; seek Infectious Diseases Department care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 重慶感染症専科の劉敏医師が注意喚起：サル痘（Mpox）は身近に存在、感染が疑われたらどこで受診すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: 中国本土（重慶）でのMpox（Clade IIb）流行は既知の継続的事象であり、死亡例なく重症度は低いが、性的接触を介したヒト-ヒト感染とMSM・HIV感染者への偏在的影響が続いており、月次報告数も増加傾向（1月28件→5月86件）にあるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症専門医による啓発・医療案内記事であり、新規アウトブレイクの発表ではない。ただし月次報告数の増加傾向（1月28件→5月86件）が見られるため、続報の有無を注視する必要がある。タイ・香港・マカオ・米国はワクチン関連の言及のみで、発生国としては確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Flesh-Eating' Bacteria In US Beaches: Could Vibrio Infection Be A Risk In India Too? What To Know
article.articleSummary: Vibrio vulnificus, a bacterium thriving in warm seawater and brackish water, can infect people through cuts or wounds or by eating raw shellfish, potentially causing severe wound infections or bloodstream infections. In the United States, a rise in coastal-water connected infections prompts warnings; Louisiana has recorded nine infections this year, all hospitalized, with five deaths. Symptoms after coastal exposure include increasing redness, swelling, warmth, severe pain or discoloration around a wound, fever and chills; severe cases can blister the skin or cause rapid tissue damage. Most infections are uncommon, but risk remains for open wounds exposed to coastal waters and for consuming raw oysters. The article notes India could face exposure but does not report an outbreak; guidance emphasizes cleaning wounds, proper cooking of seafood, and not panicking about beaches.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の海岸で発生する『人食いバクテリア』：ビブリオ感染はインドでもリスクとなるか？知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 米国ルイジアナ州での既知の感染症（ビブリオ・バルニフィカス）に関する解説記事であり、インドでの実際の発生は報告されていない。対象国での実発生がなく、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事は米国での事例を基にインドでのリスクを解説する予防的・教育的内容であり、インドでの実際の発生報告はない。ビブリオ・バルニフィカスはヒト-ヒト感染せず、毎年一定数発生する既知の感染症であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo says number of confirmed Ebola cases rises to 4,120
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues, caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus. As of August 6, 2026, the Congolese Ministry of Communication reports 4,120 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,887 deaths, a case fatality rate of 45.8%. The eastern DRC outbreak, first declared May 15, remains active. In Kinshasa, more than 200 boat passengers were quarantined at Maluku, 65 km from the capital, after a traveler who died with Ebola-like symptoms had been aboard; testing by the National Institute of Biomedical Research found no Bundibugo among suspected cases linked to the incident. No Ebola cases have been detected among Kinshasa-area travelers. WHO Director-General Tedros urged urgent strengthening of the response amid accelerating spread. On May 17, WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC); a joint $518 million continental preparedness and response plan with Africa CDC was launched on June 5.

triage.triage_reason: PHEICが宣言された大規模なエボラ(ブンディブギョ)アウトブレイクが継続中で、致死率45.8%、感染拡大が続いており、国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi's H1N1 Cases Jump Nearly 6-Fold In A Year: What's Driving The Surge And Who's At Risk
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10, Delhi records 1,344 H1N1 influenza cases this season, up from 229 in the same period last year, a sixfold rise. Health professionals warn against dismissing H1N1 as routine flu; while most healthy people recover, infection can be severe or life-threatening in vulnerable groups—older adults, pregnant women, young children, diabetics, and people with chronic heart or lung disease, as well as those with weakened immune systems. H1N1 is viral, so antibiotics are ineffective; antivirals may be considered in severe cases or for high-risk individuals. Vaccination remains a key preventive measure; annual flu vaccines may not prevent infection entirely but reduce risk of severe illness and hospitalization. Additional precautions: regular handwashing, covering coughs/sneezes, avoiding close contact when sick, and staying home when unwell. Early recognition and timely care are crucial for high-risk patients.

triage.headline_ja: デリーのH1N1患者数が1年でほぼ6倍に増加：その要因とリスク層は誰か
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1（季節性インフルエンザ株）の症例数が前年比6倍に増加しているが、既知の病原体であり重症化は基礎疾患保有者など特定リスク群に限定されているため、直ちに国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。増加傾向の継続性や当局の対応状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既に流行株化しており、新規性・異常性は低い。ただし症例数の急増（6倍）は継続的なモニタリング対象。デリー地域内の局地的増加であり、他国への拡大や渡航制限の兆候は記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths near 2,000 as WHO concedes the outbreak is outrunning the response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, Bunia, Kinshasa) accelerates beyond the response. As of Aug 8, 2026, 4,141 confirmed cases and 1,889 deaths. Second-largest Ebola outbreak on record and the largest in DRC history, surpassing the 2018–2020 Kivu total (3,317) by late July; about 75 new cases and 35 deaths daily. Contact tracing has collapsed: roughly 10 contacts per case versus over 40 in Uganda’s, and 57 in Kivu; 90% of Bunia treatment-center admissions had no contact list; more than 70% of new cases and two-thirds of deaths arise from community transmission not under observation. North Kivu centers at 139% occupancy; Ituri at 57%. No licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; WHO reversed May guidance and approved Ervebo trial in DRC using ~500,000 doses held by Gavi. Frontline health-worker compensation negotiations ongoing with the government after August 5 statements; Uganda reported 20 imported cases, 15 from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者数が2,000人に迫る中、WHOはアウトブレイクが対応能力を超えていることを認める
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、感染・死亡が急増、接触者追跡が崩壊し地域感染が拡大、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Jakut berupaya menemukan kasus Tuberkulosis cegah penularan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The North Jakarta City Government seeks to identify tuberculosis cases to prevent transmission.
article.articleSummary: North Jakarta authorities are stepping up tuberculosis (TB) control via Active Case Finding (ACF) to prevent transmission. The effort targets residents with household or close contact to TB patients. About 100 residents underwent free TB screening on August 6 at Kantor RW 010 in Kalibaru, Cilincing District. This activity is a continuation of Kampung Siaga TB, involving health workers, government, cadres, and community members. Beyond screening, participants received education on TB symptoms, the importance of early detection, and treatment adherence if diagnosed. The program aims to expand screenings to all neighborhood units (RW) in Kalibaru, underscoring that prevention and control require active community participation to shorten detection time and reduce transmission to families and surrounding environments.

triage.headline_ja: 北ジャカルタ市政府、結核感染拡大防止のため患者発見に努める
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラム（積極的症例発見活動）の通常の実施報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは見られない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の地方流行病であり、本記事は地域の日常的な公衆衛生活動（症例発見・啓発）を報じるものでシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 北市抽驗40件涼麵！超商「豪華海陸總匯」檢出沙門氏桿菌　出包門市曝 | 祝你健康 | 三立新聞網 HEALTH.SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taipei City Randomly Samples 40 Cold Noodles; Convenience Store's "Luxurious Surf-and-Turf" Salmonella Detected; Troubled Store Exposed
article.articleSummary: Salmonella detected in one of 40 ready-to-eat cold noodle products in Taipei City, Taiwan. On 2026-08-10, the Taipei City Department of Public Health randomly sampled cold noodle offerings from traditional outlets and convenience stores; 39 products met microbiological standards, while one—'Luxurious Surf-and-Turf Cold Noodles' sold by Fu Da Retail Co., Ltd., Shilin Shihdong 2nd Branch—tested positive for Salmonella. The contaminated item was traced to Hemi International Foods Co., Ltd., located in Bade District, Taoyuan City; the case has been referred to Taoyuan City Government Health Bureau for follow-up. Under Taiwan's Food Sanitation Act, authorities may require corrective action; penalties range from NT$30,000 to NT$3,000,000 if not addressed. Officials warn summer heat accelerates microbial growth in ready-to-eat cold noodles. Retailers should enforce hygienic practices, proper packaging, and cold storage below 7°C, and consumers should refrigerate and consume promptly to minimize risk.

triage.headline_ja: 台北市が冷やし麺40件を抽出検査、コンビニの「豪華海鮮陸海総合」からサルモネラ菌検出　問題店舗を公表
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の一販売店における食品サンプル検査でサルモネラ菌が1件検出された事例であり、疾病の流行や人への感染事例は報告されていない。公衆衛生上の重大な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 疾病名にParatyphoid/Typhoidが付与されているが、記事内容は食品サンプル検査でのサルモネラ菌検出に関するものであり、腸チフス・パラチフスの発生とは無関係。発生地域は台湾であり、対象国リスト（中国含む）には該当しないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kalyan: Stray dog bites more than '130 people in four hours'
article.articleSummary: White stray dog in Kalyan’s Adharwadi area attacked about 130 people over four hours on Sunday evening, with victims bitten roughly every two minutes. The dog, roaming near Sandeep Hotel, triggered a rapid public-health response as KDMC stray-dog officials, police from Khadakpada and MHB stations, and local corporators joined the hunt. Victims were rushed to the KDMC-run hospital and received anti-rabies vaccines; Dr. Sandeep Pagare confirmed 130 bite patients presented and were treated with rabies injections. No fatalities are reported in the article. The incident underscores the risk from stray canines and the need for timely post-exposure vaccination and animal-control measures in urban Kalyan; laboratory confirmation of the dog or bites is not mentioned, and there are no indicated imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: カリヤン：野良犬が4時間で130人以上に咬みつく
triage.triage_reason: 単発の野良犬咬傷事案であり死亡例なし、ヒトーヒト感染や国際的拡大リスクは認められないが、狂犬病自体の重症度リスクと地域の動物管理体制の観点から継続的な注視が望ましい。
triage.notes: 犬の狂犬病検査結果や被害者の転帰（発症の有無）は記事に記載なし。狂犬病自体は重篤だが、本事案は咬傷後の予防接種対応が主で、確定診断や死亡例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 以练筑防 以练备战 -- -- 果洛州、玛多县联合开展鼠疫应急处置实战演练
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Practice to Build Defenses, Practice to Prepare for Battle — Guoluo Prefecture and Maduo County Jointly Conduct a Real-World Plague Emergency Response Drill
article.articleSummary: On August 9, 2026, Guoluo Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture and Maduo County in Qinghai Province jointly conducted a real-world plague emergency response drill to bolster plateau public health defenses and cross-regional response capabilities. Led by the prefecture health commission and county authorities, the exercise involved prefecture/county CDCs, health bureaus, emergency management, and over 50 staff, with police, county hospital, and township clinics participating and department heads observing. The drill simulated a live plague outbreak and covered emergency mobilization, personal protective measures, epidemiological investigation, close-contact tracing, specimen collection and transport, site disinfection and flea control, risk assessment, reporting, and cross-regional joint prevention and control, strictly adhering to biosafety standards. Maduo County will summarize lessons, refine contingency plans, and sustain routine, practical drills to strengthen plague surveillance, environmental disinfection, and health education, safeguarding public health.

triage.headline_ja: 実戦を通じて防御を固め、戦いに備える ―― 果洛州・玛多県が合同でペスト緊急対応実戦演習を実施

triage.notes: 本記事は実際のペスト患者発生を報じるものではなく、青海省果洛チベット族自治州及び玛多県が合同で実施した緊急対応の実戦演習（訓練）に関する報道。監視体制強化の一環であり、公衆衛生上の実害は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Vivir, morir y sobrevivir a la epidemia de ébola de crecimiento más rápido jamás registrado de la historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Living, Dying, and Surviving the Ebola Epidemic — the Fastest-Growing in History.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Bunia, declared May 15. By August 10, the outbreak has caused more than 1,800 deaths and about 4,000 laboratory-confirmed cases, including at least 330 children (UNICEF). It is the largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest globally, surpassed only by the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with roughly 11,300 deaths and over 28,000 cases. Transmission is accelerating: in the first 11 weeks, about 1,500 deaths occurred, versus 279 in 2014. WHO Director-General Tedros warned the outbreak is outpacing response in parts of the east; MSF has mobilized around 1,400 staff. Health workers face fear: in the first month, about 75 contracted Ebola and 17 died. Mistrust and fear of hospitals hinder care; burial teams (e.g., Badya Piracel Florence) work to protect the living while ensuring dignified burials, since transmission can occur after death.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速で拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行——生き、死に、そして生き延びる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされる大規模エボラ流行が進行中で、死者1,800人超・確定例約4,000例に達し、WHOも対応の遅れを警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にシエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアが含まれるが、これらは2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行との比較のための言及であり、現行の流行地は東部DRC(ブニア中心)のみ。よって検証済み発生国はDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: El Salvador declara alerta sanitaria por influenza aviar de alta patogenicidad
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Salvador declares a health alert for highly pathogenic avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: El Salvador declares a nationwide health alert for Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) following a ministerial agreement in Diario Oficial, initial six-month duration to strengthen surveillance, control, and response to the risk of introduction and spread. The move comes amid sustained regional expansion of HPAI, with recent outbreaks reported in the United States, Canada, Argentina, Brazil, Honduras, Costa Rica and Colombia, per the OIE and FAO. Since October 2025, cases have been observed in domestic poultry, wild birds, and mammals. Clinical signs include respiratory issues, crest and beak cyanosis, head edema, ruffled plumage, reduced egg production, digestive disturbances, and sudden mortality. Diagnosis relies on virus isolation or viral RNA detection. Mandatory immediate notification of suspected cases by poultry sector actors; enhanced border and entry controls on live birds, products, and avian genetic material from affected countries. Sanitary measures in farms, slaughterhouses, and risk zones; public and sector education campaigns; vaccine oversight by the Directorate General of Livestock; penalties for non-compliance. The alert may extend if regional conditions persist; published 21 July 2026.

article.articleHeadline: US tightens travel rules for people returning from Ebola-hit regions
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo trigger tightened US travel rules: Ugandan and South Sudan travellers face enhanced health screening; DRC returnees must spend 21 days outside the US before boarding a commercial flight. The measures aim to prevent imported Ebola cases and to monitor exposed travellers amid a serious outbreak reported across several eastern provinces of DRC. The policy supplements ongoing international response to the Ebola crisis; humanitarian groups warn that travel restrictions could hinder movement of health workers and aid personnel. In support, the United States pledges an additional $242 million for a total of $512 million to fund disease surveillance, treatment, and other emergency operations in eastern DRC. Washington underscores a careful approach to containment at the source while preventing entry of potential cases.

triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC東部で発生しているエボラ出血熱への米国の対応（渡航制限・資金支援）。ウガンダ・南スーダンは渡航者への健康スクリーニング対象として言及されているが、発生国ではないため対象外。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi sees nearly 6-fold rise in H1N1 cases: Symptoms, causes, who is most at risk - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports a sharp rise in H1N1 influenza cases this year: 1,344 cases in 2026 in the city, up six-fold from 229 during the same period last year. AIIMS doctors attribute a likely link to the monsoon season and cooler temperatures, with throat swab tests confirming influenza A and H1N1 among patients with upper respiratory infections. H1N1, or swine flu, primarily affects the nose, throat and lungs and spreads via coughs, sneezes or close contact. Common symptoms include fever, body aches, cough, sore throat, runny nose, red or watery eyes, fatigue, chills and sweats. High-risk groups include the elderly, the immunocompromised, and people with diabetes, hypertension, CKD, liver disease, cancer, and children under five. Prevention includes annual flu vaccination and hygiene measures; vaccination reduces severe illness and hospitalization, though not always infection.

article.articleHeadline: ചിക്കുൻഗുനിയ വന്നവരിൽ സന്ധിവാതം കൂടുന്നുവെന്ന് പഠനം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study finds increased arthritis in people with chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Arthritis linked to chikungunya: A two-phase Indian study led by Dr. Arvind Chopra of the Pune Center for Rheumatic Diseases, with collaborators from Kozhikode Medical College and Thiruvananthapuram, published in the International Journal of Rheumatic Diseases. Surveyed 56,548 people across 14 centers with WHO support; first phase (2006–2008) and a second phase after a decade. New-onset inflammatory arthritis occurred in those without prior arthritis after chikungunya, while those with existing arthritis worsened; diabetes and hypertension aggravated impairment. Over time, some patients showed remission toward pre-illness status; others progressed to chronic arthritis and severe myalgia, more common among the elderly. India has about 195 million people with arthritis-related issues; Kerala accounts for roughly 150,000 cases. Modern medicine plus Ayurveda-integrated treatment appeared effective in the study.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア感染者に関節炎増加、研究で判明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はチクングニア感染後の関節炎リスクに関する学術研究の紹介であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではないため、シグナルとしては見送り。
triage.notes: この記事は過去（2006-2008年および約10年後）のチクングニア感染に関連する関節炎の長期的影響を調査した研究成果の報道であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクや感染症危機を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Evidence of dengue transmission and a diverse Aedes mosquito virome on the Congo's Angola border
article.articleSummary: Dengue virus transmission is evidenced at the Congo–Angola border, with field and laboratory data supporting active circulation of dengue and highlighting risk to border communities. The study also uncovers a diverse Aedes mosquito virome in the area, indicating complex vector ecology that could sustain arboviral transmission. Conducted in and around the Congo–Angola frontier, the findings emphasize potential dengue spillover and local outbreaks in regions with Aedes vectors. The article is an open-access, unedited Nature Communications manuscript (2026), listing authors including Wenqiao He, Thierry Bobanga, Anne Piantadosi, Zachary R. Popkin-Hall, Fabien Vulu, Matthew H. Collins, Melchior M. Kashamuka, Antoinette K. Tshefu, Jonathan J. Juliano, and Jonathan B. Parr. The work underscores intensified dengue surveillance and vector-virome diversity assessment to inform public health responses and border-area risk mitigation.

triage.triage_reason: 学術研究論文（Nature Communications）によるデング熱伝播とベクター生態の報告であり、公衆衛生上の具体的な症例数・重症度データが不足しているため、続報や公的発表を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究論文（プレプリント/未編集原稿）であり、実際の症例数・臨床データの記載がないため、疫学的リスク評価には追加情報が必要。アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 暑假游玩多注意 被这种昆虫叮咬可能感染寄生虫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be cautious during summer vacation: a bite from this insect may cause a parasitic infection.
article.articleSummary: Visceral leishmaniasis (kala-azar) is a chronic parasitic disease in China, caused by Leishmania and transmitted by Phlebotomine sandflies (white sand fly). High risk during summer holidays; sandflies are active May–September, peak June–July; major endemic regions include Beijing, Hebei, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, Gansu, Xinjiang, and Sichuan, with scattered cases as transmission persists. Infection occurs when a sandfly bites an infected dog and then bites a person. incubation 3–6 months; symptoms: prolonged irregular fever, hepatosplenomegaly, anemia; often atypical and misdiagnosed. Diagnosis relies on exposure history and lab tests: bone marrow aspiration, rk39 rapid test, or PCR. Treatment with sodium stibogluconate is effective under medical supervision; alternatives include amphotericin B for resistant or special patients. Preventive measures: bed nets, clothing, repellents, and post-travel testing of pets (antibody testing within six months). Emphasize early recognition and treatment to reduce mortality.

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Cases Rise In Delhi: 5 Signs Your Cold May Not Be 'Normal Viral' Infection
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10, Delhi's H1N1 influenza cases have risen to 1,344 this season, up from 229 in the same period last year—a sixfold increase. H1N1, a subtype of influenza A, can cause fever, cough, runny nose, body aches and fatigue, with a dry cough that may be severe and persist for two weeks or longer. Breathing difficulty or chest discomfort indicates potential complications such as pneumonia. A pattern of improvement followed by relapse should prompt medical evaluation. High-risk groups include pregnant women, children under five, older adults, and people with chronic conditions or weakened immunity. Transmission is via respiratory droplets; preventive measures include respiratory hygiene and handwashing. Individuals with flu-like symptoms, particularly in high-risk groups, should seek prompt medical advice rather than self-diagnosing.

triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり、記事は主に健康啓発（症状の見分け方）を目的とした内容。感染者数の6倍増という数値は注視すべきだが、重症度や医療体制への負荷に関する具体的情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza at the forefront of infectious-disease deaths; H1N1 and H3N2 viruses spreading.
article.articleSummary: Alappuzha, Kerala: Influenza is driving respiratory deaths during the monsoon. In the past week, 604 influenza cases and 10 deaths were reported in the state, with H1N1 and H3N2 predominating. This year has seen 6,650 influenza infections and 77 deaths, making influenza the leading cause of mortality in the health department’s communicable-disease list, ahead of plague and dengue. H3N2 has emerged post-COVID-19, whereas earlier seasons were dominated by H1N1. H3N2 can cause pneumonia and breathing difficulties; H1N1 presents with fever, body aches, sore throat, cough, vomiting, and fatigue. Vulnerable groups include the elderly, pregnant women, and those with weakened immunity. Transmission occurs via droplets from coughing, sneezing, or talking, and by touching contaminated surfaces with the mouth or nose. If preventive measures lapse, spread may continue, including in relief camps.

triage.notes: 季節性（モンスーン期）のインフルエンザ流行で、州内での死者数増加が報告されているが、地域内の既存の公衆衛生課題であり国際的懸念事項ではない。H3N2の優勢化がCOVID-19後の新たな傾向として言及されている点は継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يودي بحياة 1887 شخصاً في الكونغو.. وتحذيرات من تسارع الانتشار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola claims 1,887 lives in Congo, with warnings of accelerating spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,887 deaths and 4,120 confirmed infections as of August 6, 2026. A quarantined vessel at Maluku port near Kinshasa, with about 200 passengers, yielded negative test results for Ebola after a traveler with Ebola-like symptoms died; the National Institute for Biomedical Research confirmed all tests negative. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged an accelerated, stronger response as transmission appears to be accelerating. In May, the Congo and Uganda outbreaks were declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with a $518 million response plan developed with the Africa CDC to address the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola. Ongoing surveillance and containment measures are emphasized to curb the spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴで1887人の死者、感染拡大加速の警告
triage.triage_reason: PHEICが宣言されたエボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、死者数・感染者数が多く、WHOが対応強化を要請しているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。船舶検疫事例はエボラ陰性と確認済み。

article.articleHeadline: South Sudan: Research Terms of Reference - Knowledge, Attitudes and Practices Survey, Ebola Outbreak, June 2026 (SSD2604, V1) - South Sudan
article.articleSummary: South Sudan faces elevated risk of Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) importation linked to the ongoing DRC outbreak and cross-border transmission into Uganda. As of mid-June 2026, DRC reported 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, with transmission across 26 health zones in three provinces; Uganda recorded 19 confirmed cases (14 imported, 5 locally acquired). South Sudan’s long, porous borders and a major mobility corridor heighten containment challenges amid humanitarian strains. A June 2026 RCCE readiness self-assessment placed preparedness at 25, citing gaps in community feedback mechanisms and rumor control, underscoring the need for targeted engagement. REACH is conducting a Knowledge, Attitudes and Practices (KAP) survey in high-risk areas to gauge understanding of EVD, risk perception, trust in information sources, and care-seeking behavior, informing messaging and serving as entry for a broader UNICEF-led KAP study. The work aligns with parallel REACH KAP efforts in Uganda and DRC using the CDC/RTI Ebola KAP toolkit for regional comparability.

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダン：エボラ出血熱流行に関する知識・態度・実践（KAP）調査のための研究背景説明書（2026年6月、SSD2604、V1）
triage.triage_reason: DRCで676例確定・136名死亡の進行中のエボラ流行があり、既にウガンダへの越境感染（19例）も確認されている。南スーダンへの流入リスクも高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は南スーダンでのKAP調査実施を主題としているが、実際のエボラ発生（確定例・死亡例）はDRCで進行中であり、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されている。南スーダン・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Εφιάλτης με τον Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Πάνω από 4.000 κρούσματα και φόβοι για μετάλλαξη του ιού
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nightmare with Ebola in Congo: More than 4,000 cases and fears of the virus mutating.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has surpassed 4,000 cases, with 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths reported through Aug 4; Africa CDC later confirmed cases exceed 4,000. The epicenter is Ituri province, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, and Haut-Uele; Uganda has reported 20 cases and a suspected Ebola death on a vessel bound for Kinshasa, prompting quarantine and testing of remaining passengers. MSF’s Bunia treatment center notes that 90% of admitted patients are not on known-contact lists, and only about 10 contacts per case are traced versus an expected ~40, indicating under-detection. The outbreak is the second-largest on record; more than two-thirds of deaths occur in the community rather than treatment centers. Authorities plan door-to-door active case finding, village-focused response, and use of remdesivir; UNICEF warns that fear and service disruptions weaken basic health care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラの悪夢：感染者4,000人超、ウイルス変異への懸念
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生しているエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が4,000例超、死亡者1,800人超に達し、史上2番目の規模の流行となっている。ウガンダへの越境例や船舶での疑い死亡例など国際的拡大のリスクが明確であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの感染例（20例）や船舶内疑い死亡例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。感染源はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州が主要発生地、北キブ・南キブ・オートウエレ州へ拡大）。MSFによる接触者追跡の不十分さ（検出率低下）や地域内死亡が大半を占める点から、感染拡大・管理困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يقتل 1887 في الكونغو وتحذيرات من تسارع التفشي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills 1,887 in the Congo, with warnings of accelerating outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,887 deaths from 4,120 confirmed cases as of August 6. No new infections were found among more than 200 passengers aboard a quarantined boat at Maloko port, about 65 km from Kinshasa, after one traveler died with Ebola-like symptoms; the National Institute for Biomedical Research (INRB) reported all tests negative and urged calm. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called for a rapid, intensified response, warning the outbreak is accelerating. In May, WHO declared the Congo-Uganda outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and, with the African CDC, launched a $518 million plan to respond to Bundibugyo ebolavirus circulation. Ongoing surveillance and enhanced measures remain critical to contain transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴで1887人死亡 感染拡大の加速に警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱がPHEIC宣言済みで死者1887人・確認例4120人に達し、WHOも感染拡大加速を警告しており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・国際的拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダにも言及しているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため除外。PHEIC宣言済みで既に国際的関心・支援体制が構築されている進行中のアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Case Count Set to Increase as Congo Officials Expand Hunt for Hidden Infections
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is likely to worsen in coming weeks as health officials broaden the hunt for infections that have gone undetected. Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) and its partners are shifting from conventional contact tracing to a more expansive approach designed to identify hidden chains of transmission. The move addresses gaps in case detection and aims to rapidly locate and isolate additional cases to curb spread. As of 2026-08-10, authorities anticipate an increase in reported cases as undetected infections are brought into the surveillance net, informing intensified response measures and allocation of resources across affected provinces of the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ当局が隠れた感染者を追跡するための捜索を拡大する中、エボラ感染者数は増加する見込み
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が継続しており、Africa CDCが症例発見手法を強化する中で感染者数増加が予想されている。深刻な公衆衛生上の影響とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり、国際的な支援も動員されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Africa CDCが接触者追跡から積極的な症例探索へ手法を転換しており、今後数週間で報告例数が増加する見込み。感染拡大範囲や国際的拡大リスクについては記事に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Спалах Еболи в Конго став другим найбільшим в історії: влада перевіряє мутацію вірусу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo has become the second-largest in history: authorities are examining the virus mutation.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, identified as beginning in May 2026, is driven by the Bundibugyo strain. As of August 10, 2026, it has confirmed over 4,000 cases and about 1,850 deaths, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history. Health authorities fear possible viral mutation contributing to unusually severe disease and are planning joint investigations with the World Health Organization to determine genetic changes and their impact on transmission. In response, clinicians are intensifying community-based case finding, visiting homes to screen residents for Ebola symptoms. Clinical trials for treatment options are under way. An imported case in France involving a doctor returning from a humanitarian mission in DRC has recovered.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行は史上2番目の規模に：当局はウイルス変異を調査中
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行が史上2番目の規模（4,000例超、死者約1,850人）に達し、ウイルス変異の可能性やフランスへの輸入例も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: フランスでの輸入例（DRCでの人道支援活動から帰国した医師）は既に回復しており、フランス国内での二次感染は報告されていないため、フランスはverified_locationsに含めず、対象国のみ記載した。ウイルス変異の可能性についてはWHOとの共同調査が予定されており、続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura virus: बारिश के मौसम में क्यों बढ़ता है चांदीपुरा वायरस का खतरा? जानिए लक्षण और डॉक्टर की सलाह
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chandipura virus: Why does the risk of Chandipura virus increase during the monsoon season? Learn the symptoms and doctor's advice.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus poses risk during the monsoon season when sand flies flourish. In Gujarat's 2026 monsoon season, 22 children have died and authorities report 184 suspected cases with 35 laboratory-confirmed infections. Named after Chandrapur, Maharashtra, it has affected Gujarat, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, and Western India. Transmission occurs via bites from infected sand flies; humid conditions and poor vector control amplify exposure. Children under 15 are most affected due to immature immunity and higher outdoor exposure. Initial fever can be followed by sudden onset acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) with seizures, altered consciousness, or coma; progression can be rapid, sometimes within 24–48 hours. There is no vaccine or antiviral; care is supportive. Studies by Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre and National Institute of Virology suggest rapid immune activation in early infection. Prevention centers on sand fly bite avoidance: long sleeves, bed nets, sanitation, repairing wall cracks, and year-round surveillance in high-risk districts.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルス：モンスーン期にチャンディプラウイルスのリスクが高まる理由とは？症状と医師の助言
triage.triage_reason: インド・グジャラート州で子供22人が死亡し184例の疑い例（35例検査確定）が報告される急性脳炎症候群アウトブレイクであり、公衆衛生への影響が深刻かつ複数州に拡大しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサンドフライ媒介性で人-人感染は報告されていないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、小児における高い死亡率と急速な病状進行（24-48時間）から公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬が存在しない点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в Конго стала второй по масштабам в истории: власти проверяют мутацию вируса
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo has become the second-largest in history: authorities are examining the virus mutation.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, began in May 2026 in Ituri province and has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases with about 1,850 deaths, making it the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record. Authorities fear the virus may have mutated, and Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya says researchers will work with the World Health Organization to determine if changes in the virus underlie the unusually severe disease course. To identify new cases, clinicians will conduct door-to-door checks in affected communities to screen residents for Ebola symptoms. Clinical trials of potential Ebola therapies are underway in the DRC. Internationally, France reported its first imported Ebola case, a physician who had recently returned from a humanitarian mission in DRC and later recovered.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、史上2番目の規模に：当局はウイルスの変異を検証中
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が4000例超・死者約1850人と史上2番目の規模に達し、フランスへの輸入例も発生しており、国際的拡大とウイルス変異の懸念があるため、フルRRAへ移行すべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: フランスでの輸入例は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ウイルス変異の可能性とWHO・Africa CDCの共同調査進行中である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola takes severe toll on women and children in eastern DRC: UN
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC's Ituri province deepens humanitarian crisis, with displacement near one million and women and children making up about 80% of the displaced. UNICEF says children account for nearly one-third of Ebola-related deaths, while comprising about a quarter of confirmed cases. Health service use in hardest-hit areas has fallen by more than 40% amid fear of infection; the UN Population Fund warns pregnant women face barriers to maternal care. Maternal deaths in Ituri have nearly doubled since the outbreak began, averaging about six pregnancy-related deaths per week, and Ebola infection during pregnancy remains linked to a high risk of foetal loss. Rebuilding public trust is critical. UN Ocha, UNICEF, WHO, Africa CDC, and the DRC Ministry of Public Health have mobilized about 13,000 community workers, reaching over 2.4 million people with prevention/early-detection information and conducting more than 500,000 household visits to counter misinformation and encourage early treatment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国東部で女性と子どもに深刻な打撃：国連報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが人道危機を深刻化させており、死者・妊産婦死亡の増加、医療サービス利用の急減など重大な公衆衛生上の影響が確認されているため。
triage.notes: UNICEF、UNFPA、WHO、Africa CDC、DRC保健省が対応にあたっており、既に国際支援が進行中。継続的な感染拡大リスクと妊産婦・小児への深刻な影響が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 450 Kasus TBC Diperkirakan Belum Ditemukan, Pemkab Bangka Selatan Genjot Screening
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 450 TB cases estimated to be undetected, South Bangka Regency Government ramps up screening.
article.articleSummary: South Bangka Regency in the Bangka Belitung Islands, Indonesia, estimates 585 tuberculosis (TB) cases for 2026, with only 135 detected by July, leaving about 450 undetected. To close the gap, the local government is conducting free TB screening across 27 sites (three urban communities and 24 villages) from August to November 2026, aiming to screen about 2,700 residents (roughly 100 per site). The effort targets individuals with TB symptoms or those who have had household or close contact with TB patients, regardless of age. Screenings begin with symptom assessment, followed by Mantoux testing or sputum testing using the Tes Cepat Molekuler (TCM). Participants receive free health checks (blood pressure, blood glucose, etc.) in addition to TB assessment. The program seeks to improve early detection to prevent progression and transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 結核患者450人が未発見と推定、南バンカ県政府がスクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: 結核は地域の恒常的な公衆衛生課題であり、通常の対策強化（スクリーニング事業）の一環であるため、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は地域で流行している慢性感染症であり、地方自治体による定例的な検診強化策の報道。緊急性・異常性は低い。
