article.articleHeadline: Trade flow: German pork exports rebound after FMD restrictions
article.articleSummary: German pork exports to non-EU markets totaled 157,000 metric tons in Jan–May 2026, up 34% year-on-year and close to 2024 levels, aided by the containment of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) and market reopenings. South Korea reopened to German shipments about six months after FMD containment, adding 27,000 t; the United Kingdom returned to normal trade; Vietnam purchased 11,000 t more than a year earlier. Germany has been FMD-free since mid-April 2025. Still, exports to third countries remain below pre-ASF levels; in H1 2020 544,000 t were sold abroad, two-thirds to China, which Germany is negotiating an ASF regionalization agreement with. Global competition from Brazil and softening Chinese demand dampen gains. EU internal sales declined slightly due to Spain’s larger supply, though EU shipments remained the stronger pillar, with more than 80% of total shipments staying within the internal market in January.

triage.headline_ja: 貿易動向：ドイツの豚肉輸出、口蹄疫規制後に回復
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はドイツの豚肉輸出統計に関する経済・貿易記事であり、FMDはドイツで既に収束済み（2025年4月よりFMDフリー）。対象国における新規感染症アウトブレイクの記述はなく、公衆衛生上の懸念事項ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツの豚肉貿易統計が主題。ドイツは対象国リストに含まれず、また対象国（Brazil, China, Vietnam）についても実際の疾病発生ではなく貿易競合・輸出先・ASF規正化協定交渉の文脈での言及のみであり、verified_locationsには該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội chống dịch sốt xuất huyết trong mùa cao điểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi fights dengue fever during peak season.
article.articleSummary: Hanoi faces dengue fever as peak season arrives. As of August 2026, the city reported 1,259 dengue cases across 115 of 126 communes and wards, with outbreaks and a risk of wider spread without decisive control. The Hanoi Department of Health deployed 46 inspection teams to 91 localities to assess response, vector surveillance, and communications. In Hong Ha Ward, 22 dengue cases and one outbreak have been recorded; four cases in two weeks and two patients under treatment, with clusters around Tu Lien, Yen Phu, and Phuc Xa. In Phu Dong Commune, seven cases across seven villages were reported by August 6, prompting formation of vector-control brigades and rapid-response teams, plus ULV and hot fogging with 12 L Hantox 200. Despite campaigns, some households retain water containers with larvae, and public awareness is uneven. Hot, humid, rainy weather and population movement heighten transmission risk; officials urge larval reduction and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、ピークシーズンにデング熱と闘う
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱流行でハノイ市が対応中だが、重症度や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、現時点では国内対応で管理可能なレベルのため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ハノイ市内でのデング熱季節的流行。1,259例が126コミューン中115で報告され、当局は媒介蚊対策・監視チームを展開。重症例・死亡報告はなく、国際的拡大の兆候も見られない。

article.articleHeadline: छत्तीसगढ़ में मलेरिया के 8 हजार मामले, कांकेर में 13 दिन में मारे गए पांच, NHRC ने मुख्य सचिव को भेजा नोटिस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 8,000 malaria cases in Chhattisgarh, five died in 13 days in Kanker, NHRC sent a notice to the Chief Secretary
article.articleSummary: 8,000 malaria cases reported in Chhattisgarh, with five deaths in Kanker district within 13 days. The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has taken suo motu cognizance and issued a four-week notice to the Chief Secretary seeking a detailed report on alleged government laxity. Malaria is spreading to Kavardha and Bilaspur rural areas, including Mudhwayi village (Baiga-majority) and surrounding regions, with transmission observed over the past 15 days. Health department investigations have confirmed malaria infections in about 40-45 villagers in Kavardha; locals claim five deaths, though officials have not officially confirmed these fatalities. In Bilaspur’s Kota region, a 37-year-old woman has died of malaria, and a 17-year-old student’s death is under suspicion of falciparum malaria.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティースガル州でマラリア8000例、カンケール地区で13日間に5人死亡、NHRCが州首席書記官に通知
triage.triage_reason: 国内複数地域でマラリア感染が拡大し死亡例が続いており、人権委員会(NHRC)が政府に通知を出すなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: マラリアは地域流行性疾患で国際拡大リスクは低いが、複数州（チャッティースガル州）で死亡例を伴う感染拡大が継続し、NHRCが行政対応の遅れを指摘するなど国内の社会的関心が高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: अफ्रीका में मच्छरों से फैल रहा Yellow Fever, हर साल हजारों मौतें! भारत में हो सकता खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow Fever spreading by mosquitoes in Africa, thousands die every year! There could be a risk in India.
article.articleSummary: Yellow Fever, a viral disease transmitted by Aedes, Haemagogus, and Sabethes mosquitoes, primarily in Africa and parts of the Americas, causes 67,000–173,000 severe infections and 31,000–82,000 deaths annually, per WHO. Transmission occurs in three cycles: sylvatic (jungle) via primates, intermediate, and urban when infected humans enter vector-rich areas. Incubation is 3–6 days; early symptoms include fever, headache, myalgia, weakness, nausea. About 15% progress to severe disease with jaundice, dark urine, bleeding, organ failure, and shock; fatality in severe cases reaches about 50% within 7–10 days. India is not endemic, but vaccination and passenger certificates are required for travelers from yellow fever–affected countries; the certificate becomes valid 10 days after vaccination and, under current WHO rules, remains valid for life. There is no specific antiviral treatment; vaccine provides long-term protection.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで蚊により黄熱病が拡大、毎年数千人が死亡！インドにもリスクの可能性
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生イベントではなく黄熱病に関する一般的な解説記事であり、インドは非流行国と明記されている。具体的な新規発生国も特定されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカにおける黄熱病の一般的な疫学情報とインドへの潜在的リスクを解説する教育的記事であり、対象国における具体的な新規発生を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: ABP Live Doc Talk | Hepatitis Risk During Monsoon: How To Protect Your Liver From Infection
article.articleSummary: Monsoon raises hepatitis risk in India, with Hepatitis A and E transmitted mainly through contaminated water and food. Regency Health, marking World Hepatitis Day, urges safe water, proper food handling, hygiene, and vaccination to protect liver health, especially among pregnant women, older adults, and those with weakened immunity. Globally, the WHO notes about 304 million people live with chronic Hepatitis B or C as of 2022; in India, the NVHCP estimates roughly 40 million with Hepatitis B and 6–12 million with Hepatitis C. Early hepatitis can present with fever, fatigue, nausea, loss of appetite, and later dark urine, pale stools, or jaundice; symptoms should prompt medical evaluation. Prevention emphasizes drinking boiled/filtered/packaged water, washing hands, and thorough washing of produce, plus Hepatitis A vaccination for at-risk individuals. Hepatitis B and C prevention includes vaccination, safe medical practices, screening, and timely treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ABP Liveドクタートーク｜モンスーン時期の肝炎リスク：感染から肝臓を守る方法
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや症例増加を報じるものではなく、季節性の一般的な健康啓発・予防情報記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、世界肝炎デーに関連した一般的な予防啓発記事であり、具体的な患者数増加や集団発生の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le bateau immobilisé près de Kinshasa libéré, aucun cas détecté
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the boat immobilized near Kinshasa released, no cases detected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the DRC: A passenger boat immobilized upstream of Kinshasa, off Maluku, resumed on 7 August with all occupants. Seven symptomatic passengers tested negative; Health Minister Roger Kamba announced on 9 August. The alert followed a voyage longer than the Ebola incubation period (more than 21 days). Initial surveillance misidentified the boat's origin as Kisangani; verification showed it came from Mongala, a province spared from the outbreak. The alert had been sparked by the death of a passenger who disembarked in Mongala with fever, diarrhea and vomiting; because the body was not sampled, Ebola could not be confirmed. The upstream checkpoint will remain permanent. Kinshasa has seen no cases; the outbreak's epicenter remains Ituri, more than 1,000 km away.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：キンシャサ近郊で移動停止していた船が解放、感染例は検出されず
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上のリスクを有する疾患であり、今回はキンシャサ近郊での感染疑い事案が陰性と確認されたものの、イトゥリ州を中心に進行中のアウトブレイクの一部として継続的な監視が必要なため。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のエボラアウトブレイク（震源地イトゥリ州）に関連する個別事案（船舶隔離）の続報であり、結果は陰性（感染例なし）。アウトブレイク自体は継続中であり、監視体制（検問所の常設化）が維持されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Էպոլայի համաճարակը Քոնկոյի Ժողովրդավարական Հանրապետութեան մէջ. 743 վարակուած երեխաներ, 330 մահ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. 743 infected children, 330 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is the country’s heaviest and fastest-spreading. As of 2 August 2026, UNICEF reports 743 confirmed pediatric Ebola cases and 330 deaths. Core hotspots are Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nizi, and Rwampara. From April to June 2026, essential health service utilization declined by 42% in outbreak centers, and 13% province-wide. Immunization declined notably: first-dose measles vaccination in Mongbwalu fell 69%; May–June health facilities delivered over 23,000 fewer routine childhood vaccines than the previous month. Maternal health services were affected too, with births down 13% overall (up to 70% in some districts) and antenatal visits reduced. UNICEF warns disruptions could raise deaths from malaria and pneumonia. In response, about 13,000 community health workers and partners reached over 2.4 million people with prevention/early-detection messaging and conducted 505,000 home visits to restore trust and direct suspected cases to health centers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行、感染児童743人・死亡330人
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で同国史上最も急速かつ大規模なエボラ流行が発生し、死亡者数・感染者数ともに多く、医療サービス崩壊による二次的な健康被害（麻疹・マラリア・妊産婦ケア低下）も報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事にはルワンダの地名も付与されているが、サマリー本文はコンゴ民主共和国イツリ州（ブニア、モングバルウ、ニジ等）での流行に限定されており、ルワンダでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : plus de 300 enfants morts, et des services de santé qui se vident
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: more than 300 children have died, and health services are emptying out.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, remains active with Bunia as the epicenter. By Aug 2, 2026, 743 confirmed cases and 330 deaths among those under 18, who account for about a quarter of cases but nearly one-third of deaths; under-5 mortality exceeds 60% of confirmed pediatric cases, while adults under 30% CFR. As of Aug 6, Bunia alone reports 950 confirmed cases and 289 deaths. Health-seeking behavior deteriorates: essential services in four main hubs (Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nizi, Rwampara) down 42% April–June; province-wide consultations fall about 13% (140,921 to 123,142). Routine vaccination collapses, with Mongbwalu measles first dose down 69% and over 23,000 routine doses unscheduled May–June. Maternal health declines: assisted births −13% province-wide; prenatal visits down ~28% (Bunia 38%, Rwampara 30%, Nizi 70%). UNICEF warns of broader health system disruption affecting malaria, diarrheal diseases, and other treatable conditions, and calls to keep facilities open. Interventions include ~13,000 community workers trained, 2.4 million reached with prevention messages, and 505,000 home visits; funding gap: $89.9 million of a $113.45 million appeal remains.

triage.headline_ja: イツリのエボラ:300人以上の子供が死亡、医療サービスが空洞化している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ流行は確定例743件、死亡330件（小児）に達し、医療システム崩壊を伴う深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルである。
triage.notes: 発生地域にルワンダ(Kigali Province)が含まれているが、記事本文はイツリ州（DRC）のエボラ流行のみを主題としており、ルワンダでの発生は記載されていないため除外した。また併記されている麻疹・マラリアは、エボラによる医療崩壊の二次的影響として言及されているのみで、独立した流行ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Seven bitten by stray dogs, schools closed in parts of Rajouri's Kotranka
article.articleSummary: Rabies/stray-dog bites in Kotranka, Rajouri district, Jammu and Kashmir: seven persons and several other dogs were bitten by roaming rabid/stray dogs today. In response, authorities closed schools in Kotranka on August 10, 2026, with Heads of Institutions and teachers in panchayats Jaglanoo, Mohra-A, Mohra-B, Hubbi, Larkooti, Kandi Upper, Kandi Lower, and Khadyoon instructed to inform parents that students shall not attend and shall remain at home. The order, issued by the Zonal Education Planning Officer, calls for strict compliance and precautionary measures to safeguard student safety. The incident highlights ongoing dog bite/rabies concerns in the area, prompting immediate educational closures while safety arrangements are implemented.

triage.headline_ja: ラジョウリ県コトランカで野良犬に7人が咬まれ、学校が一部閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 地域的な狂犬病疑いの動物咬傷事案で学校閉鎖などの対応が取られているが、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生インパクトを示す情報は不足している。
triage.notes: 野良犬による咬傷が多発し学校閉鎖に至っているが、狂犬病確定診断や死亡例の記載はなく、地域的な動物由来事案として経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Batuk Berkepanjangan, Pemkab Bangka Selatan Diminta Segera Cek TBC Lewat CKG di Puskesmas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Persistent Cough, South Bangka Regency Government Urged to Immediately Check TB via CKG at the Puskesmas
article.articleSummary: Free Health Check (CKG) at Bangka Selatan Regency's puskesmas is urged to detect tuberculosis (TB) early. In South Bangka Regency, residents are encouraged to use the annual, free health screening to catch TB at an early stage. TB symptoms to watch include a cough lasting more than two weeks, intermittent fever—especially at night—and notable weight loss. TB testing via sputum examination can yield results in about one to two days after laboratory analysis, enabling timely confirmation. Health official Slamet Wahidin notes that TB is highly transmissible through droplets when coughing, so people with coughs or respiratory symptoms should practice coughing etiquette and wear masks. The initiative aims to bolster early detection and curb transmission by providing free access at puskesmas and promoting routine health checks.

triage.headline_ja: 咳が続く場合、南バンカ県政府はプスケスマスのCKGを通じて早急にTBC検査を受けるよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核の早期発見を促す公衆衛生啓発記事であり、異常な増加や新規アウトブレイクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による結核早期検診の啓発キャンペーンに関する記事で、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu cases : स्वाइन फ्लू से किन लोगों को ज्यादा खतरा, कैसे करें बचाव, डॉक्टरों ने बताया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu Cases: Who Is at Greater Risk from Swine Flu, How to Protect Yourself, Doctors Explain.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10, swine influenza A(H1N1) cases are rising in Delhi and other parts of India during the monsoon. Longer monsoon, temperature fluctuations, and heightened viral activity are driving the increase. Most outpatient cases are mild, but prevention through isolation is advised. At Fortis Hospital in Gurgaon, infectious disease specialists say symptoms include sudden fever, cough, sore throat, headache, body pains, nasal symptoms, and fatigue, with shortness of breath more likely in high-risk groups. About 20–30% of infections in children, the elderly, pregnant women, and people with weakened immunity or underlying chronic conditions (lung, heart, diabetes, kidney disease) may develop breathing difficulties. Early treatment with oseltamivir within 72 hours is emphasized. Vaccine on doctor’s advice, hand hygiene, and avoiding contact with infected individuals are key measures. Globally, seasonal influenza infects about 1 billion annually, with 3–5 million severe cases.

triage.headline_ja: スワインフル症例：スワインフルにより特にリスクが高いのは誰か、どう予防するか、医師が解説
triage.triage_reason: インドでの季節性H1N1増加に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、重大な公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報は乏しいが、モンスーン期の感染拡大として経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）はインドで例年モンスーン期に増加する既知の疾患であり、記事は主に予防・症状に関する医療情報提供が目的。具体的な症例数や重症化率の統計は明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتسارع في الكونغو الديمقراطية وسط غياب لقاح وعلاج للسلالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola accelerates in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid lack of a vaccine and treatment for the strain.
article.articleSummary: As of August 10, 2026, Ebola accelerates in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, marking its 17th outbreak. The current outbreak has 3,973 confirmed cases over 80 days, surpassing the 2018 outbreak’s 3,411. Deaths exceed 1,800; 776 recovered; more than 220 suspected. Ituri Province in the northeast is the epicenter, with about 84% of total cases and 85% of the latest 99 new cases. Five provinces are affected. Health workers in Bunia protest over delayed salaries, hindering response. WHO warns official counts may be fourfold underestimates due to spillover and delayed detection. The United States has pledged $242 million to support Ebola response. Moderna has approval to begin Phase 1 trials for a vaccine targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists. International partners pledged roughly $1.5 billion to support efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で加速、当該株に対するワクチン・治療法が存在しない中で拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ第17次流行が2018年流行を上回る規模となり、死者1800人超、ワクチン・治療法未承認の株であることからIHR基準複数該当。国際支援・資金投入も進んでいる重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 米国は資金援助国であり発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。WHOは公式集計が実際の4倍過小評価の可能性を指摘しており、実態はさらに深刻な可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt cao kèm nôn khan, người đàn ông đi khám phát hiện mắc căn bệnh đang gia tăng ở Hà Nội, dễ gây biến chứng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High fever with persistent vomiting: a man who goes for a check-up discovers he has contracted a disease on the rise in Hanoi that can easily lead to complications.
article.articleSummary: A 43-year-old man from Hanoi was hospitalized with dengue on day 4 of illness after four days of fever, chills, myalgia, and nausea/vomiting; no epistaxis or abdominal signs at admission. Ultrasound showed free fluid in the abdomen and pleural space, prompting hospitalization. Clinician notes dengue can progress rapidly, with the dangerous phase typically between days 3–7, including plasma leakage, thrombocytopenia, hemorrhage, or organ injury; fever and pain may lessen even as illness worsens, so close monitoring is essential. Abdominal ultrasound is a diagnostic and monitoring tool. Hanoi CDC reports rising dengue cases over two weeks, indicating peak season driven by hot, humid, rainy weather that boosts Aedes transmission. Dengue has four serotypes (DEN-1 to DEN-4); reinfection with a different serotype raises the risk of severe disease. Vietnam licenses the Qdenga vaccine (two doses, 3 months apart). Preventive measures include mosquito control and avoiding NSAIDs; seek medical evaluation for fever.

triage.headline_ja: 高熱と乾いた嘔吐、検査で発覚したハノイで増加中の合併症を招きやすい疾患
triage.triage_reason: ハノイでのデング熱症例増加は季節性・地域的に予想される事象であり、IHR基準は該当なしだが、重症化リスクや媒介動物による感染拡大の可能性からWPRO基準に一部該当するため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はハノイにおけるデング熱の個別重症例とCDCによる患者数増加の報告を扱っており、SFTSウイルスへの言及はなし。季節性のデング熱流行としては典型的な内容であり、特異的な異常事象の兆候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 4 209 cas confirmés et 1 916 décès au 7 août, l'INSP relève des " attentes répétées " de vaccin contre une souche qui n'en a aucun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 4,209 confirmed cases and 1,916 deaths as of August 7, INSP notes 'repeated expectations' for a vaccine against a strain for which there is none.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 4,209 confirmed cases and 1,916 deaths as of August 7, with 828 recoveries and 595 patients in isolation or hospital. Ituri hosts 3,636 cases and 1,551 deaths (86.4% of the national total; 42.7% provincial fatality), North Kivu 470/315 (67.0%), Haut-Uélé 91, Tshopo 9, South Kivu 3. The outbreak spans 53 of 140 health zones. Transmission remains active with 89 new cases and 29 deaths in the last 24 hours across Ituri (73), North Kivu (12) and Haut-Uélé (4). Contact tracing is 83.4% (14,923/17,896 to follow), unevenly performed; below the WHO/Africa CDC target of 95%. 1,318 alerts on Aug 7; 443 validated as suspected; 305 investigated; 198 transferred. Laboratories tested 326 samples with 89 confirmations (27.3% positivity). Treatment centers saturated in Ituri; gaps in North Kivu and Haut-Uélé. No vaccine for Bundibugyo; Ervebo targets Zaïre; vaccine candidates awaited. Report suspected cases to 151.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：8月7日時点で確認例4,209件、死者1,916人。INSPは『ワクチンが存在しない株』への『繰り返しの期待』を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 確認例4,209件・死者1,916人と大規模かつ致死率が高く、感染拡大が継続中で、当該株（Bundibugyo）にはワクチンが存在しないという異常事態であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域として挙げられているTshopo、South Kivu、Ituriは全てDRC国内の州であり、国としてはDRCのみが対象。ワクチン供給不足（Bundibugyo株に有効なワクチンが存在しない）と接触者追跡率がWHO/Africa CDC目標（95%）を下回っている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: CKG di Lapas Cipinang jadi upaya deteksi dini penyakit warga binaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CKG at Cipinang Prison becomes an early-detection effort for inmates' diseases.
article.articleSummary: TB screening integrated with Free Health Check (CKG) at Cipinang Prison in East Jakarta, conducted by Suku Dinas Kesehatan Jakarta Timur on Monday as part of Indonesia’s 81st Independence Day celebrations. The initiative screens inmates to detect tuberculous infection early and curb potential transmission in a high-density facility. About 20 health workers from the DKI Jakarta Health Office and district offices, supplemented by nearby clinics and hospitals, participate, bringing total personnel to 31. Checks take place at five designated locations, with 200 inmates slated for screening at each, totaling roughly 1,000 inmates. The integrated CKG–TB screening enables health staff to map possible transmission hotspots within the prison and ensure inmates receive free health services. TB remains a concern in East Jakarta, and early detection is intended to prevent wider outbreaks in the prison environment.

triage.headline_ja: チピナン刑務所での無料健康診断（CKG）が受刑者の疾病早期発見の取り組みとなる
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾病（結核）に対する通常のスクリーニング・早期発見活動であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 刑務所という高密度環境での結核スクリーニングプログラムであり、既存の公衆衛生対策の一環。新規感染爆発や異常事態の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola case count set to increase as Congo officials track hidden infections
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Congo is expected to worsen in the coming weeks as officials broaden their hunt for infections that have gone undetected. Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) and partners are shifting from conventional contact tracing to door-to-door case finding in the hardest-hit areas where widespread community transmission suggests broad exposure. The intensified search is anticipated to raise daily counts of suspected cases as thousands of community health workers uncover illnesses the existing surveillance system missed, according to Wessam Mankoula, Africa CDC's head of emergency preparedness and response. The strategy aims to identify hidden infections and interrupt transmission, even as it temporarily inflates reported case numbers. No details on laboratory confirmation, transmission source, or import/export cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染者数、当局が隠れた感染を追跡する中で増加見込み
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2上常に通知対象となる疾患であり、コミュニティ内での広範な感染拡大が疑われ、症例数増加が予想されているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ感染拡大と、Africa CDCによるドアツードアの症例発見戦略への転換を報告。検査確定状況や感染源、輸出入例に関する情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Jangan Sepelekan Lingkungan Kotor, Penyakit Ini Bisa Menyerang Semua Usia dan Mengganggu Kesehatan - TribunWow.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't Underestimate Dirty Environments; This Disease Can Affect People of All Ages and Compromise Health.
article.articleSummary: Dirty environments increase risk of infectious diseases including dengue fever (DBD) transmitted by Aedes aegypti via standing water, with symptoms such as high fever, headache, body pains, rash, and weakness. The piece highlights that exposure can affect people of all ages. Diarrhea can arise from contaminated food or water. Leptospirosis risk rises after contact with water or soil contaminated with rat urine. Airborne hazards like dust, smoke, and poor ventilation heighten acute respiratory infections (ARI). Poor hygiene can lead to skin issues caused by bacteria, fungi, and parasites, presenting itching, rash, redness, and scaling. The article emphasizes routine environmental cleanliness—remove trash, avoid standing water, and ensure good air circulation—to reduce health risks.

triage.headline_ja: 不衛生な環境を軽視しないで—この病気は全年齢層を襲い健康を害する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な発生事例や患者数の報告ではなく、環境衛生と疾病リスクに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、シグナルとしての緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱・レプトスピラ症・下痢症・呼吸器感染症等を一般的な公衆衛生啓発として紹介する内容で、特定の発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: เฝ้าระวัง 'โรคปอดอักเสบจากไวรัส RSV' ช่วงฤดูฝน ผู้สูงอายุเสี่ยงภาวะแทรกซ้อนรุนแรง - The Bangkok Insight
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant for RSV-related pneumonia during the rainy season; the elderly are at risk of severe complications - The Bangkok Insight.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Department of Disease Control warns RSV-related pneumonia, influenza, and COVID-19 should be monitored during the rainy season. RSV infection is rising; Digital Disease Surveillance (Jan 1–Apr 30, 2569) recorded 1,792 RSV cases (17.358 per 100,000) with no deaths. RSV can affect all ages but may progress to lower respiratory tract disease and pneumonia requiring hospitalization, especially in the elderly and those with diabetes, COPD, or heart disease, or immunocompromised individuals. Pneumonia in 2569 data (Jan 1–Feb 26) reached 63,511 cases with 73 deaths; incidence in people aged 60+ was 237.70 per 100,000. RSV spreads via droplets, secretions, and surfaces that can harbor the virus for hours. Vaccination guidance from the Infectious Diseases Association of Thailand targets adults and seniors: 75+, or 50–74 with comorbidities (lung/heart disease, immunocompromise, diabetes with complications, severe obesity, liver or advanced kidney disease, or kidney transplant). Seek care for fever, cough, or shortness of breath.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季にRSV関連肺炎を警戒、高齢者は重篤な合併症のリスク - The Bangkok Insight
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のRSV・インフルエンザ・COVID-19に関する定例的な公衆衛生上の注意喚起であり、死亡者数も報告なし（RSV）で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: タイ疾病管理局による季節性呼吸器感染症（RSV、インフル、COVID-19）への注意喚起記事。感染者数は増加傾向だが死亡例なし、通常の季節的疾病サーベイランス情報であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: El Congo sofreix el pitjor brot d'ebola de la seva història: Més de 1.900 morts i 4.200 contagis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo suffers the worst Ebola outbreak in its history: More than 1,900 deaths and 4,200 infections.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the most devastating Ebola outbreak in its history, driven by the Bundibugyo variant for which there is no licensed vaccine. Since the emergency was declared in mid-May, confirmed infections exceed 4,200 and deaths approach 1,916. In recent days, about 150 new cases and roughly 50 additional deaths have been reported. The World Health Organization warns transmission remains highly active and accelerating. The epicenter is in Ituri, with spread across five eastern provinces—Ituri, Upper Uele, Tshopo, North Kivu and South Kivu—and more than fifty health zones affected. A major barrier is armed militias’ violence and mass displacement, hindering contact tracing, surveillance, and emergency deployment. With no approved vaccine, response relies on early diagnosis, supportive care, isolation, and international aid urged by Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが史上最悪のエボラ流行に直面：死者1,900人超、感染者4,200人超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、ワクチン未承認・武装勢力による対応阻害など重大な懸念があるため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行で、ワクチン未承認かつ武装勢力の活動により対応が困難。WHO事務局長も国際支援を要請している重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Descartan casos de ébola en el barco interceptado de camino a la capital de RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases ruled out on the intercepted boat bound for Kinshasa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola ruled out on an intercepted 255-passenger boat bound for Kinshasa, after concerns surfaced about a suspected case aboard a vessel sailing from Mongala about 65 km from the capital. Officials say no Ebola cases are detected in Kinshasa after 21–22 days at sea, and seven passengers with symptoms tested negative in laboratories. A passenger who disembarked with fever, diarrhea and vomiting died, but no lab confirmation could be obtained. The boat resumed its voyage once Ebola was excluded. The eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo’s outbreak, declared May 15, is the second-largest by infections and the largest in the DRC, with 1,916 deaths and 4,209 confirmed cases. Uganda declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, CFR 30–50%, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment; transmission via bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の首都に向かっていた拿留船でエボラ感染例は否定される
triage.triage_reason: 船内のエボラ疑い例は否定されたが、記事はDRC東部で進行中の大規模エボラ流行（確定4,209例、死亡1,916例、CFR30-50%）について言及しており、既存の重大な公衆衛生上の脅威が継続しているためフルRRAでの継続評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は船内でのエボラ疑い例が陰性であったという内容だが、背景にあるDRC東部の大規模エボラ流行（史上DRC最大規模、CFR30-50%、承認ワクチン・治療法なし）は依然進行中であり、渡航者を介した拡散リスクが示唆される。ウガンダは7月28日にエボラ終息宣言済みだが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Why Hepatitis A is no longer a simple disease in Kerala
article.articleSummary: Kerala faces explosive Hepatitis A outbreaks with an age shift from children to young adults (roughly 18–40 years accounts for about 90%), accompanied by severe and atypical illness, including prolonged high liver enzymes, immune-mediated extra-hepatic complications, bone marrow suppression, and fulminant hepatitis requiring liver transplantation. Infections concentrate in the Malappuram–Kozhikode belt, a water-borne disease hotspot, prompting calls for universal Hep A vaccination and safe drinking water. Case counts and deaths: as of 30 December 2025, 31,536 cases and 82 deaths; in 2024, 28,412 cases and 96 deaths; in 2026 (year to date), 12,437 cases and 125 deaths, with 69 confirmed HAV deaths. Treatments include plasmapheresis, steroids, and in severe cases liver transplantation; relapsing/cholestatic hepatitis with bilirubin elevations lasting 3–6 months observed. Two Kerala studies (2024–25; 2020–24) link adult infection with immune dysregulation, higher hospitalization (18%), HLH, AKI, pulmonary involvement; adults have 8.4× higher odds of moderate-severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でA型肝炎がもはや「単純な病気」ではなくなった理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」と「異常性」の2つが該当し、成人への感染シフトや重症化・死亡増加が確認されているためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ケララ州マラプラム・コーリコード地域で水系感染由来のA型肝炎が拡大。従来小児中心だった感染が18-40歳の成人に90%シフトし、重症化（肝移植必要例、免疫関連合併症、骨髄抑制等）と死亡者数増加（2025年82人、2024年96人、2026年YTDで125人）が報告されている。国際的拡大の兆候はなく、対象は主にインド国内・ケララ州に限定される。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS recomienda priorizar el estudio de la vacuna contra el ébola 'Ervebo' ante el brote del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO recommends prioritizing the study of the Ebola vaccine 'Ervebo' in light of the Congo outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine (Zaire ebolavirus), should be prioritized for inclusion in a Phase 3 randomized trial to evaluate its efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak. After May 16, when the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, WHO's Technical Advisory Group on prioritization of candidate vaccines reviewed available vaccines and treatments. Earlier guidance restricted Ervebo to research settings to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo; new animal data indicate cross-protection. The report urges immediate Phase 3 testing without prior Phase 2 data, noting no safety concerns if vaccination targets contacts in the outbreak. A Bundibugyo-specific vaccine remains the preferred option, though no candidate data exist yet. If Ervebo proves effective, production and access should be scaled for affected populations.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはコンゴでのエボラ流行に際し、ワクチン『Ervebo』の研究を優先するよう推奨
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行がPHEICと宣言され、WHOがワクチン第3相試験を緊急に推奨していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 本流行はブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによるもので、2026年5月16日にPHEICと宣言されている。既存ワクチン『Ervebo』はザイール株用だが、動物実験でクロス防御の可能性が示され、第3相試験の即時実施が提言されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Transmission Evidence and Diverse Aedes Mosquito Virome Found on
article.articleSummary: Dengue transmission has been documented along the Congo–Angola border, where human and mosquito surveillance found dengue virus circulating in a region with historically limited monitoring. The study confirms circulation of dengue virus serotypes 1–4 and highlights Aedes aegypti as the primary vector, with Aedes albopictus also possible in some settings. The Congo–Angola border is an epidemiological bridge, underscoring how cross-border movement can sustain transmission even when case reporting differs between countries. Researchers used human serology/molecular testing alongside direct detection of viral RNA in mosquitoes, noting that antibodies reflect past exposure while viral RNA signals recent acquisition. A core element was profiling the Aedes virome—the full viral community in mosquitoes, including insect-specific viruses that may influence arbovirus transmission. The findings advocate integrated surveillance combining clinical testing, mosquito sampling, genomic sequencing and environmental monitoring to distinguish local from imported transmission and guide targeted vector control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・アンゴラ国境地帯でデング熱の感染証拠と多様なネッタイシマカウイルス叢が発見される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ・アンゴラ国境地域でのデング熱ウイルスの継続的な循環を示す学術研究であり、急性の集団発生報告ではないが、監視体制が薄い地域での持続的な媒介蚊感染の可能性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（蚊のウイルス叢解析）であり、症例数や死亡者数の報告はない。アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。継続的なサーベイランスの必要性が示唆されているため、続報の有無を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: CKG Digelar di Lapas Cipinang, Upaya Deteksi Dini Penyakit Warga Binaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CKG Held at Cipinang Prison, Early Detection of Inmates' Diseases.
article.articleSummary: On Monday, 10 August 2026, East Jakarta Health Office conducted a Free Health Check Program (CKG) at Cipinang Penitentiary in Jakarta to screen inmates for Tuberculosis (TB) and assess overall health. The integrated CKG-TB screening targets about 1,000 inmates across five locations, with 200 people per site. The operation is led by roughly 20 health workers from the East Jakarta Health Service and Jakarta Timur Suku Dinas Kesehatan, supplemented by nearby clinics and hospitals, for a total of 31 staff. The aim is early detection of potential TB transmission within the high-density prison setting and to ensure inmates receive free health examinations. By combining CKG with TB screening, authorities seek to identify TB hotspots and curb broader transmission in Jakarta Timur.

triage.headline_ja: チピナン刑務所でCKG(無料健康検診)を実施、収容者の疾病早期発見の取り組み
triage.triage_reason: 定期的な結核スクリーニングプログラムの実施報告であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 cases surge nearly 6-fold in Delhi: What causes swine flu, precautions and how to rebuild immunity
article.articleSummary: Delhi's H1N1 influenza cases have surged to 1,344 this season, up from 229 in the same period last year, a near six-fold rise as monsoon drives flu activity in New Delhi. The current wave reflects seasonal influenza; most people recover within about a week, but severe disease can occur in high-risk groups. Fever, body aches, headache and fatigue can overlap with dengue, so prolonged or worsening fever warrants medical care rather than assuming 'just viral fever.' Warned signs include difficulty breathing, chest pain, persistent fever, confusion, severe weakness, dehydration, or a relapse after initial improvement. Preventive measures emphasized: annual seasonal flu vaccination, staying home when ill, improving ventilation, masking in crowds, and strict hand hygiene. The article notes there is no quick immune-boosting remedy; recovery should focus on balanced nutrition and hydration after fever and poor appetite, with protein-rich foods and fluids to support convalescence.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1感染者数が約6倍に急増：豚インフルエンザの原因、予防法、免疫回復について
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1感染者数が前年比約6倍に急増しているが、多くは軽症で季節性インフルエンザの範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）のデリーでの季節的増加を報じる記事で、重症例の多発や国際的拡大の兆候は明示されていない。モンスーン期の毎年の流行パターンとの関連が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le Sud-Kivu totalise 72 jours sans nouveau cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: South Kivu records 72 days without a new case.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) shows a continued lull in South Kivu, with 72 days since a new confirmed case as of the 7 August situation report. Since the declaration of the 17th outbreak, South Kivu has recorded 3 confirmed cases (1 death, 2 recoveries); only the Miti-Murhesa health zone has been affected among 34 zones. The ministry notes transmission is not active in South Kivu, while it remains active in three provinces—North Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Ituri—as the epicenters. Cumulative DRC totals reach 4,209 confirmed cases, 1,916 deaths, and 828 recoveries. South Kivu health authorities say surveillance continues and urge continued adherence to hygiene measures. The 17th Ebola outbreak was officially declared on 15 May.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：南キブ州、新規感染者ゼロが72日間継続
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で継続中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する続報。南キブ州では小康状態だが、北キブ・オートウエレ・イトゥリ州では感染が活発に継続しており、累計感染者4,209人・死亡1,916人と規模が大きく、IHR Annex2の即時通報対象疾患であるため、フルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は南キブ州における小康状態（72日間新規感染なし）を報じるものだが、DRC全体としては北キブ・オートウエレ・イトゥリ州で感染が活発に継続中の第17次アウトブレイクであり、既存の継続監視対象として重要度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ludhiana plans water-based fogging amid monsoon mosquito threat, eyes Rs 1 cr savings
article.articleSummary: Ludhiana's Municipal Corporation plans to use water-based fogging to combat mosquito-borne risk during the monsoon, aiming for about Rs 1 crore annual savings. Stagnant water from monsoon rains across Ludhiana has increased breeding sites; conventional fogging already underway in vulnerable neighborhoods; waterlogging heightens breeding opportunities. Officials say water-based fogging will strengthen control, but MLA Ajay Gupta cautions it cannot be sole solution if stagnant water persists. Public health measures include source control—removing standing water in containers, pots, yards—and residents urged to use repellents, clothing coverage, screens, and regular checks after rainfall. Mosquito-borne diseases such as dengue and malaria are concerns. Symptoms to watch: high fever, severe headache; seek medical advice promptly rather than self-treatment. The plan aims to reduce mosquito populations during monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: ルディヤーナ市、モンスーン期の蚊媒介感染症対策として水性防疫（フォギング）へ移行、年間1000万ルピーの節約見込み
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期の恒例的な蚊対策・防疫活動に関する行政報道であり、具体的な感染者数増加や異常事態の報告はなく、通常の予防的公衆衛生対応の範囲内。
triage.notes: デング熱・マラリアの具体的な発生数や症例報告は記事中になく、モンスーン期の定例的な媒介蚊対策（防疫）に関する行政計画の記事。

article.articleHeadline: Swara Bhasker Hospitalised With Dengue: When Does The Infection Become Severe?
article.articleSummary: Swara Bhasker was hospitalized in Mumbai after testing positive for dengue. Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral infection transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, common in India. It typically starts with sudden high fever and may include severe headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle and joint aches, nausea, vomiting, and rash. Most patients recover with hydration and supportive care, but dengue can progress to severe disease around the time fever subsides. The critical phase lasts about 24–48 hours, during which complications such as plasma leakage, significant bleeding, low blood pressure, organ dysfunction can develop. Warning signs include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, nose or gum bleeding, vomiting blood, blood in stool, rapid breathing, dizziness, cold or pale skin, reduced urine, or a sudden drop in blood pressure. Platelet count alone does not determine severity; clinicians monitor bleeding, BP, fluid balance, and overall condition. Hydration should be guided by medical advice.

triage.headline_ja: スワラ・バスカー氏、デング熱で入院：重症化するのはいつか？
triage.triage_reason: 有名人1名の個別入院に関する健康情報記事であり、デング熱はインドで既知の流行病であるため異常性・公衆衛生上の新規性はなく、社会的関心もセレブニュースの範疇に留まる。
triage.notes: 有名人の個人的な入院に関する記事で、デング熱の症状・重症化サインについての一般的な医療情報記事。集団発生や異常な流行状況を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 太景流感新藥 Pixavir 獲准進行南韓三期臨床試驗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taijing influenza drug Pixavir approved to proceed with Phase III clinical trials in South Korea.
article.articleSummary: Pixavir marboxil (BRC-201), an influenza cap-dependent endonuclease inhibitor developed by Taijing-KY (4157), received South Korea MFDS approval to start a multi-center, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase III trial in adults and adolescents with acute uncomplicated influenza. The IND approval, granted to proceed under the South Korean partnership with Boryung Biopharma, will evaluate efficacy and safety, focusing on time to symptom relief, antiviral activity, clinical recovery, and reduction of influenza-related complications. The program emphasizes a single-dose, complete oral treatment course, addressing adherence challenges associated with multi-day regimens. Taijing notes prior successful Phase III blinded data and上市 experience in Greater China to support safety and efficacy, positioning Pixavir for rapid local execution and expansion in South Korea, and potential growth in the Northeast Asia influenza antiviral market amid shifting seasonal patterns and co-circulating respiratory viruses.

triage.headline_ja: 太景流感新薬Pixavir、韓国での第III相臨床試験実施が承認
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインフルエンザ治療薬の臨床試験承認に関する企業発表であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や感染拡大リスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 対象国（韓国は対象国リスト外、中国は発生地域に含まれるが記事の主題は薬剤の臨床試験承認であり感染症発生ではないため除外）。医薬品開発・治験関連ニュースであり、感染症イベントとしてのシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | CAF C1 : l'APR FC du Rwanda refuse de venir à Kinshasa pour affronter les Aigles du Congo, évoquant Ebola et l'insécurité | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | CAF Champions League: Rwanda's APR FC refuses to come to Kinshasa to face the Congo Eagles, citing Ebola and insecurity | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Rwanda's APR FC refuses to travel to Kinshasa to face the Congo Eagles in the CAF Champions League preliminaries, citing concerns over an Ebola outbreak and security in the Democratic Republic of Congo. After the CAF interclub draw, APR FC coach Abderrahim Taleb announced on Aug 9 that the club would request CAF to stage the two-legged tie at a neutral venue, and that Kigali should host the return leg instead. The Congo Eagles are training in Tanzania and beat Young Africans 2-1 in a friendly at Uhuru Stadium. The first leg is scheduled for early September in Kinshasa (weekend of Sept 4-7, 2026), with the return leg in Rwanda the following weekend (Sept 11-13, 2026). Taleb said they remain focused on preparation while monitoring developments.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース｜CAFチャンピオンズリーグ：ルワンダのAPR FCがエボラと治安悪化を理由にキンシャサ遠征を拒否
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行の存在を背景としたスポーツ関連記事であり、新規の症例数・死亡者数等の公衆衛生情報は含まれていないが、渡航制限に関する社会的影響が示されているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はサッカーチームの渡航拒否であり、DRCでのエボラ流行に関する新規の医学的情報（症例数、死亡者数、発生地域の詳細等）は提供されていない。既存のエボラ流行に対する社会的・経済的影響（国際大会の渡航拒否）を示す事例として続報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: बारिश में बीमारियों का डबल अटैक: वायरल, डेंगू और फ्लू से बचने के लिए अपनाएं ये सावधानियां -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Double Attack of Illnesses During the Rainy Season: Adopt These Precautions to Prevent Viral Infections, Dengue, and Flu
article.articleSummary: During the monsoon in Bhopal, risks rise for viral fever, influenza, dengue, malaria, chikungunya, and gastrointestinal illnesses due to weather changes, waterlogging, increased mosquitoes, and contaminated water. High-risk groups include children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with preexisting conditions. A senior physician explains how early symptoms of cold, flu, viral fever, dengue, and malaria can be distinguished, which signs should not be ignored, and the precautionary measures recommended to prevent infections during the rainy season. The article centers on awareness and timely medical care to manage monsoon illnesses in India, highlighting the importance of recognizing warning symptoms and seeking prompt evaluation to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季における病気のダブル攻撃：ウイルス性感染症、デング熱、インフルエンザを防ぐための注意点
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定の異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性疾患（デング熱、マラリア、インフルエンザ等）の予防啓発を目的とした一般的な健康記事であり、具体的な発生件数や異常な増加を示すデータは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le bateau isolé à 65 km de Kinshasa finalement libéré après
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The boat isolated 65 km from Kinshasa finally released after.
article.articleSummary: On August 10, 2026, Democratic Republic of the Congo Health Minister Roger Kamba announced the release of a boat held about 65 kilometers from Kinshasa on the Congo River after suspicions tied to a death. Seven passengers showing symptoms underwent testing for Ebola; all tests returned negative. The boat was halted and all passengers evaluated; authorities described symptoms as consistent with ordinary illnesses. Despite the clearance, health authorities will maintain intensified river surveillance, establishing a permanent monitoring post around 65 km from Kinshasa to intercept incoming traffic. All downstream boats to Kinshasa will be stopped and passengers screened without exception. A new form for sailors and passengers will be implemented next week, recording departure time, crew/passenger counts, and any health issues relevant to public health. This is intended to bolster surveillance of river traffic bound for Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:キンシャサから65km離れた場所で隔離されていた船が検査後に解放
triage.triage_reason: 船内で疑われた症例のエボラ検査は全員陰性であり、実際のエボラ感染は確認されていない。当局は通常疾患と説明し、監視体制強化のみを実施。
triage.notes: エボラ検査は全て陰性であり、確認された感染事例ではない。DRC当局はコンゴ川沿いの恒久的監視体制を新設し、今後の乗客記録用フォームを導入するなど予防的対応を継続している点は今後の動向として留意。

article.articleHeadline: We prepared for Ebola -- but not this Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugy o ebolavirus, first identified in Uganda in 2007, drives the Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo—the largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history and the second-largest Ebola epidemic on record after 2014–2016 West Africa. Ebola virus disease comprises multiple species; preparedness over the past decade focused on Zaire ebolavirus (EBOV). Early diagnostics lagged as assays optimized for EBOV performed poorly against Bundibugyo, exposing surveillance blind spots. The licensed Ervebo vaccine targets EBOV glycoprotein; WHO advised against routine use for Bundibugyo outside research due to uncertain efficacy. Emerging data hint at partial cross-protection, but not clinically proven. Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are advancing: Oxford/Serum Institute Phase 1 trial and Moderna mRNA candidate; therapeutics for Bundibugyo likewise in development. The crisis underscores the need for cross-species preparedness and pre-crisis evidence to guide policy.

triage.headline_ja: 我々はエボラに備えていた――しかし、このエボラには備えていなかった
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模、記録上2番目に大きいエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ・ウイルス種）であり、既存の診断・ワクチン体制の想定外の限界が露呈しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで発生中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス病流行が主題。ウガンダは同ウイルスが2007年に初めて確認された場所として言及されているのみで、現在の流行地ではない。アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれない。診断アッセイやワクチン（Ervebo）のEBOV種特異性がブンディブギョ種に対して有効性不十分であることが強調されており、対応能力の外部支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: TBC Masih Mengancam Warga Bangka Selatan, Pasien Diminta Tuntaskan Pengobatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis Still Threatens South Bangka Residents, Patients Urged to Complete Treatment
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB), caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, remains a public health concern in Bangka Selatan Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands, Indonesia. Delayed treatment carries a high risk of death, and people with symptoms or risk factors are urged to seek care promptly. TB treatment lasts four to six months and requires strict adherence, with about 70–80% of Bangka Selatan patients cured, leaving 20–30% not fully treated. Stopping therapy early can lead to drug-resistant TB, potentially extending treatment to about nine months. Common symptoms prompting evaluation include a cough lasting more than two weeks, night-time fever, and significant weight loss. Free health screenings at puskesmas under the Cek Kesehatan Gratis program are available. Authorities emphasize rapid case finding to reduce transmission and the importance of completing therapy for diagnosed individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 結核は南バンカ地域住民にとって依然脅威、患者に治療完了を要請
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核に関する定例的な公衆衛生啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルの結核対策・治療完遂を促す通常の公衆衛生広報記事であり、新規のアウトブレイクや異常な事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من خروج "إيبولا" عن السيطرة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Warns Ebola Is Out of Control
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10, the World Health Organization warns Ebola is out of control in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the epicenter in Ituri Province and spread beyond it. Deaths exceed 1,800; 776 recovered; over 220 suspected cases; the true toll may be higher due to cases outside known transmission chains and delays in detection. Dr. Islam Anan attributes the surge to a Bundibugyo Ebola strain with a genetic mutation increasing transmissibility. He notes the old vaccine is ineffective for this outbreak and that unsuited diagnostics and weak health infrastructure in the DRC hinder response, contributing to accelerating spread. Roughly 4,000 infections and over 1,700 deaths have occurred in about eight weeks, implying a case-fatality rate around 44%—far higher than COVID-19’s ~1% CFR. Some projections warn the peak could reach up to 40,000 infections.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱が制御不能と警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株の変異型)が急速に拡大し、致死率約44%、死者1800人超、WHOが制御不能と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 既存ワクチンが無効とされる変異株の出現、診断・医療インフラの脆弱性、致死率約44%という極めて高い数値が報告されており、緊急のリスク評価が必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: DRC releases boat detained over fears of Ebola on board
article.articleSummary: DRC Congo released a boat after fears of Ebola on board proved unfounded. The vessel, detained last week, was initially believed to originate from Kisangani, where Ebola cases have been detected, but health authorities confirmed it actually began in Mongala, a region free of Ebola. A passenger who fell ill on board was disembarked; that person died, but no samples were taken, ruling out Ebola. Two children and another adult died aboard; they tested negative for the virus. Additional passengers showing symptoms were tested and all results were negative. Kinshasa authorities say they will continue to monitor downstream river traffic within 65 kilometers of the capital, with two barges already inspected on Saturday. No Ebola cases detected; monitoring ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラ感染の疑いで拘留していた船を解放
triage.triage_reason: この船自体はエボラ陰性で誤報だったが、記事はキサンガニでエボラ患者が発生している活動的な流行の存在を明らかにしており、河川交通の監視が継続していることから、進行中のアウトブレイクの実態確認のためフルRRAへの移行が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 報道された船内のエボラ疑いは検体未採取または陰性で確定的なエボラ感染は確認されなかったが、キサンガニでのエボラ発生自体は既知の事実として記載されている。この既存アウトブレイクの規模・拡大リスクについては本記事からは不明であり、続報および既存のDRCエボラ流行に関する情報を併せて評価する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Warga Penderita Tuberkulosis Diharap Berobat untuk Cegah Penularan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis Patients Urged to Seek Treatment to Prevent Transmission.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) screening under Jakarta North City's public health drive targets Kalibaru, Cilincing, North Jakarta. The Active Case Finding (ACF) program, linked to Kampung Siaga TB, screens residents with household or close contact to TB patients. At Kalibaru Auxiliary Health Center, 100 residents participated in free TB screening on August 6, conducted in RW 010. In addition to testing, participants received education on TB symptoms, the importance of early diagnosis, and treatment adherence if diagnosed positive, with emphasis on preventing transmission to family and surrounding communities. Officials say early detection is crucial to interrupt transmission and to enable prompt treatment. The effort aims to extend screening to all neighborhood units (RW) across Kalibaru. Success depends on collaboration among government, health workers, cadres, and residents.

triage.headline_ja: 結核患者は感染予防のため治療を受けるよう促される
triage.triage_reason: 地域の日常的な結核スクリーニング活動に関する報道であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・社会的関心の高まりを示す要素は見られない。
triage.notes: ジャカルタ北部での通常の結核アクティブケースファインディング（ACF）プログラムの実施報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 29.376 Warga Binaan-Petugas Lapas Sudah Ikuti CKG dan Skrining TBC Sejak Juni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 29,376 Inmates and Prison Staff Have Participated in CKG and TB Screening Since June
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Directorate General of Corrections reports that the Free Health Check (CKG) and tuberculosis (TB) screening program in prisons began on June 29, 2026. As of August 10, 2026, chest X-ray screening has been completed for 29,376 individuals: 26,910 inmates and 2,466 prison staff, at Lapas Cipinang in Jakarta. Nationally, the program targets 272,573 inmates and 48,876 staff across 532 prisons. Implemented as a Presidential Quick Win with cross-ministry cooperation (Health Ministry, Dinas Kesehatan, Suku Dinas Kesehatan, and PUskesmas), the effort continues beyond screening to treatment for identified cases. TB-positive individuals will undergo Molecular Rapid Testing (Tes Cepat Molekuler, TCM) to confirm diagnosis; positives are isolated in dedicated facilities with attention to nutrition and masking. The government emphasizes equal health rights for inmates and will provide updates as lab results arrive.

triage.headline_ja: 29,376人の被収容者・刑務所職員が6月から無料健康診断(CKG)と結核スクリーニングに参加
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は政府主導の結核スクリーニング事業の進捗報告であり、異常な発生や急増を示す内容ではなく、既存の公衆衛生プログラムの実施状況報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 刑務所内での結核スクリーニング・治療プログラムの進捗報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。政府の既存対策として実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi's H1N1 Cases Have Jumped Nearly 6x: The Flu Symptoms You Shouldn't Ignore This Monsoon
article.articleSummary: Delhi has recorded a nearly six-fold rise in H1N1 influenza cases this monsoon, with 1,344 cases reported so far this season, up from 229 in the same period last year. The surge is being seen across the Delhi–NCR region, as clinicians report more patients with persistent flu-like illness and warn of a lengthier recovery for some, particularly children. Health experts emphasize heightened vigilance for warning signs and timely medical care during this monsoon period. The development signals an ongoing outbreak in the capital and surrounding areas, prompting hospitals and public health authorities to monitor trends closely. No lab-confirmation details or infection sources are provided in the report; the emphasis remains on early recognition, supportive care, and managing vulnerable groups to reduce complications.

triage.headline_ja: デリーのH1N1感染者数が約6倍に増加：この雨季に見逃してはならないインフルエンザ症状
triage.triage_reason: デリーで季節性H1N1インフルエンザの報告数が前年比約6倍に増加しているが、重症度や死亡例の詳細、国際的拡大の兆候はなく、既知の病原体による季節的流行の範囲内と考えられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1の患者数増加報告であり、ラボ確認や重症度の詳細情報が不足している。今後の症例数・重症度の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 台東今年首例境外移入確診登革熱　衛生局完成個案疫調衛教防治 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taitung's first imported dengue fever case of the year; Health Bureau completes epidemiological investigation, health education, and prevention and control for the case | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's first dengue fever import case this year occurred in Taitung County: a man who traveled from Malaysia and the Maldives developed symptoms during travel, and at Taoyuan International Airport his fever prompted a positive dengue antigen rapid test. The Taitung Health Bureau completed case investigation, health education, and prevention measures by August 8. Authorities conducted density surveys within 50 meters of the patient's home and related venues and intensified environmental patrols. Residents were urged to adopt the '巡、倒、清、刷' mosquito-control steps (inspect, dump standing water, clean, scrub) and use DEET-based repellents. As of August 9, 2026, Taiwan reported 119 dengue cases: 7 locally transmitted and 112 imported, with imports from Indonesia 25, Vietnam 23, Maldives 15, Malaysia 12, Philippines 11, Cambodia 9, Thailand 6, India 6, Sri Lanka 4, Singapore 1. Physicians should obtain travel history (TOCC) and perform NS1 testing for suspected cases to prevent community spread.

triage.headline_ja: 台東県で今年初の海外由来デング熱確定症例、衛生局が個案調査と防疫教育を完了
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国外）における単発の輸入デング熱症例で、地元衛生当局が通常の防疫対応を完了している。ベクター媒介感染症としての拡大可能性は否定できないが、現時点で社会的・政治的関心の高まりや深刻な公衆衛生影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（対象国外）における単一の輸入デング熱症例で、輸入元国（インドネシア・ベトナム・マレーシア・フィリピン・タイ・インド等）は感染発生地というより渡航歴に基づく感染源として言及されているため、対象国リストに該当する国での発生イベントとしては確認できず、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taitung's first imported dengue fever case this year; Health Bureau completes case investigation, health education, and prevention and control.

triage.headline_ja: 台東県で今年初の輸入デング熱確定例、衛生局が症例調査・保健教育・防疫対策を完了
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国外）における輸入デング熱の日常的なサーベイランス報告であり、新たな異常事態や大規模流行を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Конго мобилизира 30 000 души в търсене на скрити инфекции от ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo mobilizes 30,000 people in search of undetected Ebola infections.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo accelerates as health authorities expand door-to-door case finding in the hardest-hit areas, shifting from traditional contact tracing. Africa CDC and partners plan to mobilize 25,000–30,000 community health workers for case finding, contact tracing, and community engagement; about 2,000 deployed and 4,000 more planned. Mobile phones and Starlink satellite links are being extended to improve reporting, with a goal to cut the time from symptom onset to case detection to under 72 hours. By Aug 2, 2026, confirmed Ebola cases reached 4,209 with 1,916 deaths (case fatality 45.5%). Signals investigated fell to 68.8%, while over 70% of new infections occur among people not previously identified as contacts; the contact-list now includes ~17,000 versus an estimated 160,000–200,000. Researchers are sequencing Bundibugyo virus to assess mutations that could drive mortality; 743 infected children, 330 deaths, as of Aug 2, with UNICEF reporting >60% of under-5 infections dying.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラの潜在感染者を探すため3万人を動員
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例4,209人・死亡1,916人（致死率45.5%）に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続し、接触者未特定の新規感染が70%超と拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: Africa（大陸）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。

article.articleHeadline: [아주초대석] 박상철 회장 "감염병엔 국경 없어...백신은 한 국가 자산 아닌 세계 인구 지키는 것" | 아주경제
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Aju Spotlight] Chairman Park Sang-cheol: "Infectious diseases know no borders... Vaccines are not the asset of a single country; they protect the global population." | Aju Business Daily
article.articleSummary: Established in 1997 under UNDP in Seoul, the International Vaccine Institute (IVI) is Korea-based and directs vaccine development, testing, and distribution for children in developing countries, with 42 member countries and the WHO. Its hallmark is the affordable oral cholera vaccine, whose technology was transferred to Ubio Biologics in 2010; it has since reached 52 countries with over 240 million doses, and Korea supplies about 80% of global oral cholera vaccines. The typhoid conjugate vaccine, developed with SK bioscience, has WHO PQ and is commercialized. IVI’s current work includes SFTS mRNA vaccines with the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency and Seoul National University; measles–rubella and COVID-19 microneedle patches with QuadMedicine; a hepatitis B microneedle vaccine in Phase 1; AI-guided design for rotavirus and dengue antigens with CreoSgi and POSTECH. Rift Valley fever vaccines are advancing in South Africa; mpox real-world studies are underway in the DRC. IVI emphasizes vaccines as global public goods, requiring sustained international collaboration to strengthen local production, cold chains, and health systems amid shifting infectious-disease landscapes due to climate change and aging.

triage.headline_ja: [아주초대석] 朴相哲会長「感染症に国境はない…ワクチンは一国の資産ではなく世界の人口を守るもの」｜アジュ経済
triage.triage_reason: 国際ワクチン研究所(IVI)の活動紹介記事であり、具体的な感染症の発生・流行を報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての該当性はない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発機関(IVI)のインタビュー記事であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクを報じたものではない。DRCやSouth Africaへの言及はワクチン臨床試験地であり、疾病発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。
