article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Cases Cross 1,300 In Delhi: Is Your Parent Or Child In The H1N1 Danger Zone?
article.articleSummary: Delhi-NCR reports 1,349 H1N1 (swine flu) cases this monsoon season, up from 229 by September last year, with no fatalities reported so far. Hospitals report about 7–10 H1N1 patients daily in OPD, alongside a slight uptick in COVID-19. Most infections are mild and fever typically resolves in 3–5 days; severe outcomes cluster in high-risk groups: elderly, young children, diabetes, hypertension/heart disease, and chronic kidney disease. Monsoon-related temperature dips and damp, crowded indoor spaces are linked to increased spread, with common symptoms including sore throat, nasal discharge, dry cough, and headache. Red flags mandate prompt care: persistent fever or breathing difficulty. Home management includes two-to-three days of isolation and masking around vulnerable family members. Prevention hinges on annual flu vaccination (preferable before/early season), frequent hand-washing, covering coughs, and cleaning surfaces; healthy household members should avoid spreading illness.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1感染者数が1,300人を超える：あなたの親や子供はH1N1の危険地帯にいますか？
triage.triage_reason: デリーでの季節性H1N1（豚インフルエンザ）感染者数増加が報告されているが、死亡例なく大半が軽症であり、モンスーン期の既知の季節パターンとして説明可能なため、フルRRAに進むほどの重大性は認められない。
triage.notes: 前年比で症例数が大幅増加（229→1349）しているが、死亡例なく大半が軽症。モンスーン期特有の季節性インフルエンザ増加として医療者・公衆向けの注意喚起記事であり、新規変異株や異常な重症化の報告はない。続報で重症化率や死亡例の有無を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱疫情升溫 台東首見境外移入病例 衛生局啟動防治措施 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak intensifies; Taitung reports its first imported case; Health Bureau launches prevention and control measures
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak intensifies in Taiwan as Taitung County records its first imported dengue case this year. A man returning from Malaysia and the Maldives developed symptoms and tested positive for dengue at Taoyuan International Airport. The Taitung Health Bureau launched prevention and control measures, conducting mosquito-density surveys and environmental inspections within 50 meters of the patient’s home and activity sites; no community transmission detected yet. As of August 9, national totals reach 119 dengue cases this year, with 7 locally acquired and 112 imported. Imported cases predominantly come from Southeast Asia and other high-risk areas: Indonesia 25, Vietnam 23, Maldives 15, Malaysia 12, and the Philippines 11. Authorities urge travelers to endemic regions to wear protective clothing, use DEET-containing repellents, and residents to perform weekly checks to remove standing water. Seek prompt medical care if fever or other dengue-like symptoms appear and report travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 登革熱疫情升温、台東県で今年初の海外感染例を確認—衛生局が防疫対策を開始
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における登革熱の輸入例報告であり、地域感染は確認されていない。例年見られる季節性の輸入症例報告で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（台東県）における登革熱の輸入症例であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれない。インドネシア・ベトナム・モルディブ・マレーシア・フィリピンは輸入症例の感染国（渡航歴地）として言及されているのみで、これらの国自体でアウトブレイクが発生しているという記述ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。地域感染（コミュニティ感染）は未確認であり、通常の季節性サーベイランス報告と判断。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من خروج "إيبولا" عن السيطرة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of Ebola getting out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating, with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warning of an unprecedented surge in transmission and the outbreak spreading beyond its main epicenter in Ituri Province. As of 10 August 2026, Congo's Ministry of Health reports more than 1,800 deaths and about 776 recoveries, with suspected cases continuing to be reported. The director-general emphasized that containment remains possible only if authorities and partners mobilize a faster, more coordinated response to curb transmission and prevent further escalation. The warning highlights that the outbreak is no longer confined to Ituri and stresses the urgent need for intensified action to stop the spread and protect affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の制御不能化に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が主要発生地を超えて拡大し、1,800人以上の死亡が報告されており、WHOが制御不能化への警戒を発しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長自らが制御不能化のリスクを警告している点で、社会的・政治的関心が非常に高いイベントと判断。フルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 3 Anak Meninggal Suspek Rabies di Buleleng, Cakupan Vaksinasi Anjing Baru 31,91 Persen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Children Die From Suspected Rabies in Buleleng; Dog Vaccination Coverage Is Only 31.91 Percent.
article.articleSummary: Three children in Buleleng Regency, Bali, Indonesia, died of suspected rabies between January and August 9, 2026, after dog bites and without receiving post-bite anti-rabies vaccine (VAR). Victims: 9-year-old KJP (Sawan) bitten by a stray dog; 13-year-old KS (Busungbiu) bitten by a pet dog whose owner killed the animal; 7-year-old GEW (Bubunan, Seririt) bitten in early June, developing hydrophobia, aerophobia, hypersalivation, photophobia, and agitation. GEW was diagnosed suspek rabies at RSUD Tangguwisia, referred to RSUD Buleleng, arriving about 15:30 WITA on Aug 7, 2026, and died two hours later in the ER. In GEW’s case, the local dog was kept by the family and was killed and buried after the bite. The three deaths occur amid 4,927 animal-bite rabies cases in 2026 through Aug 9, with 3,648 patients receiving VAR; dog vaccination coverage in Buleleng is 31.91%.

triage.headline_ja: ブレレン県で狂犬病疑いにより子ども3人死亡、犬のワクチン接種率はわずか31.91%
triage.triage_reason: バリ島ブレレン県で狂犬病疑いによる小児死亡が複数発生し、犬のワクチン接種率が低いことから今後も感染拡大のリスクがあり、地元メディア・行政の関心も高いためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドネシアで既知の流行病だが、犬ワクチン接種率が低く(31.91%)、咬傷後の抗狂犬病ワクチン未接種による死亡例が続いていることから、地域レベルでの対応強化・支援が必要と考えられる。アフガニスタン(Uruzgān)は記事の主題と無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Revue de presse Afrique - À la Une: l'épidémie d'Ebola gagne encore du terrain en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa press review - Front page: the Ebola outbreak is gaining ground again in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) surpasses 4,000 confirmed cases and about 1,850 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. The WHO classifies it as the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine or antiviral exists; two vaccines (Oxford and Moderna) are in Phase I trials, with doses being distributed, though efficacy remains unproven. Ongoing security issues—armed conflict, population displacement, and mistrust—hamper the response, and many new infections occur outside existing contact-tracing networks. Response measures include a 100-bed treatment center in Ituri and strengthened capacity at a center in Nizi. Kinshasa reports no cases; a vessel near the capital was tested after a suspect fever death, all results negative. MSF experts call the outbreak unprecedented in scale.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ・プレスレビュー - 一面：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行がさらに拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で確認例4,000人超・死者約1,850人に達し、WHOが史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行と分類。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、治安悪化・住民移動により対応が難航しており、国際的な支援が必要な深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: キンシャサでは症例なし（船舶検査は陰性）。ワクチンはフェーズI試験段階で有効性未確立。治安・住民移動が接触者追跡を阻害し、既存の追跡網外での新規感染が多発している点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 中国の新型コロナ陽性率22％超 -- 中国メディア
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's COVID-19 positivity rate exceeds 22%
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 positivity rate in China rose to 22.3% in the 31st epidemiological week (July 27–August 2, 2026) based on China CDC’s acute respiratory infection surveillance, surpassing influenza A at 13.3%. Sentinel outpatient respiratory samples from influenza-like illness detected SARS-CoV-2, with no novel pathogens identified. The NB.1.8.1 lineage remains the predominant strain. Regionally, southern provinces show higher positivity than northern areas; the 15–59-year age group has the highest rate. Since January 2023, COVID-19 has been managed as a Category B infectious disease in China, with typically 1–2 waves annually. The current rise is within a cyclical pattern, and the severity is similar to the past two years, with the upward trend already slowing. No significant public health risk or clear impact on healthcare capacity has been observed.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の新型コロナ陽性率22％超 -- 中国メディア
triage.triage_reason: 既知の病原体（既存株NB.1.8.1）による季節性の陽性率上昇であり、新規性・重症度・公衆衛生への重大な影響は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 既存株による周期的な感染拡大であり、新規病原体の検出や医療体制への明確な影響は確認されていない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Only 8% of people in UK check rabies risk before travelling abroad, despite it existing in over 75% of countries
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a global travel health threat, present in more than 150 countries and causing about 59,000 deaths annually. UK and Northern Ireland travellers show a striking underestimation of risk: only 8% check whether rabies is present at a destination, and 26.4% verify vaccination requirements. Nearly half (43%) have travelled to rabies-present destinations in the last five years without verifying risk; in Northern Ireland, 52% have done so, while 70% would delay or avoid seeking medical care after exposure and 70% are unaware that rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms develop. Gaps include 62% not knowing cats or other mammals can transmit rabies, 49% unaware transmission via bite, and 61% unaware of lick/scratch transmission. About 99% of human cases arise from dog bites. A 2025 fatal case in Morocco underscores risk. Campaigns Think Rabies Before You Travel and Mission Rabies promote precautions and dog vaccination in hotspots; cited destinations include Turkey, Morocco, and Thailand.

triage.headline_ja: 英国国民の8%しか海外渡航前に狂犬病リスクを確認していない、狂犬病は75%以上の国に存在するにもかかわらず
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は英国民の狂犬病リスク認識に関する意識調査・啓発キャンペーンの内容であり、特定国における新規の疫学的発生事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はUK/北アイルランドの旅行者を対象とした狂犬病リスク認識に関する調査結果と啓発キャンペーンの紹介であり、トルコ・モロッコ・タイは狂犬病流行国の例示として言及されているのみで、これらの国における具体的な新規発生事象の報告ではない。2025年のモロッコでの死亡例に言及があるが詳細不明。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: 台東今年首例境外移入確診登革熱　衛生局完成個案疫調衛教防治 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taitung's first imported dengue fever case of the year; the Health Bureau has completed the case's epidemiological investigation, health education, and prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s Taitung County reports its first imported dengue fever case of 2026. A traveler returning from Malaysia and the Maldives developed symptoms and tested positive for dengue NS1 at Taoyuan Airport on arrival. The Taitung Health Bureau completed epidemiological investigation, health education, and prevention measures by August 8. Density surveys and environmental checks are under way around the patient’s residence and related sites; residents are urged to enhance anti-mosquito actions, including patrol, discarding standing water, cleaning surroundings, and applying DEET repellents. Taiwan has 119 dengue cases this year, with 7 locally transmitted and 112 imported. Imported cases span Indonesia, Vietnam, Maldives, Malaysia, Philippines, Cambodia, Thailand, India, Sri Lanka, and Singapore. Clinicians should obtain travel history, perform dengue NS1 testing for suspected cases, and promptly report to the Dengue Prevention Center. Sun Guoping, head of Taitung Health Bureau, urges ongoing vector control during summer and the monsoon season.

triage.headline_ja: 台東で今年最初の輸入性デング熱確定例、衛生局が症例の疫学調査・保健教育・防疫対策を完了
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（台東県）における輸入デング熱の単発事例であり、対象国での発生ではない。地域感染例も少数（7例）で、既知の疾患として通常の防疫対応が行われており、公衆衛生上の重大性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾・台東県における輸入デング熱例の報告。感染源としてマレーシア・モルディブ等が言及されているが、実際の発生地（発症・診断）は台湾であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。輸入例の感染源国（ベトナム、タイ、インドネシア、フィリピン、インド等）は台湾国内での輸入症例集計の文脈で言及されているのみで、それら各国での発生イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Вірус міг мутувати: спалах Еболи перевищив 4 тис. хворих
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Virus May Have Mutated: The Ebola Outbreak Surpassed 4,000 Cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus surpassed 4,000 cases, with 3,973 confirmed and 1,801 deaths reported by August 4 and crossing the 4,000 mark by August 6. The flare, officially first detected May 15, is the second-largest in history and may indicate possible mutation; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May. The epicenter is Ituri’s Bunia, a mining region of ongoing conflict, with spread to Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Two-thirds of deaths occur outside hospitals; in the MSF-run Bunia treatment center, 9 of 10 hospitalized patients were not listed as contacts. Contact tracing remains weak (about 10 contacts per case vs ~40 expected). Uganda reports 20 cases but containment is achieved there. UNICEF warns disruption of essential health services; in Mongbwalu, measles vaccination first-dose coverage fell by 69%.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスが変異した可能性：エボラ流行が4千人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行で、死者1800人超・感染4000人超、複数州へ拡大しウガンダにも波及しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。麻疹ワクチン接種率低下など二次的な公衆衛生への影響も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Вирус мог мутировать: вспышка Эболы превысила 4 тыс. больных
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The virus could have mutated: the Ebola outbreak exceeded 4,000 patients.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain has exceeded 4,000 cases, with 3,973 confirmed infections and 1,801 deaths as of August 4; it crossed 4,000 on August 6. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri’s Bunia, with suspected transmission since January, and is the second-largest on record. Africa CDC notes it is eight times more cases and six times more deaths than West Africa’s 2014–2018 epidemic. The epicenter remains Ituri, with spread to Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Upper Uele, and Tshopo. Two-thirds of deaths occur outside hospitals; MSF reports 9 of 10 hospitalized patients at Bunia’s treatment center were not on official contact lists, and average contacts per case are about 10 (vs 40 expected). Uganda reports 20 cases but containment succeeded. WHO declared a PHEIC in May. UNICEF warns of disrupted health services, noting a 69% drop in first-dose measles vaccination in Mongbvale; a death aboard a vessel bound for Kinshasa prompted passenger quarantines.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスが変異した可能性：エボラ出血熱の流行が4千人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）が4,000例・1,800人超の死者を記録し、WHOがPHEICを宣言済みで、ウガンダへの越境例や船上での死亡例もあり国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの20例確認や船上感染例も報告されているが、主要な発生地はDRC。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。麻疹ワクチン接種率の低下も付随的に報告されているが、主イベントはエボラ出血熱。

article.articleHeadline: Dog bites 130 people in four hours in India
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-10, in the Kalyan Adharwadi area of Maharashtra’s KDMC, a stray white dog went on a biting spree, injuring more than 130 people over four hours on Sunday evening. The animal roamed the area before becoming aggressive, according to KDMC officials. All bite victims were rushed to a nearby hospital for anti-rabies vaccination. Dr Sandeep Pagare of KDMC’s Rukminibai Hospital confirmed that 130 dog-bite patients were admitted and given rabies injections after reporting bites from a white dog. A hunt is underway to locate the stray animal.

triage.headline_ja: インドで野犬が4時間に130人に咬みつく
triage.triage_reason: 単発の野犬咬傷事件であり、狂犬病確定例の報告はないが、多数の被害者が発生しており継続的な動向確認が必要。
triage.notes: 咬傷被害者全員に抗狂犬病ワクチンが投与されたとの記載があり、狂犬病発症例の報告は現時点で確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Khẩn cấp cứu bệnh nhân sốt rét ác tính
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emergency treatment for a patient with severe malaria.
article.articleSummary: A 30-year-old man from Can Tho, previously working in Nigeria, presented to Ho Chi Minh City Infectious Diseases Hospital on July 23, 2026 with severe malaria and jaundice. He had fever, chills, and sweating during his return to Vietnam; malaria parasites were detected at a private clinic and later confirmed at the hospital, placing him at imminent risk of death requiring artesunate, a scarce antidote in southern Vietnam. Doctors secured artesunate from Bach Mai Hospital in Hanoi, enabling a rapid cross-city transfer. The hospital’s Social Work department mobilized volunteers to receive the drug in Hanoi and arrange transport via Nội Bài Airport to Tan Son Nhat, with Vietnam Airlines support; pharmacy and clinical teams in Ho Chi Minh City prepared to administer on arrival. This imported malaria case underscores urgent inter-city collaboration to deliver life-saving treatment and avoid fatal outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 重症マラリア患者の緊急救命治療
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア渡航歴のあるベトナム人男性1名の輸入マラリア重症例であり、国内での感染拡大や公衆衛生上の広範な影響を示す情報はない。個別治療事案として位置づけられる。
triage.notes: 輸入例1件の重症マラリアであり、国内医療機関間の薬剤搬送・連携事例を伝える記事。感染症危機管理上のシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Khẩn cấp cứu bệnh nhân sốt rét ác tính trở về từ châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emergency treatment for a patient with severe malaria returning from Africa.
article.articleSummary: Severe malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum with jaundice in a 30-year-old Vietnamese man from Can Tho who had been working in Nigeria returned to Ho Chi Minh City. On 23 July he arrived at the City Hospital for Tropical Diseases in dire condition, requiring intravenous artesunate, but stock in the southern region had run out. The hospital urgently coordinated with Bach Mai Hospital in Hanoi to secure artesunate. A social-work-led logistics effort arranged a volunteer to collect the drug at Bach Mai, and Vietnam Airlines ferried it from Hanoi to Tan Son Nhat Airport, with on-ground pharmacy staff ready to receive. Within two hours the artesunate arrived at the Tropical Diseases Hospital, was administered immediately, and the patient subsequently recovered and stabilized. This case underscores rapid inter-hospital collaboration and the ongoing risk of imported malaria from Africa.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカから帰国した重症マラリア患者の緊急治療
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア帰りのベトナム人男性1名の輸入マラリア症例で、治療により回復・安定化した個別事例であり、公衆衛生上の異常な拡大リスクや流行の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: アフリカ（ナイジェリア）からの輸入マラリア症例で、患者はベトナム・ホーチミン市の病院で治療を受け回復。記事は病院間の薬剤輸送連携（南部でアルテスネート薬剤切れ）に焦点を当てた個別事例報道であり、アウトブレイクや地域流行を示す内容ではない。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo supera los 4.200 casos y alcanza 1.916 fallecimientos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,200 cases and reaches 1,916 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo totals 4,209 confirmed cases and 1,916 deaths (case fatality 45.5%), with 89 new cases and 29 deaths in the last 24 hours. Ituri remains the epicenter (86.5% of cases), reporting 73 of the 89 new cases. The outbreak spans 53 of 140 health zones across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, and South Kivu. Surveillance yields 1,318 alerts, 443 suspected, 305 investigated, and 198 transferred to treatment centers. Contact tracing covers 83.4% (14,923 of 17,896). Lab results: 326 samples tested, 89 positives (27.3%), with Ituri contributing 73 positives. Ituri CT centers hold 840 beds, 595 occupied (69.2%); 85 admissions, 73 discharges (14 cured). North Kivu: 247 admissions, 200 confirmed; Haut-Uele lacks a standardized Ebola treatment center. Ambulances limited; 46 infection-control rings, 31 of 32 sites disinfected; border screening 148,287 travelers (98.2%), with uneven point functionality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、感染者4,200人・死者1,916人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認例4,209人・死者1,916人（致死率45.5%）に達する大規模エボラ流行が5州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率45.5%と極めて高く、Ituri州を中心に53/140保健区に拡大。接触者追跡率83.4%、国境スクリーニング98.2%と対応リソースの限界も報告されており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 石药创新猴痘mRNA疫苗获美国药物临床试验批准
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CSPC Innovation’s Monkeypox mRNA Vaccine Approved for Clinical Trials in the United States
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox vaccine SYS6037 has received U.S. FDA approval to begin clinical trials in the United States. Monkeypox is caused by the Monkeypox virus, an orthopoxvirus. SYS6037 injection is a single-stranded mRNA vaccine encoding multiple antigens for prevention of monkeypox infection. It is developed by CSPC Innovation (石药创新) through its subsidiary Shiyao Group Giant Stone Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. (巨石生物制药有限公司), in collaboration with the Institute of Microbiology, Chinese Academy of Sciences. The FDA notification confirms clinical-trial authorization, enabling US-based testing. This development highlights collaboration between a Chinese pharmaceutical entity and a national research institute to advance a monkeypox vaccination candidate. Source: Beijing Business Daily; published 2026-08-10.

triage.headline_ja: 石薬創新のサル痘mRNAワクチン、米国での臨床試験承認を取得
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン開発・臨床試験承認に関する報道であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発企業（中国のCSPC/巨石生物）による米国での臨床試験承認に関する内容であり、実際のMpox感染発生を報じるものではないため、対象国での発生事例として扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: ನಾಗಲಾಪುರ:ಸಾಂಕ್ರಾಮಿಕ ರೋಗದ ಭೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗ್ರಾಮಸ್ಥರು ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳು ಬಗೆಹರಿಸದಿದ್ದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿಭಟನೆ :ಉಮೇಶ್ ಮುದ್ನಾಳ - Sanjevani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nagalapur: In fear of a contagious disease, villagers protest if their problems are not resolved: Umesh Mudnal - Sanjevani
article.articleSummary: As of 10 August 2026, Nagalapur village in Saidapur region faces severe sanitation neglect: no proper sewerage, open drains, stagnant wastewater on roads, and potholes, with women lacking adequate toilets. Mosquito breeding in collected rainwater has heightened fears of dengue and malaria among residents. Local activist and All India Koli Society state secretary Umesh K. Mudnal warned that unless authorities address drainage, sanitation, and road infrastructure, villagers will protest by blocking roads. He and others cited repeated appeals to officials, calling for immediate sanitation drives, construction of drains, and concrete roads (CC roads), along with essential public facilities. The mobilization includes a large number of villagers, including women, underscoring urgent public health concerns and a demand for timely intervention to prevent disease spread and restore basic infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: ナガラプール:感染症の恐怖に怯える村民、問題が解決されなければ抗議行動へ:ウメーシュ・ムドナル
triage.triage_reason: 実際のデング・マラリア患者発生の報告はなく、衛生環境悪化に対する住民の懸念・抗議表明が主題であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す具体的症例情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の感染症発生の報告ではなく、衛生インフラ不備（排水・道路など）に伴う蚊の発生とデング・マラリアへの住民の懸念・抗議行動を報じたもの。具体的な患者数や症例確認情報は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Cấp tốc đưa thuốc từ Hà Nội vào TP.HCM cứu bệnh nhân sốt rét ác tính
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expedited delivery of medicine from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City to save a patient with severe malaria.
article.articleSummary: On 10 August 2026, Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases saved a man with severe Plasmodium falciparum malaria. The 30-year-old patient from Can Tho had returned from Nigeria three days earlier with fever, chills, and sweating; laboratory confirmation identified P. falciparum. Artesunate, a critical antimalarial, was scarce in the south, prompting an emergency nationwide transfer from Bach Mai Hospital in Hanoi. The hospital’s social-work unit coordinated; a relative collected the drug at Bach Mai, which was then flown to Ho Chi Minh City by Vietnam Airlines, arriving at 21:15 and delivered to the Infectious Diseases department by 22:00. The patient recovered after intensive treatment. Malaria is transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes; travelers returning from Africa should seek medical care for fever promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイからホーチミン市へ薬を緊急輸送し、重症マラリア患者を救命
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア渡航歴のある患者1名の輸入マラリア症例で、治療により回復しており、地域的な流行や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は輸入例1名の治療・薬剤輸送の成功事例を報じるもので、感染拡大や現地流行を示す内容ではない。南部でのアルテスネート不足という医療資源上の課題は今後の動向として注視の価値があるが、単独記事としては見送り相当。

article.articleHeadline: सतना न्यूज: सेंट्रल जेल में हेपेटाइटिस बी-सी से पीडि़त मिले 10 बंदी | 10 inmates in Central Jail found suffering from Hepatitis B and C.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Satna News: 10 inmates in Central Jail found suffering from Hepatitis B and C.
article.articleSummary: Satna, Madhya Pradesh: Ten inmates in Central Jail tested positive for hepatitis B (7 cases) and hepatitis C (3 cases) during a July 27–August 7 screening that also covered Nagod and Maihar sub-jails, with 1,556 inmates screened. All positives are male; Nagod and Maihar reported no cases. The district hospital lists 58 hepatitis patients. For positives, viral load and baseline testing will be performed; samples preserved and sent to an external lab with results in 3–4 days. If viral load exceeds 20,000 copies/mL, treatment will begin; if below, a re-test after six months. Hepatitis refers to liver inflammation caused by five viruses: A, B, C, D, E; acute hepatitis is often HAV-related; chronic forms affect immunity, and HDV can co-infect with HBV while HEV causes hepatitis E. Dr. Pradeep Gautam, nodal officer, says treatment will start if viral load crosses the threshold.

triage.headline_ja: サトナ・ニュース: 中央刑務所で10人の受刑者がB型・C型肝炎に感染していることが判明
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内の定期スクリーニングで発見された既知の血液媒介性肝炎（B型・C型）であり、急性の公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: B型・C型肝炎は主に血液・体液を介して感染し、刑務所内での既存感染者のスクリーニングによる発見であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Swine flu outbreak sweeps through Delhi: Capital logs over 1,300 cases of H1N1 virus - Symptoms, and who is at high risk?
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 1,349 confirmed H1N1 swine flu cases, up from 229 at the same point last season as monsoon conditions promote transmission of Influenza A (H1N1). High-risk groups include children under 5, adults over 65, pregnant women, and people with diabetes, chronic lung or heart disease, or immunosuppression. Symptoms include fever, sore throat, cough, nasal congestion, headache, myalgia, and fatigue; children may have diarrhea or vomiting. Seek care if symptoms persist beyond 3–4 days; emergency signs include difficulty breathing, chest pain, confusion, persistent lethargy, or fever recurrence. No deaths have been reported in Delhi this season; hospitals are prepared, though severe cases could raise hospitalizations. Dengue cases exceed 1,300, complicating diagnosis. Prevention stresses hand hygiene, ventilation, and avoiding close contact. Oseltamivir is most effective within 48 hours for high-risk patients. Seasonal quadrivalent vaccine, updated for circulating strains, is recommended for high-risk groups and takes about two weeks to develop protection.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで豚インフルエンザが拡大：首都でH1N1ウイルスの症例が1,300件を超える－症状と高リスク群について
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1インフルエンザ流行で前年より症例数が増加しているが、死亡例はなく病原体・感染様式に異常性はないため、IHR基準はほぼ該当しない。デング熱との重複流行による医療現場の負荷は注視すべき点。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）とデング熱の同時流行がデリーで報告されているが、死亡例なく病院は対応可能な状況。モンスーン期の毎年発生するパターンであり、フルRRAの必要性は低いが症例数増加傾向を継続的に観察する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: RDC liberta embarcação retida por suspeitas de Ébola - O País - A verdade como notícia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC frees vessel detained on suspicion of Ebola
article.articleSummary: DRC authorities freed a vessel previously detained over suspected Ebola exposure after clarifying its origin. Initially believed to have departed Kisangani, where Ebola cases were detected, the boat actually left Mongala province, which has no recorded cases. A passenger with Ebola-like symptoms disembarked and died, but no sample was collected to confirm or exclude the virus. Three other people died aboard; Ebola tests were negative. Other symptomatic passengers were tested as well, with no positive results. Despite the release, health authorities will maintain river surveillance within 65 km of Kinshasa for boats heading toward the capital; two barges had already been inspected on Saturday. Monitoring continues as of 10 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラ感染疑いで抑留されていた船舶を解放
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中とみられるエボラ出血熱の発生（キサンガニでの症例確認）に関連し、船上での死亡例や渡航制限措置（船舶抑留・河川監視）が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はキサンガニで確認されたエボラ症例を背景とした船舶検疫措置に関するもの。船上死亡者のエボラ検査は一部未実施・一部陰性だが、DRC国内でのエボラ流行継続が示唆されており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Podcast JR 15 Min #1482 | Bronquiolite e vírus respiratórios: o alerta dos pediatras
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Podcast JR 15 Min #1482 | Bronchiolitis and Respiratory Viruses: The Pediatricians' Warning
article.articleSummary: Brazilian pediatric respiratory illnesses surged before winter, with hospitalizations of infants for these conditions rising nearly 200% from February to May 2025, according to a Sociedade Brasileira de Pediatria survey. Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), responsible for the majority of bronchiolitis cases, is circulating strongly during this period and can cause serious complications in children under one year old. The JR 15 Minutos podcast features pediatric infectious disease specialist Renato Kfouri, secretary of the Immunizations Department at the Brazilian Society of Pediatrics, discussing implications for prevention and care. The report highlights bronchiolitis and other viral respiratory infections in the Brazilian pediatric population, underscoring the ongoing risk to infants as RSV activity remains elevated and winter approaches.

triage.headline_ja: ポッドキャストJR 15分 #1482 | 細気管支炎と呼吸器ウイルス：小児科医からの警告
triage.triage_reason: RSVによる乳幼児の細気管支炎は季節性の既知の現象であり、通常予想される範囲内の公衆衛生上の話題であるため、シグナルとしての新規性・異常性は低い。
triage.notes: RSVは季節性呼吸器感染症であり、ブラジルにおける冬季前の流行は既知のパターン。ポッドキャスト形式の一般向け情報提供記事であり、突発的な異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: സ്വരാ ഭാസ്കറിന് ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി; പനി കുറയുമ്പോഴും വേണം ജാഗ്രത, അറിയാം ഡെങ്കിയുടെ ലക്ഷണങ്ങളും പ്രതിരോധവും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swara Bhaskar has dengue fever; even as the fever subsides, vigilance is needed; dengue symptoms and prevention.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, a mosquito-borne illness, is discussed in relation to Bollywood star Swara Bhaskar, who says she is undergoing treatment after contracting the disease. Transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes that typically bite by day, dengue symptoms usually appear 3–14 days after infection and can progress to severe disease if not treated. Early signs include sudden high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle and joint pains, and a red rash on the chest and face, with nausea and vomiting. Warning signs requiring urgent care—persistent vomiting, abdominal pain, bleeding, dark stools, sudden breathing difficulties, pale/clammy skin, faintness, or a sharp drop in blood pressure—warrant immediate hospital attention. Treatment centers on rapid care; patients should rest and stay hydrated with fluids such as salted rice-water and other beverages, continuing observation for 3–4 days after fever subsides to prevent complications.

triage.headline_ja: スワラ・バースカルがデング熱に感染；解熱後も要注意、デング熱の症状と予防法について
triage.triage_reason: 有名人個人の罹患を起点としたデング熱の症状・予防に関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団発生を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は個人の罹患報告とデング熱の一般的な予防・症状情報にとどまり、地域的な集団発生やアウトブレイクの報告はない。有名人が話題性を持つのみで、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết chuyển nặng sau những dấu hiệu tưởng chừng hồi phục
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever worsens after signs that seemed to be recovering.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Hanoi, Vietnam: a 43-year-old man experienced four days of high fever with chills and myalgia. Initially managed as outpatient; by day 4 persistent fever, nausea and vomiting developed. Thrombocytopenia emerged (platelets 55 G/L); Dengue NS1 antigen was positive, CRP elevated, and mild transaminase rise (AST 61 U/L). He was hospitalized for observation and treatment. An initial abdominal ultrasound was normal, but within three days free fluid appeared in the peritoneal cavity and right pleural space, indicating plasma leakage. By day 10, dengue with ongoing fever and liver enzyme elevation persisted. Treatment included fluids/electrolytes, fever care, vitamin C, hepatoprotectives, and a platelet transfusion. Clinicians highlight that dengue's critical phase (days 3–7) can progress even without obvious bleeding or high fever. Emphasizes follow-up testing during days 3–7, regional seasonal patterns in Vietnam, four dengue serotypes, and vaccination with Qdenga (two doses, 3 months apart). Also promotes mosquito control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 回復したように見えた兆候の後、デング熱が重症化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで流行しているデング熱の単一重症例に関する臨床経過の啓発記事であり、異常な集団発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にSFTS Virusが含まれるが記事サマリー内に言及がなく、デング熱の単一臨床例報告と判断。ベトナムでデング熱は季節性の流行病であり、本記事は臨床啓発目的の内容。

article.articleHeadline: He works to slow the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history -- like many others, without pay
article.articleSummary: In eastern Congo's Ituri province, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak—the fastest-growing on record—has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases and more than 1,800 deaths, with Ituri accounting for about 90% of cases. Declared in mid-May, the outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo virus, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Front-line workers, including Wiza Bondele, 29, an infection-control worker at a Bunia hospital, continue to work amid strikes protesting months of unpaid salaries (roughly $510 monthly promised). Some payments have been made electronically, but many are partial or delayed, undermining morale. The response is challenged by armed conflict and misinformation, with clinics attacked and trust eroding. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids. Officials say the payment backlog is being cleared, but the situation remains urgent.

triage.headline_ja: 彼は無給のまま、史上最速で拡大するコンゴのエボラ流行を食い止めるために働いている
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で発生中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行は史上最速の拡大速度で4000例超・死者1800人超に達し、承認されたワクチン・治療薬がなく、武装勢力の攻撃や医療従事者の未払い賃金によるストライキが対応を阻害しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョウイルス種による流行であり、武装勢力による攻撃や誤情報、医療従事者への未払い賃金問題が対応を著しく阻害している点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Sebelum Gigit Bocah 7 Tahun hingga Akhirnya Meninggal, Anjing di Bubunan Buleleng Serang 6 Warga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog in Bubunan, Buleleng Attacks 6 Residents, Including a 7-Year-Old Boy Who Later Died
article.articleSummary: Rabies case in Bubunan, Seririt, Buleleng, Bali, Indonesia, caused the death of seven-year-old Gede EWP after a stray dog that had previously bitten six residents also bit him. The six prior victims were aged 65, 60, 42, 41, 41 and 35; they reported bites to the village and received rabies vaccination (VAR) at Puskesmas Seririt. Gede EWP’s bite was not reported at the time. The stray dog, which hid in a warehouse, was later killed by the boy’s father. In June 2026, Dinas PKPP Buleleng conducted a mass vaccination of about 430 dogs in Bubunan to curb transmission. This fatal rabies case underscores ongoing public health measures in Bali, including vaccination campaigns and wound management, following dog-bite incidents.

triage.headline_ja: バリ島ブレレン、ブブナンの犬が6人の住民を襲撃、その後7歳の少年を咬み死亡させる
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡例が発生しているが、バリでは既知の流行地域であり異常性は低く、地域的なワクチン接種対応で管理されているためPICKUPには至らない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はバリで既知の風土病であり、地元保健当局（Puskesmas、Dinas PKPP Buleleng）がワクチン接種・咬傷対応を実施中。ヒト-ヒト感染や国際拡大の懸念はない単発の死亡事例。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma segundo caso de gripe aviária do ano em ave encontrada no Ibirapuera
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms second avian influenza case of the year in a bird found at Ibirapuera Park
article.articleSummary: Second confirmed case of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) in São Paulo state in 2026, detected in a wild bird found at Ibirapuera Park, São Paulo. The infected species is the Black-bellied Whistling Duck (Dendrocygna viduata); the bird was not park-resident. Confirmation came from the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense after isolation and clinical assessment. Authorities deem the event isolated, with no link to commercial poultry or meat/egg production. No commercial poultry operations within 10 kilometers of the find site. Epidemiological surveillance will be conducted in the region, and residents will receive sanitary guidance. No human infections have been reported, and exports of poultry products remain unaffected; Brazil's sanitary status with the OIE is unchanged. First 2026 case, July 15, also in a wild whistling duck, was rescued in an urban area and sent to a zoo in Guaíra near Barretos, with surveillance at three farms, two in sanitary fallow.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、イビラプエラ公園で発見された鳥から今年2例目の鳥インフルエンザ感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: 野鳥（渡り鴨）における孤発例で、家禽産業や人への感染との関連はなく、当局も孤立事例と判断しており、貿易・輸出への影響もないため。
triage.notes: 野鳥での孤発例。商業養鶏場との接点なし、ヒト感染報告なし、OIEステータスも変更なし。ルーティンサーベイランスの一環と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 300 enfants tués, l'ONU sonne l'alarme sur une crise sanitaire d'envergure
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 300 children killed, the UN warns of a health crisis of major proportions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has recorded over 4,000 cases and 1,850 deaths as of 2026-08-10. More than 300 children have died, representing about a quarter of confirmed cases and a third of deaths. Health services are strained as fear of infection reduces care-seeking, with usage down over 40% in recent months. In Ituri, maternal deaths have nearly doubled, with about six women dying weekly from delivery complications; Ebola during pregnancy carries a high risk of fetal loss. The WHO is intensifying its response, and an advisory group recommends quickly launching a clinical trial in DRC to evaluate Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine. 13,000 community health workers with authorities, WHO, CDC Africa and UNICEF have reached 2.4 million people and conducted over 500,000 home visits to counter misinformation and promote early detection. The UN calls for sustained mobilization to curb spread and protect vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：子ども300人死亡、国連が大規模な健康危機を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続し4,000例超・死者1,850人に達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHO、CDC Africa、UNICEFなど国際機関が対応を強化しており、既に既知の大規模アウトブレイクの継続報告。フルRRAでの詳細評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: PH bans livestock imports from 7 nations over FMD - PortCalls Asia
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10, the Philippines imposed a temporary ban on importing live animals and selected animal products from seven economies due to confirmed foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) cases. The affected countries are Azerbaijan, Bahrain, Cyprus, Iraq, Israel, Kuwait, and Palestine, with FMD virus serotype SAT1 outbreaks validated through WOAH reference labs after FAO confirmation. Under Department Circular No. 39 by Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr., entry of live swine, cattle, water buffaloes and other FMD-susceptible animals, plus fresh skeletal muscle meat, casings, tallow, hooves, horns and animal semen from the affected areas, is prohibited. The aim is to shield the domestic livestock sector, food security and farmer livelihoods. Prohibited shipments at ports will be seized. WOAH-classified safe commodities may still enter under strict rules, including ultra-high-temperature milk/dairy, heat-treated canned meat, protein meal, gelatin, and certain processed hides/leather, with veterinary certification.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン、口蹄疫を理由に7カ国からの家畜輸入を禁止 - PortCalls Asia
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）は動物のみに影響する疾患であり、実際の発生国（アゼルバイジャン、バーレーン、キプロス、イラク、イスラエル、クウェート、パレスチナ）は対象国リストに含まれない。フィリピンは輸入禁止措置を取っているだけで自国内での発生ではない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは動物疾患（口蹄疫）であり、ヒトの健康リスクは確認されていない。発生地域として挙げられた国々（中東・コーカサス地域）はいずれも対象国リストに含まれず、フィリピンは輸入規制措置を取っているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وباء إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 4120 إصابة و1887 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 4,120 cases and 1,887 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 4,120 confirmed cases and 1,887 deaths. Health authorities report intensified surveillance, expanded contact tracing, and strengthened preventive and therapeutic measures in affected areas to curb transmission. Ebola is a highly dangerous viral disease that spreads primarily through direct contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person. The update emphasizes that rapid detection, isolation of cases, and prompt provision of medical care are among the most important steps to limit spread and reduce fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、感染者4,120人・死者1,887人に増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で4,120例・死亡1,887例（致死率約46%）に達する大規模エボラ出血熱流行であり、IHR基準の重大性・異常性に該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約45.8%と高く、当局が監視強化・接触者追跡拡大を実施中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の有無については記事に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi Flu Update: मामूली जुकाम या H1N1 स्वाइन फ्लू? डॉक्टर से समझें लक्षणों में अंतर और सही इलाज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Delhi Flu Update: Mild Cold or H1N1 Swine Flu? Consult a Doctor to Understand the Difference in Symptoms and the Correct Treatment.
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 1,349 confirmed H1N1 influenza A cases in 2026 as of August 6, with rising hospitalizations and some ICU admissions, signaling potential pneumonia and respiratory distress. H1N1 symptoms include abrupt high fever, chills, headache, body aches, fatigue, plus nasal congestion, cough, and sore throat; children may experience nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. Unlike common colds, influenza often has more severe, sudden onset. After exposure, symptoms typically appear in 2–3 days, with recovery around 3–5 days in many cases. Diagnosis is via PCR testing of nasal or throat swabs. Treatment may involve antiviral oseltamivir (Tamiflu); antibiotics are reserved for secondary bacterial infections. At-risk groups include young children, the elderly, pregnant women, and individuals with asthma/COPD, heart disease, diabetes, or obesity. Prevention includes masks in crowds, hand hygiene, and avoiding close contact; seek prompt care for persistent fever, breathing difficulties, chest tightness, or low oxygen saturation.

triage.headline_ja: デリー・フルーアップデート：軽い風邪かH1N1豚インフルエンザか？医師が症状の違いと正しい治療法を解説
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1季節性インフルエンザの症例数増加と入院・ICU入室が報告されているが、季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは現時点で不明。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザ株であり、既存の医療体制で管理可能とみられる。症例数・重症度の推移を継続的に確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: В ВОЗ оценили ситуацию с Эболой в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO assessed the Ebola situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: By August 10, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed nearly 2,000 people and infected over 4,000 within the first three months. Mohammed Janabi, WHO Regional Director for Africa, described the situation as dire during an online press briefing. He noted that 60–70% of fatalities occurred at home, underscoring barriers to timely medical care. The report highlights ongoing transmission in the DRC and calls for continued public information efforts to encourage people to seek care promptly. The online briefing was conducted for journalists in Geneva. The report is part of a WHO assessment of the Ebola situation in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の状況を評価
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で3か月間に感染者4000人超・死者約2000人という大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態としてIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ジュネーブは記者会見の開催地であり、発生国はコンゴ民主共和国のみと判断。致死率が高く（死者約2000人/感染者4000人超）、家庭内死亡率60-70%と医療アクセスの障壁が指摘されており、continued transmissionとWHOの国際的な関与から高リスクと評価。

article.articleHeadline: Congo continúa aplicando medidas de prevención contra ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo continues to implement preventive measures against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Republic of the Congo continues preventive measures against Ebola as the neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a rising outbreak. From May 15, when Ebola was declared an epidemic in the DRC, to August 7 the outbreak affected 53 health zones across Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uélé, with 4,209 confirmed cases and 1,916 deaths; 828 recovered and 595 isolated or hospitalized. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. The WHO has begun vaccine candidate trials in DRC but recommends testing Ervebo—the only approved Ebola vaccine—due to lack of a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine. Early animal data suggest Ervebo may offer some protection against Bundibugyo with no major safety concerns. In Congo, the Ministry of Public Health, supported by the WHO, is inspecting border areas and running technical advisory programs to strengthen entry-point surveillance and prevent cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ出血熱に対する予防措置を継続
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認済み感染者4,209人・死者1,916人に達する大規模なエボラ出血熱流行が継続しており、承認ワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による国際的拡大リスクが高いため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ共和国（ブラザビル）の予防措置について述べているが、実際の流行発生国はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であり、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当する。コンゴ共和国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi Swine Flu Update: H1N1 Cases Spike Beyond 1,300 With Recent Deaths
article.articleSummary: Delhi swine flu (H1N1) outbreak: 1,344 H1N1 cases reported in Delhi-NCR this season, up from 229 at the same point last year, signaling spread across Delhi, Gurgaon, and Faridabad. Hospitals in Delhi-NCR report impact; a child nearly four years old died at BLK-Max Hospital due to severe complications, breaking a multi-year Delhi record of zero H1N1 deaths from 2020 through Sept 2025, despite 3,151 cases in 2024 with no fatalities. India typically experiences two seasonal peaks (Jan–Mar and Aug–Oct), though timing varies by state; urban and peri-urban areas are most affected, with outbreaks in closed populations. Transmission is via airborne droplets; communicability 3–5 days in adults, up to 7 days in young children; peak viral shedding on day 1. Mild cases may not require Oseltamivir, but high fever/severe symptoms or high-risk patients may need antiviral treatment and home isolation, with 24–48 hour reassessment.

triage.headline_ja: デリーのインフルエンザ最新情報:H1N1症例が1,300人を超え、最近死亡例も発生
triage.triage_reason: デリーNCRでのH1N1症例数が前年の約6倍に急増し、2020年以降ゼロだった死亡例（幼児）が発生するなど、異常な増加と重篤な転帰が確認されたためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の症例数急増および多年ぶりの死亡例発生が報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなし。地域医療体系での対応可否について追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Pasaman Barat perkuat kolaborasi percepat eliminasi TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The West Pasaman Regency Government strengthens collaboration to accelerate TB elimination.
article.articleSummary: West Pasaman Regency, West Sumatra, Indonesia, intensifies cross-sector collaboration to accelerate tuberculosis (TB) elimination through Public Private Mix (PPM) and expands Tuberculosis Preventive Therapy (TPT) and a TB Regional Action Plan (RAD). Regional Secretary Doddy San Ismail stated the effort unites public health facilities and private providers, the Health Office, hospitals, community health centers (puskesmas), and stakeholders, with a focus on effective communication, information, and education (KIE) to communities. TB treatment lasts at least six months, requiring patient adherence and ongoing family-contact screening with prophylaxis to prevent transmission. Challenges include diverse social and cultural contexts; education strategies must be tailored accordingly. Smoking, low health awareness, and HIV co-infection increase complication risk. Referencing Presidential Regulation 67 of 2021, Indonesia targets TB elimination by 2030. The West Pasaman Regency Government calls for stronger synergy among government, health facilities, and stakeholders to implement PPM, broaden TPT, and ensure RAD TB is measurable and sustainable.

triage.headline_ja: 西パサマン県政府、TB撲滅の加速に向けて連携を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核の通常の対策強化・行政連携に関する報道であり、異常な増加や新規性はなく、フルRRAに進む必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 結核撲滅に向けた行政の取り組みに関する定例的な報道であり、緊急性のある感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le bateau isolé pour suspicion d'Ebola libéré, tests négatifs
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Boat isolated on suspicion of Ebola released; tests negative.
article.articleSummary: Approximately 200 passengers on a boat quarantined at Maluku, 65 km from Kinshasa, were tested after a suspected Ebola-related death; tests for the Bundibugyo strain were negative, including seven symptomatic individuals. Investigations traced the vessel’s route to Mongala province, not Kisangani as initially reported; Mongala is not affected by the current outbreak. Congolese authorities announced a permanent control system for ships descending the Congo River to prevent spread to Kinshasa. The Democratic Republic of the Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, declared May 15 in Ituri, eastern DRC, has 4,000 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths (case fatality rate around 45%). No infections were detected among the passengers, and the boat was released.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ疑いで隔離されていた船が解放、検査結果は陰性
triage.triage_reason: 当該船の検査は陰性だったが、記事内で言及されているDRCの第17次エボラ流行（確定4,000例、死亡1,850例、致死率約45%）は重大な公衆衛生上の懸念であり、河川交通を介した拡大リスクも指摘されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 報告された船内の疑い例は検査で陰性となり収束したが、背景にある第17次エボラ流行（イトゥリ州発、致死率約45%）は継続中であり、コンゴ川を介したキンシャサへの拡大防止のため恒久的な監視体制が導入された点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: US imposes new Ebola travel curbs -- RT Africa
article.articleSummary: US imposes Ebola travel curbs as of 2026-08-10: Americans returning from DR Congo within 21 days before departure may not board US-bound flights, including itineraries with a stopover in DR Congo. Those affected should remain outside the US until 21 days have elapsed since leaving DR Congo. Americans returning from Uganda and South Sudan may fly home but must route through Dulles, ATL, IAH, or JFK for CDC screening (travel and symptom questions, temperature checks, and observation). Canada bans foreign nationals recently in DR Congo; Israel, Qatar, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Rwanda have entry/visa restrictions; Uganda has suspended flights and cross-border transport with DR Congo. Russia heightens border controls. The outbreak in DR Congo (May 15) is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola; no approved vaccines or targeted treatments. Congolese Health Ministry: 4,209 cases, 1,916 deaths (CFR 45.5%), up from 3,674/1,621; 53 health zones across five provinces (up from 49).

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱に関する新たな渡航制限を実施 -- RT Africa
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が拡大しており（4,209症例、死亡1,916人、CFR45.5%）、複数国が渡航制限・出入国管理強化を実施していることから、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として直ちにフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で発生しているエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行拡大であり、米国・カナダ・イスラエル・カタール・クウェート・サウジアラビア・UAE・ルワンダ・ウガンダ・ロシアなど多数の国が渡航・出入国制限を課している。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみで、他国は流行発生地ではなく対応措置を取っている側であるため除外した。承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法がなく致死率45.5%と高い点、複数国が渡航制限を発動している点から国際的緊急性が高いイベントと判断。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ сообщила о смерти 2 тыс. человек от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reported 2,000 deaths from Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed nearly 2,000 people and infected over 4,000 within three months, according to World Health Organization Africa regional director Mohammed Janabi. About 60–70% of deaths occurred at home, highlighting the need for urgent public messaging to seek medical care. End-July official counts reported 960 deaths, but WHO says the true scale is likely undercounted by several times. The article notes concerns about underreporting and stresses improved surveillance and response. The Foreign Ministry announced plans to deploy domestic vaccines to protect against the virus. As of August 10, 2026, the situation remains dire with ongoing transmission and high mortality outside healthcare facilities.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱による2000人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で3か月間に4000人以上が感染し約2000人が死亡する大規模なエボラ流行が発生しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、WHOによる注視など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 公式集計（960人死亡、7月末時点）とWHO推定（約2000人死亡、4000人以上感染）に大きな差があり、報告体制の不備が疑われる。死亡の60-70%が医療機関外で発生しており、地域社会への浸透と対応の遅れが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: O explicável surto de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Explainable Outbreak of Measles
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak with 20 confirmed cases in São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. Brazil, formerly endemic-free since November 2024, now faces an active outbreak; genotyping confirms the circulating virus is imported. Koplik spots precede the rash; symptoms include high fever, dry cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and photophobia, with a rash starting on the face and behind the ears. Severe complications include pneumonia, acute otitis media with potential permanent hearing loss, and encephalitis. Vaccination gaps in the capital show first-dose coverage 77.5% and booster coverage 65.5% for the trivalent vaccine, versus the 95% target. Health authorities recommend vaccinating individuals aged 6 months to 59 years to achieve herd protection and prevent reestablishment of endemic transmission; ongoing surveillance and vaccination campaigns are underway.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹アウトブレイクの説明可能な発生
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは2024年11月以来麻疹排除状態にあったが、輸入株による活動性のアウトブレイクが発生し、ワクチン接種率の低さ（1回目77.5%、2回目65.5%）により地域内流行再確立のリスクがあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 麻疹はブラジルのサンパウロ市を中心に確認され、輸入株によるアウトブレイクで、以前の排除ステータスが崩れた点が重要。ワクチン接種率の目標未達（95%目標に対し77.5%/65.5%）が感染拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: उल्हासनगरात डेंग्यूचे ३० संशयित रुग्ण सापडल्याने आरोग्य विभाग सतर्क
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Ulhasnagar, 30 suspected dengue patients found; health department on alert.
article.articleSummary: Thirty suspected dengue cases detected in Ulhasnagar from private labs, prompting an alert by the Ulhasnagar Municipal Corporation health department. The city is also monitoring malaria, chikungunya, typhoid, and diarrheal diseases. The uptick correlates with rain-induced water stagnation due to open sewers, potholes, and poor drainage. Health-chairperson Savita Torane-Ragde led a review with medical health officer Satyam Gupta, directing immediate expanded inspections across the city. Door-to-door checks will target standing water around homes, open water containers, pots, discarded tires, and similar breeding sites; a broader sanitation drive and awareness campaign will be intensified. Citizens are urged to participate: ensure no stagnant water near residences, maintain a dry day weekly, and seek prompt medical care for fever or dengue-like symptoms rather than self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: ウルハースナガルでデング熱疑い患者30人確認、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱疑い例増加に対する地方自治体の通常警戒対応であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られないが、雨季の蚊媒介感染症拡大の可能性があるため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 疑い例30名で確定診断は不明。地方自治体（Ulhasnagar Municipal Corporation）が主体的に対応しており、季節性・地域限定的な事案。マラリア・チクングニア・腸チフス・下痢症も併せて監視されている。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 Varian Baru PQ.16.1.1 Merebak di Hong Kong, Waspadai Gejalanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 New Variant PQ.16.1.1 Spreading in Hong Kong, Watch for Its Symptoms.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Hong Kong rises as positivity reaches 9.79% amid spread of Omicron subvariants NB.1.8.1 and the newly identified PQ.16.1.1. Health authorities identify 45 adult cases in the past month, with seven deaths in that period. Most infections are mild, presenting influenza-like symptoms such as fever, sore throat, and cough. Prof. Ivan Hung Fan-ngai of the University of Hong Kong notes that older adults, those with chronic illnesses, infants, and the unvaccinated face higher risk for severe disease. The Center for Health Protection stresses that current vaccines remain effective against these subvariants. With vaccine stock projected to expire in September, authorities urge those not yet vaccinated or due for a booster in six months to seek vaccination promptly, as pediatric vaccines are expected to be ready only in Q4. Timely vaccination is key to maintaining protection and reducing fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: 香港でCOVID-19新変異株PQ.16.1.1が拡大、症状に注意を
triage.triage_reason: 香港でCOVID-19新変異株が確認され死亡例もあるが、大部分が軽症でワクチンも有効とされ、現時点で国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の事例であり、対象国リストのChina(1814991)に含めて評価。新変異株の出現自体は珍しくなく、現状はCHPによる通常監視の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 4,2 тысячи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,200.
article.articleSummary: As of August 10, 2026, confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 4,209, with 1,916 deaths. The outbreak spans 53 medical zones across five provinces, with Ituri province remaining the epicenter, accounting for about 86.5% of cases. WHO regional director Mohammed Janabi described the situation as 'bad' and urged intensified public information campaigns and timely medical care for those ill. The Congo-Uganda Ebola outbreak was designated a public health emergency of international concern by WHO on May 17, with regional risk considered high. The figures were reported by ATS citing the DRC Ministry of Health. Health authorities continue to monitor and coordinate response across affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ確定症例が4,200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、感染者4,209人・死者1,916人と深刻な公衆衛生への影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として言及されているが、記事の主題は主にDRCの症例数報告であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言し、地域リスクは高いとされている。

article.articleHeadline: Около 2 тыс. человек умерли в Конго из-за лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Approximately 2,000 people died in Congo due to Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has killed nearly 2,000 people and infected over 4,000 within three months of its start, according to WHO Africa Regional Director Mohammed Djanabi on August 10, 2026. He noted the situation is bad, with 60–70% of deaths occurring at home, underscoring delays in seeking care. The briefing urges continued public messaging on timely medical help. Bloomberg's July 27 assessment cited by the article suggests this outbreak could become the second-largest in history, with cases surpassing 3,200 and Ebola deaths in a two-week period reaching about 1,405. Context also references commentary about conflict in the region hindering response and mentions Russian assistance to curb cross-border Ebola importation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ熱により約2000人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（感染者4000人超、死者約2000人）で、史上2番目の規模になる可能性が指摘されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの大規模エボラ流行を主題としており、越境リスクへの言及もあるが具体的な他国感染事例は明記されていない。地域紛争が対応を妨げているとの言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: ಚಂಡಿಪುರ ವೈರಸ್ ಪ್ರತಿ ಮಳೆಗಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಮರಳುವುದೇಕೆ? ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಅಪಾಯ ತಡೆಯುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ? | Why Chandipura virus returns every monsoon and why children face the highest risk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why does Chandipura virus return every monsoon? How to prevent danger to children?
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus resurges during the monsoon in western and central India, notably Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Andhra Pradesh, with deaths among children. CHPV infection begins with fever and quickly progresses to encephalitis syndrome (AES), causing severe brain inflammation; without timely care, deterioration can occur within 24–48 hours, leading to unconsciousness or death. Transmission by sandflies; hot, humid, unsanitary environments and nearby livestock elevate breeding and exposure. Children under 15 are disproportionately affected due to developing immunity, outdoor exposure, malnutrition, crowding, and limited health access. Early signs include fever with vomiting or severe headache; worsening drowsiness, confusion, or seizures require urgent care. No licensed vaccine or antiviral exists; management is supportive with early detection. Prevention: long-sleeved clothing in evenings, insecticide-treated nets, repellents, sanitation, repairing walls, and removing breeding habitats. A Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre–NVI study identifies three existing drugs for repurposing, but animal studies and trials are pending.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルスはなぜ毎年雨季に再来するのか？子供への危険を防ぐには？
triage.triage_reason: 毎年雨季に発生する既知のチャンディプラウイルス（脳炎症候群）に関する解説記事で、新たな異常発生や国際的拡大の兆候は明確でないが、小児の重症化・死亡例があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はチャンディプラウイルスの季節的再発と予防策に関する解説記事であり、新規大規模発生を報告するものではない。既存の医薬品転用研究（グジャラート・バイオテクノロジー研究センター）も言及されているが動物試験・臨床試験は未実施。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak may have begun in February: WHO regional chief
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak may have begun in February, according to genetic sequencing cited by WHO Africa Regional Director Mohamed Yakub Janabi, suggesting Bundibugyo virus circulated for months before detection. The Ebola outbreak was officially declared in the DRC on May 15. Bunia, capital of eastern Ituri Province, is the epicenter. As of August 7, local authorities report 4,209 confirmed cases and 1,916 deaths, underscoring an ongoing outbreak. The sequencing findings highlight a longer period of undetected transmission and the critical role of genomic surveillance in outbreak assessment and response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、2月に始まっていた可能性:WHOアフリカ地域責任者
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認4,209例・死亡1,916例に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、数か月間検知されずに拡大していたことが判明。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHOアフリカ地域責任者による公式発言であり信頼性が高い。致死率が約45%と非常に高く、既にフルRRAの対象となっている可能性が高い。継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 20個月大男嬰感染甲型流感危殆　私家診所求醫期間抽搐　轉送急症室 (19:18) - 20260810
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 20-month-old boy infected with influenza A in critical condition; had a seizure while seeking treatment at a private clinic; transferred to the emergency department (19:18) - 2026-08-10.
article.articleSummary: As of 10 August 2026, Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection reports a single case of Influenza A in a previously healthy 20-month-old boy, who is critically ill with septic shock. Fever began on 7 August; on 8 August he had a seizure at a private clinic and was transferred to Queen Elizabeth Hospital Emergency Department, then admitted to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit after showing hypotension. Respiratory testing confirmed Influenza A. The patient had not received the 2025/26 seasonal flu vaccine and had no travel during incubation. One household contact developed upper respiratory symptoms and tested positive for influenza by rapid antigen test, but remained mild and recovered without hospitalization. CHP will continue investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 生後20ヶ月の男児がA型インフルエンザに感染し重篤化、私設診療所受診中に痙攣発作、救急室へ転送 (2026年8月10日)
triage.triage_reason: 季節性A型インフルエンザの単発重症例であり、家庭内接触者は軽症で回復。異常株の証拠や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、重症度のみがWPRO基準に該当するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 香港での季節性インフルエンザA型による単発重症例。ウイルス亜型（例:H1N1/H3N2等）の詳細不明。家庭内接触者は軽症で回復しており、二次感染の広がりは限定的とみられる。CHPが継続調査中。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 20個月大男嬰染甲流併發敗血性休克　情況危殆留醫PICU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 20-month-old boy infected with H1N1 influenza, complicated by septic shock; in critical condition and admitted to the PICU.
article.articleSummary: 20-month-old boy in Hong Kong diagnosed with influenza A (H1N1), complicated by septic shock and in critical condition in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit at Queen Elizabeth Hospital. Onset last Friday with fever; by Saturday he presented with convulsions and, with low blood pressure, was admitted to the PICU. Respiratory sample confirmed influenza A infection; clinical diagnosis influenza A with septic shock. The child had no prior known health issues and did not receive last year’s seasonal flu vaccine; no travel during the incubation period. A household contact recently developed upper respiratory symptoms and tested positive for influenza by rapid antigen test but had a mild course and recovered. The Centre for Health Protection is investigating. As of 2026-08-10, seven severe pediatric influenza cases have been reported in Hong Kong, including one death, with activity expected to stay high in the coming weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 20か月の男児がA型インフルエンザ(H1N1)に感染、敗血性ショックを併発し重篤な状態でPICUに入院
triage.triage_reason: 個別重症小児例だが季節性インフルエンザの範囲内であり、香港では既に7例の重症小児例（1名死亡）が報告されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないが、活動高止まりが予想されるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の事例のためChinaに分類。季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の重症小児例で、家庭内感染のクラスターも確認されているが規模は限定的。衛生防護中心が調査中。

article.articleHeadline: 东西问丨孙兆彬：气候变暖加剧 全球传染病传播风险大幅攀升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East-West Q&A | Sun Zhaobin: Climate warming intensifies the global transmission risk of infectious diseases, rising sharply.
article.articleSummary: Climate warming accelerates mosquito development and pathogen replication, raising global transmission risk of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika, and expanding Lyme disease and fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome to higher latitudes and elevations. Heavy rainfall and floods create mosquito breeding sites and contaminate water, fueling cholera and typhoid outbreaks; drought drives water storage that creates artificial breeding habitats. Forest degradation and wildlife migration heighten hantavirus and Ebola spillover risks, while northward movement of freshwater snails suggests schistosomiasis spread. Seasonal influenza patterns may shift with temperature, humidity, and rainfall, altering aerosol survival and indoor transmission. Sri Lanka reports a direct dengue-climate link. WHO and One Health approaches guide surveillance; China advances climate-health action plans and machine-learning–based predictive tools. Public guidance urges heed meteorological alerts, reduce outdoor activity in heat, strong mosquito control, water safety after floods, safe food, and low-carbon living with masking for air pollution.

triage.headline_ja: 東西問丨孫兆彬：気候温暖化の激化により、世界的な感染症の伝播リスクが大幅に上昇
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は気候変動と感染症リスクの関係性についての専門家インタビュー・解説記事であり、特定の国・地域における具体的な発生イベントを報じたものではないため、シグナルとして扱う対象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動が複数の感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、ジカ熱、ライム病、SFTS、コレラ、腸チフス、ハンタウイルス、エボラ、住血吸虫症、季節性インフルエンザ）の伝播リスクに与える一般的影響を論じる解説記事。スリランカのデング熱と気候の関連性に触れているが対象国リストに含まれず、中国についても具体的な発生事例ではなく政策・研究動向の紹介のため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo em São Paulo: 75% dos doentes não tomaram vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in São Paulo: 75% of patients did not get vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo state, Brazil: 23 confirmed cases in 2026, with 16 patients unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Cases reported in the capital São Paulo, São Bernardo do Campo, and Guarulhos. Of the 23, two are imported and the remainder linked to importation, though the exact source of infection remains unknown. In response, the state health secretariat SES-SP launched a Multivaccination Campaign, running through September 1 across 645 municipalities. The campaign offers universal measles vaccination using the MMR vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella) to residents aged 6 months to 59 years in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, regardless of prior vaccination status. The outbreak is characterized by a transmission chain associated with importation.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの麻疹：患者の75%がワクチン未接種
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で輸入関連の麻疹アウトブレイク（23例、大半が未接種）が発生し、州保健当局が大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始しており、行政の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 輸入関連の麻疹アウトブレイクで、サンパウロ州が9月1日まで645市町村でMMRワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施中。重症例・死亡の報告はなく、国外支援の必要性は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Análise | Risco que se repete: assim como o zika, vírus oropouche pode afetar cérebro de bebês em gestação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Analysis | The recurring risk: as with Zika, Oropouche virus can affect the brains of fetuses during gestation.
article.articleSummary: Oropouche virus has expanded its circulation in Brazil, with nearly 14,000 confirmed cases in 2024 and elevated counts into 2025, now circulating across all five regions. The expansion accompanies reports of vertical transmission, abortions, fetal deaths, and congenital malformations including microcephaly in pregnancies with infection. To study brain impact, researchers used human cerebral organoids—mini-brains—derived from stem cells. Infections used two lineages: BeAn19991 (Amazonas, 1960) and RJ/LVM-2024 (Rio de Janeiro, 2024) with a rearranged genome. Across both, 657 genes were differential expressed: downregulation of neural progenitor proliferation and upregulation of inflammatory, replication, and cell-death pathways. Organoids showed reduced growth, irregular borders, and disorganization, especially in ventricular zones where progenitors proliferate; Ki67 and PAX6 declined. Neurons and astrocytes were later infected. Similar neurotoxic effects across strains suggest inherent neurotropism, not a recent evolution.

triage.headline_ja: 分析｜繰り返されるリスク：ジカ熱と同様、オロプーシェウイルスは妊娠中の胎児の脳に影響を与える可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: オロプーシェウイルスがブラジル全土に拡大しており、垢直感染・胎児死亡・小頭症などの先天性異常が確認されている点で公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事象と判断される。
triage.notes: 本記事は研究解析記事だが、既知のオロプーシェウイルス感染拡大（2024年以降、ブラジル全域で拡大）と先天性障害リスクを扱っており、公衆衛生上の重要性からPICKUPと判断。国際的拡大の有無は本記事内では明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 20個月大男嬰感染甲型流感　情況危殆
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 20-month-old boy infected with influenza A in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: 20-month-old boy in Hong Kong is critically ill with influenza A and septic shock. He developed fever last Friday, was taken to a private clinic, then rushed to Queen Elizabeth Hospital after a seizure; he was hypotensive and respiratory samples tested positive for influenza A. He remains hospitalized in critical condition. He had not received last year’s seasonal flu vaccine and had no travel during the incubation period. A household contact recently developed mild upper respiratory symptoms and tested positive for influenza by rapid antigen test. Since late June, seven severe pediatric influenza cases have been recorded in Hong Kong, including one death; activity is expected to remain high in coming weeks. The government has completed procurement for the 2026/27 seasonal influenza vaccination programme and is preparing vaccination arrangements, urging schools, parents and childcare centers to participate in school outreach vaccination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 20カ月大の男児がA型インフルエンザに感染　重篤な状態
