article.articleHeadline: 30 Suspected Dengue Cases Reported in Ulhasnagar; Health Department on Alert
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10, Ulhasnagar reports 30 suspected dengue cases under observation amid monsoon conditions. Dengue is transmitted by the bite of infected Aedes mosquitoes, which breed in stagnant water; authorities warn that water accumulation in residential and public spaces can elevate transmission risk. The health department has stepped up surveillance, convened a review of communicable diseases, and instructed field teams to strengthen preventive measures and monitor areas with suspected cases. Public health actions focus on mosquito-control measures and resident awareness to prevent breeding and infection. With the 30 suspected cases under observation, officials are expected to intensify prevention efforts to contain potential spread. No laboratory-confirmed cases are reported in the article; no information on imported or exported cases is provided.

triage.headline_ja: ウルハスナガルでデング熱疑い例30件を報告、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域でデング熱疑い例が報告されているが、検査確定例はなく、季節性の流行対応の範囲内であり社会的関心の高まりも明確でないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節性のデング熱疑い例であり、検査確定例の情報なし。ウルハスナガル市（マハーラーシュトラ州）での地域的な発生。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола меняет правила: почему вспышка в ДРК с вирусом Бундибуйо застала мир врасплох
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Changes the Rules: Why the Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the DRC caught the world off guard
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), marks the 17th Ebola event, confirmed on 15 May 2026 after laboratory testing. The epicenter is Ituri, where mining-driven population movement accelerates spread; as of the announcement, 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths. The Bundibugyo virus has previously caused local outbreaks in Uganda and the DRC; it is less virulent than the Zaïre ebolavirus (Zaire) strain that fueled the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic but remains highly transmissible between people. No vaccines or specific therapies for this strain are widely deployed, and population immunity is effectively absent. With no licensed treatments, clinicians rely on supportive care and symptom management. Contact tracing and isolation remain primary controls but are challenged by mobility and limited infrastructure. Lessons emphasize parallel development of vaccines/diagnostics for all Ebolavirus species, rapid diagnostics deployment, and modular, adaptable treatment protocols for emerging strains, guiding global health security preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがルールを変える：DRCでのブンディブギョウイルスによるアウトブレイクはなぜ世界を驚かせたのか
triage.triage_reason: DRCでブンディブギョウ株エボラの新規アウトブレイクが確認され、246例の疑い例と80人の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブギョウ株エボラのDRC・イトゥリ州での新規アウトブレイクを主題としている。ウガンダ・アンゴラは過去の流行歴として言及されているのみで、今回の発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC and WHO say faster and community led action is needed to contain Ebola in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo requires faster, community-led action, say Africa CDC and WHO after a 4–5 August joint mission to Uganda and eastern DRC. In DR Congo, 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases, 1,801 deaths and 776 recoveries across 51 health zones in five provinces were recorded as of 4 August 2026; 99 new cases and 52 deaths in the latest 24-hour period. Ituri Province accounts for about 90% of cases, with Bunia, Rwampara and Mongbwalu among the most affected zones. Operational challenges include only 75% contact follow-up (target 95%), 674 people in care, and North Kivu treatment-centre occupancy at 139%. The mission stressed community engagement, reliable local information, better access to testing and treatment, and early symptom reporting. Calls include earlier detection, expanded testing, laboratory and ambulance capacity, stronger facility infection prevention, frontline worker support, and rapid donor funding. Uganda’s outbreak ended July 28 (20 cases, 2 deaths) with complete follow-up; cross-border coordination remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCとWHO、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ制圧にはより迅速でコミュニティ主導の対応が必要と発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認済み症例3,973例・死者1,801人に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続し、国際機関の合同ミッションが対応強化を要請しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行は7月28日に終息（20例、死亡2例）と報告。ルワンダ（Kigali Province）は発生地域リストに含まれるが対象国リストに該当せず、記事の主題もDRCであるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Meningite meningocócica na infância: entenda a doença e a importância da prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal meningitis in childhood: understand the disease and the importance of prevention.
article.articleSummary: As of September 2025, Brazil recorded 696 meningococcal meningitis cases and 131 deaths, following 1,551 cases and 333 deaths in 2023–2024 (monthly averages rising from 60 to 68). Neisseria meningitidis serogroups A, B, C, W, and Y circulate in Brazil with regional variation; serogroup B is among the most common. The disease progresses rapidly, often within 12–24 hours, potentially causing meningitis or septicemia, with about 40% of survivors experiencing sequelae such as deafness, amputations, or neurological impairment. Vaccination is the main preventive strategy: meningococcal C protects only serogroup C; ACWY covers A, C, W, Y; B targets serogroup B. Public health programs offer vaccines C and ACWY; private networks also provide B. Additional measures include hand hygiene, covering coughs, ventilation, and avoiding crowding. Early diagnosis and treatment markedly reduce mortality (Brazil’s fatality reached 22% in 2024).

triage.headline_ja: 小児期の髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎：疾患の理解と予防の重要性
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルにおける髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の統計・予防啓発を目的とした一般的解説記事であり、新規の異常発生やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は疫学統計とワクチン接種の重要性を説明する予防啓発コンテンツであり、突発的なアウトブレイクの報告ではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Infosalus.- El ECDC notifica cerca de 220.000 casos de chikungunya y...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infosalus - The ECDC reports around 220,000 chikungunya cases and ...
article.articleSummary: ECDC’s update through Aug 5, 2026 reports 219,522 chikungunya cases and 81 deaths across 25 non-EU/EEA countries. July had 6,746 cases and 4 deaths, down from June's 41,959 cases and 23 deaths. Twelve countries have active outbreaks, mainly in the Americas, with 173,655 cases and 9 deaths this year. Brazil leads in case numbers; other affected countries include Argentina, Bolivia, Colombia, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Paraguay and Venezuela. In Europe, France is the only country with local transmission so far in 2026 (seven cases). Chikungunya is not endemic in continental EU/EEA; most cases are travel-associated, but viremic travelers can seed local transmission where Aedes albopictus is present. Asia records 45,435 cases and no deaths (India highest); China 88, Pakistan 28; Philippines 84 in two outbreaks. Africa ~432 cases, no deaths; Mauritius has the most in 2026, with East Africa affected.

triage.headline_ja: インフォサルス - ECDCがEU域外で約22万件のチクングニア熱症例と81人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: ECDC報告によりブラジル、インド、フィリピン、中国を含む多数の国・地域でチクングニア熱の症例が継続的に発生し、国際的拡大が確認されているためIHR基準（重大な影響・国際的拡大）を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: ECDCの定期サーベイランス報告で、南米（ブラジル中心）、アジア（インド中心）、フィリピン、中国等で症例が確認されている。ヨーロッパではフランスで局地的伝播が報告されているが、対象国リストには含まれない。アフリカではモーリシャスが最多だが対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : l'épidémie pourrait avoir commencé dès février, selon un responsable de l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: the outbreak could have started as early as February, according to a WHO official.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may have begun as early as February, months before its official May 15 declaration, according to genomic sequencing analyses cited by WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Yakub Janabi. In Bunia, the Ituri province epicenter, he said sequences indicate the virus circulated for several months prior to detection. The DRC reported the Bundibugyo strain as the outbreak cause, declared May 15. As of Friday, health authorities listed 4,209 confirmed cases and 1,916 deaths. The Ituri capital Bunia remains the epicenter, with officials noting that delayed detection allowed the virus to gain ground. Ongoing response focuses on containment to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国/エボラ：WHO関係者によると流行は2月には既に始まっていた可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認例4,209人・死者1,916人に達する大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続中であり、検出の遅れによる感染拡大も指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く（約45%）、検出遅延により数ヶ月間ウイルスが検知されずに循環していた可能性がWHOにより指摘されている。Ituri州Bunia市が疫病の中心地。

article.articleHeadline: За три месяца с начала эпидемии Эболы в ДР Конго умерли почти 2 тысячи человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In three months since the Ebola outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, nearly 2,000 people have died.
article.articleSummary: Three months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, nearly 2,000 deaths and more than 4,000 infections have been reported, according to Mohammed Janabi, WHO Africa regional director, speaking to reporters on August 10, 2026. The situation is described as poor, with the outbreak intensifying in the country. About 60-70% of fatalities have occurred at home, underscoring the need for ongoing public information about the importance of seeking medical care promptly. The regional director emphasized continued outreach to communities to encourage timely care, aiming to reduce mortality as the outbreak persists. Data reflect figures up to August 10, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行開始から3か月で約2000人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死者約2000人・感染者4000人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大リスクも否定できないためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOアフリカ地域局長が言及しており、致死率の高さと自宅死亡率60-70%という点から医療アクセス・地域社会への浸透に課題があることが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch tả lợn châu Phi diễn biến phức tạp, nguy cơ lây lan cao tại Quảng Ngãi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever outbreak shows complex developments, with a high risk of spread in Quảng Ngãi.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreak in Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam, remains complex. From early 2026 through Aug 4, ASF affected 34 communes/wards, with over 1,600 pigs infected or culled and 95 tons of pork destroyed. From July 1–Aug 4, outbreaks occurred in 19 communes, with more than 1,000 pigs affected. As of Aug 4, 19 communes had not yet passed 21 days since the last case, signaling ongoing transmission. Authorities attribute persistence to a hardy virus in the environment and weather swings that weaken herd immunity; rising live-pork prices have spurred restocking without full biosecurity. A recombinant ASF virus of genotypes I and II was detected, increasing morbidity and complicating control. With pig numbers rising for year-end demand, the risk of spread remains high, prompting enhanced surveillance, warning sampling, stamping-out, vaccination, sanitation, and controls on transport, slaughter, and trade. Farmers are urged to uphold biosecurity and promptly report signs.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱の流行が複雑化、クアンガイ省で拡大リスクが高まる
triage.triage_reason: 遺伝子組換え型（genotype I/II）のアフリカ豚熱ウイルスが検出され、罹患率上昇と防疫の複雑化を招いており、貿易・移動制限措置が既に取られているためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱は人への感染性がないため直接的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、遺伝子組換え株の出現や広範な発生継続、貿易規制の実施など、食料安全保障・経済・バイオセキュリティ上の懸念から継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Infestação do mosquito da dengue diminui em Fortaleza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue-carrying mosquito infestation declines in Fortaleza.
article.articleSummary: Fortaleza, Brazil, saw a 61% drop in neighborhoods at risk for Aedes aegypti infestation in three surveys conducted in 2026, falling from 41 to 16. The third LIRAa (Rapid Index Survey for Aedes aegypti) of the year identifies vector presence across 121 neighborhoods in the capital. Dengue cases remain the primary concern: 519 confirmed dengue cases and six deaths reported in Fortaleza in 2026. Chikungunya accounted for 12 cases, while no Zika cases were recorded. The findings reflect an ongoing arbovirus risk despite improvements in vector risk classification, signaling continued need for surveillance and vector control in key areas as the 2026 season progresses.

triage.headline_ja: フォルタレザでデング熱媒介蚊の発生率が減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱媒介蚊の感染指数は改善傾向にあり、症例数も特に急増や異常な状況を示していない定例的なサーベイランス報告であるため。

article.articleHeadline: За 3 месяца в ДР Конго от лихорадки Эбола умерли почти две тысячи человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In three months in DR Congo, almost two thousand people died from Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Three months into an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, nearly 2,000 deaths and over 4,000 infections have been reported. The epidemic is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, which is difficult to test, and vaccines against Bundibugyo are not effective. WHO Africa regional director Mohammed Janabi announced the figures at a briefing, noting the May 17 emergency declaration for Congo and Uganda. A major challenge is public awareness, with about 70% of Ebola deaths occurring at home due to people not seeking care. In Uganda, the outbreak was contained, with the government declaring it ended after 42 days of surveillance following the discharge of the last patient, in late July. Uganda officially confirmed 20 cases: 15 imported from Congo and 5 locally transmitted.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で3か月間にエボラ熱により約2000人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によるDRCでの大規模な死者数（約2000人）・感染者数（4000人超）が報告され、WHOがEmergency宣言を発出しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがある事案であるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既に42日間のサーベイランス後に終息宣言済みであり、現時点の主要な発生地はDRCのみ。ウガンダはBluedotの発生地域には含まれるが、記事の主題は既に終息した過去の輸入例であり対象国リストにも該当しないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo種はワクチン効果が乏しく、家庭内死亡率が高いことから管理面での懸念も強い。

article.articleHeadline: 20個月大男嬰染甲流併發敗血性休克危殆｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 20-month-old boy contracted H1N1 influenza complicated by septic shock in critical condition | METROHK.com.hk
article.articleSummary: An otherwise healthy 20-month-old boy in Hong Kong developed fever on August 7 and was admitted August 8 to Queen Elizabeth Hospital’s Pediatric Intensive Care Unit with septic shock and hypotension. Respiratory tests were positive for influenza A, diagnosed as influenza A with septic shock; he remains in critical condition. He had no travel during the incubation period; a household contact recently had milder flu symptoms and tested positive by rapid antigen. Since late June, CHP reports seven pediatric severe influenza cases, with one death, urging vaccination and good hygiene. Influenza activity is high; last week 9.94% of respiratory samples were influenza positive, and influenza-related hospitalizations were 0.73 per 10,000. Circulating strains are influenza A H3 and H1, each ~45%, with influenza B ~10%; H3 is clade K, circulating globally since last August. WHO recommends 2026/27 Northern Hemisphere vaccine composition; HK has procured vaccines and plans school outreach. Parents should seek urgent care for signs like rapid breathing, cyanosis, altered consciousness, or persistent fever.

triage.headline_ja: 20か月の男児がA型インフルエンザに感染し敗血性ショックを併発、危篤状態｜METROHK.com.hk
triage.triage_reason: 香港での季節性インフルエンザ（A型H3/H1）の重症小児例および死亡例が報告されているが、これは例年の季節性インフルエンザ活動の範囲内であり、新規性・異常性は低いため継続的な動向観察が適切。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H3クレードK、H1、B型混在）の通常のサーベイランス報告に加え、小児重症例7例・死亡1例が含まれる。香港衛生防護中心（CHP）はワクチン接種を推奨し対応中であり、国際的支援は不要と考えられる。
