article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में 6 गुना बढ़े स्वाइन फ्लू के मामले, जानिए H1N1 के लक्षण और कब डॉक्टर के पास जाना चाहिए
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu cases have risen sixfold in Delhi; learn the symptoms of H1N1 and when to see a doctor.
article.articleSummary: Delhi, India: As of August 10, 2026, swine flu (H1N1 influenza A) cases have surged sixfold in Delhi, with more than 1,300 cases reported, up from about 239 by this time last year. The illness begins like a cold but rapid fever accompanies systemic symptoms. Typical signs include sudden fever, headaches, sore throat, fatigue, body and muscle pains, and a dry, severe cough that may persist two weeks or longer even after other symptoms ease. Shortness of breath or chest tightness may indicate serious complications such as pneumonia, especially in those with preexisting heart, lung, kidney, liver, or metabolic conditions. High-risk groups include pregnant women, children under five, and the elderly. Do not self-diagnose; rest, stay hydrated, avoid spreading infection, and seek medical care if breathing difficulties arise or symptoms worsen or recur after improvement.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでインフルエンザA(H1N1)（豚インフルエンザ）の症例が6倍に増加、症状と受診の目安について
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1症例が前年比6倍に増加しているが、重症度・死亡数・医療機関の対応状況など詳細情報が不足しており、季節性インフルエンザの範囲内である可能性が高いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとしてインド国内で毎年報告されており、既知の病原体であるため国際的な異常性は低いが、症例数の急増（6倍）は監視継続に値する。重症度・死亡率に関する記述がなく評価不能。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento de infecções por HIV acende alerta para a prevenção - Conexão Tocantins - Portal de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in HIV infections raises awareness about prevention - Conexão Tocantins - News Portal
article.articleSummary: UNAIDS Global Report 2026 highlights an uptick in new HIV infections in Latin America from 2010 to 2025, contrasting with declines elsewhere, despite four decades of progress including expanded antiretroviral therapy and improved prevention. In Brazil, rising incidence translates into ongoing healthcare challenges, with 2023 recording 38,222 new infections and 2024: 39,216. Expert Iangla Damasceno of the Hospital of Tropical Diseases, UFNT/HU Brazil, stresses access to PrEP and PEP, available through the SUS after clinical evaluation. In Tocantins, PrEP/PEP are dispensed at five units in Palmas, Araguaína, Porto Nacional, Gurupi, and Paraíso. Early diagnosis via testing—recommended periodically for sexually active individuals every three to six months and after risk exposure—improves life quality and reduces transmission. Emphasis on information, combating misinformation, and risk perception is essential to curb new infections.

triage.headline_ja: HIV感染の増加が予防への警鐘を鳴らす - Conexão Tocantins - ニュースポータル
triage.triage_reason: HIV感染者数の緩やかな増加傾向を報じる公衆衛生上の啓発記事であり、突発的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、既存の医療体制（SUS、PrEP/PEP提供）で対応中。統計的な増加傾向の報道であり、突発的なアウトブレイクではないためDISMISSと判断。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le bateau isolé pour suspicion d'Ebola libéré, tests négatifs
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Boat isolated on suspicion of Ebola released; tests negative.
article.articleSummary: DRC: A boat isolated at Maluku, 65 kilometers from Kinshasa, on suspicion of Ebola was released after negative tests on about 200 passengers, including seven symptomatic individuals. The vessel originated from Mongala province, not Kisangani. Authorities are implementing permanent river-ship controls along the Congo River to curb potential spread. The Democratic Republic of Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, declared May 15 in Ituri, has reached around 4,000 cases and 1,850 deaths, a case fatality rate of about 45%. Laboratory confirmation showed no Ebola infection among tested passengers, permitting their release; the incident underscores persistent transmission risks and the need for continued river surveillance and port-of-entry checks.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ疑いで隔離された船舶、検査結果陰性のため解放
triage.triage_reason: 当該船舶の検査は陰性だったが、記事はDRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行（約4000例、死亡1850人、致死率約45%）に言及しており、公衆衛生上の重大性と国際的拡散リスクが継続しているためフルRRAでの評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は検査陰性による解放事案だが、背景として進行中のエボラ流行（イトゥリ州発、4000例超、致死率45%）の規模と重大性からPICKUP判定とした。コンゴ河沿いの水上輸送における継続的な感染拡大リスクにも留意。

article.articleHeadline: El ECDC notifica cerca de 220.000 casos de chikungunya y 80 muertes fuera de la UE en lo que va de año
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The ECDC reports nearly 220,000 chikungunya cases and 80 deaths outside the EU so far this year.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya virus disease: 219,522 cases and 81 deaths reported outside the EU/EEA in 2026 across 25 countries, as of Aug 5. July saw 6,746 cases and 4 deaths, with June at 41,959 cases and 23 deaths. Twelve countries have active outbreaks, predominantly in the Americas, totaling 173,655 cases and 9 deaths this year; Brazil has the highest burden, with Argentina, Bolivia, Colombia, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Paraguay, and Venezuela also affected. In Europe, France is the only country with local transmission this year (7 cases); chikungunya is not endemic in continental EU/EEA, and most cases are travel-associated, with potential local spread where Aedes albopictus is present. In Asia, 45,435 cases and zero deaths, led by India; China 88 cases (down from 400 last year), Pakistan 28, and the Philippines reports two outbreaks totaling 84 cases. Africa reports about 432 cases and no deaths, East Africa most affected; Mauritius has the largest 2026 case load.

triage.headline_ja: ECDCが年初来のEU域外でのチクングニア熱約22万件、死亡80人を報告
triage.triage_reason: ECDCによる世界的なチクングニア熱発生状況の定期サーベイランス報告であり、既知の流行病の継続状況を示すもので特段の異常性や新規性は認められないが、複数国での継続的な流行は経過観察に値する。
triage.notes: ECDCによる週次/定期的なグローバルサーベイランス報告。ブラジルが最も感染負荷が高く、アジアではインドが最多、中国・フィリピンでも症例が報告されている。パキスタン・フランス等は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: CHP investigates severe influenza A infection in toddler
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection investigates a severe paediatric influenza A infection in a 20-month-old boy. The child developed fever on 7 August, attended a private clinic on 8 August, then suffered a convulsion and was admitted to the paediatric intensive care unit with septic shock; he remains in critical condition. Preliminary findings show no 2025/26 seasonal influenza vaccination and no travel during incubation; one household contact had mild respiratory symptoms and tested positive by rapid antigen, but recovered. Seven severe paediatric influenza cases have been recorded since late June, with one death. Last week, 9.94% of respiratory specimens were influenza positive; influenza admissions were 0.73 per 10,000. Dominant strains are influenza A(H3) and A(H1), each 45%, with influenza B at 10%. H3 subclade has circulated worldwide since last August; no evidence of greater severity. WHO guides 2026/27 vaccines; HK has procured vaccines and is launching School Outreach Programme. Public urged vigilance and prompt care for deteriorating symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生防護中心（CHP）、幼児の重症A型インフルエンザ感染例を調査
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの重症小児例（ICU入院、敗血症性ショック、直近で7例中1死亡）が続いており、社会的・行政的関心（CHPによる調査）もあるため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心ありの条件を満たす。
triage.notes: 香港における季節性インフルエンザ（A型H3/H1優位）の定期サーベイランス報告。個別の重症小児例が調査対象だが、全体の陽性率・入院率は例年並みで、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは示されていない。今季の重症小児例・死亡例の推移を継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Update: DR Congo Ebola outbreak may have begun in February: WHO regional chief
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus may have begun in February, earlier than the May 15 declaration, per genetic sequencing noted by WHO official in Bunia. As of Aug 7, 4,209 confirmed cases and 1,916 deaths reported across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo; Ituri is epicenter. The outbreak is the 17th in the DRC, largest in the country and second-largest globally after 2014-2016 West Africa. Early cases may have been misattributed to malaria/typhoid, delaying recognition; 60-70% of deaths reported outside treatment centers. On Aug 7, WHO advisory group recommended Ervebo vaccine be prioritized for randomized trial; concerns about cross-protection against Bundibugyo virus. Prior vaccination in North Kivu during 2018-2020 outbreak noted to confer milder disease in infected health workers. Emphasis on community engagement, earlier detection, decentralized treatment to alter trajectory over 8-12 weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 続報：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は2月に始まった可能性－WHO地域責任者
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認4,209例・死亡1,916例に達する大規模エボラ流行（過去最大規模、世界的にも2014-16年西アフリカ流行に次ぐ規模）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリー中には言及がないため除外。DRC国内のイトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、ハウト・ウエレ、チョポ州にわたる大規模流行で、致死率も高く、早期発見の遅れや誤診（マラリア・腸チフスとの混同）が流行拡大の要因とされている。ワクチン（Ervebo）の交差防御に懸念があり、ランダム化試験が推奨されている。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmed Number of Ebola Patients in DRC Exceeds 4,200 - Reports
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo reportedly exceeds 4,200 cases, per the headline. Published 2026-08-10. The body, however, documents a Walvis Bay, Namibia road rehabilitation handover valued at N$132 million for six dilapidated roads spanning about eight kilometres, with senior officials such as Works and Transport Minister Veikko Nekundi, Erongo Governor Natalia Goagoses, Erongo Regional Council Chair Lazarus Kanelombe, Walvis Bay Rural Constituency Councillor Ruben Shikongo, and Walvis Bay Chief Executive Victoria Kapenda in attendance. No clinical details, laboratory confirmations, transmission sources, or outbreak data appear in the text. The article thus presents a mismatch between the Ebola/DRC claim of the headline and the road-project content of the body.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者数、確認済みで4,200人超―報道
triage.triage_reason: 見出しはDRCでのエボラ感染者数4,200人超という重大な内容を主張しているが、本文はナミビア・ウォルビスベイの道路整備事業に関する内容で、臨床データや検査確認、感染経路等の情報が一切なく、見出しの主張を裏付ける情報が確認できないため、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事本文は見出しの内容（DRCのエボラ）と全く無関係なナミビアの道路整備記事であり、見出しと本文の重大な不一致が見られる。DRCでのエボラ感染者数4,200人超という情報は本記事内で裏付けられておらず、他の信頼できる情報源（WHO、DRC保健省等）での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում էբոլայի հաստատված դեպքերի թիվը գերազանցել է 4200-ը
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the number of confirmed Ebola cases has exceeded 4,200.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Ebola has confirmed cases exceeding 4,200, with 1,916 deaths. As of August 10, 4,209 confirmed cases have been reported across five provinces and 53 health zones, with Ituri province as the epicenter, accounting for about 86.5% of cases. The World Health Organization notes the outbreak situation remains 'bad' and urges intensified efforts to inform the public to seek medical care promptly. On May 17, WHO declared the Congo–Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern because of cross-border spread risk. Uganda’s authorities announced on July 28 that its outbreak had ended. Despite that, WHO continues to assess the regional risk of further spread as high.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ確定症例が4,200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行は死者1,916人・症例4,209人に達し、WHOがPHEICを宣言済みで越境拡大リスクも高いことから、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事内で言及されているが流行は終息と報告されており、また対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kalyan's Stray Dog Horror: 130+ People Bitten in Just Four Hours, Caught After 7-Hour Search
article.articleSummary: White stray dog rampage in Adharwadi, Kalyan (KDMC area) on Sunday night left about 130 people bitten over seven hours. The animal was captured around 1:30 am after a KDMC search operation, aided by local corporators, MHB and Khadakpada police. Victims were taken to KDMC’s Rukmini Bai Hospital, where about 130 dog-bite patients received anti-rabies vaccines. Hospital official Dr. Sandeep Pagare confirmed the unusually high turnout and the white dog’s description. The incident prompted a targeted response by KDMC’s stray-dog unit to locate and capture the animal. All reports indicate the bites were attributed to a single white dog near the Sandeep Hotel area. The article emphasizes post-exposure rabies vaccination in the wake of a mass canine attack in the KDMC jurisdiction.

triage.headline_ja: カリヤンの野良犬騒動:わずか4時間で130人以上が咬まれる、7時間の捜索後に捕獲
triage.triage_reason: 単一の野良犬による咬傷事件で全員に抗狂犬病ワクチンが投与されており、現時点で狂犬病発症の報告はないが、多数の咬傷者が出た異常な事例として経過観察が望ましい。
triage.notes: 犬は捕獲され、咬傷者は暴露後ワクチン接種を受けているため、狂犬病発症のリスクは管理されている。狂犬病自体の発生ではなく、単発の大量咬傷事件である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: NanoViricides Has Received Regulatory Approval for a Phase II Clinical Trial of NV-387 Oral Gummies as a Treatment for Ebola in DR Congo To Fight the Current Largest Ever and Expanding Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Regulatory approval from ACOREP in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) enables a Phase II trial of NV-387 Oral Gummies for Ebola caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV). NanoViricides has engaged Om Sai Clinical Research Private Limited as the trial CRO, with a DR Congo team preparing for first dosing. The current BDBV Ebola outbreak in DRC is described as the largest ever in the country: as of August 6, 2026, 4,141 confirmed cases and 1,889 deaths, with 829 recoveries and a crude case-fatality rate of 46%. The outbreak spans at least five provinces, and over 80% of new infections are outside known contact lists, including displacement camps of about 4.4 million people. NV-387 is an orally active antiviral; the Phase II design aims for rapid results in a resource-limited setting, contrasting with ongoing infusion-based trials such as PARTNERS evaluating Remdesivir and MBP-134 antibodies.

triage.headline_ja: ナノヴィリサイズ社、コンゴ民主共和国における現在最大規模かつ拡大中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対する治療薬としてNV-387経口グミ剤の第II相臨床試験の規制当局承認を取得
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）アウトブレイクが進行中で、致死率46%、5州以上に拡大、感染者の80%超が既知の接触者リスト外という制御不能な状況にあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は製薬企業（NanoViricides）の治験承認に関するプレスリリースだが、背景として記載されているDRCのエボラアウトブレイクの規模（史上最大、CFR46%、4.4万人規模の避難民キャンプを含む）が極めて重大であるため、アウトブレイク自体をシグナルとしてPICKUP判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: OMS: el ébola comenzó a circular en la RDC cuatro meses antes de declararse la epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola began circulating in the DRC four months before the outbreak was declared.
article.articleSummary: Ebola began circulating in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo in February, four months before the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, per genetic analysis led by Steve Mundeke Ahuka. WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Yakub Janabi cautioned that the four-month lead of the virus over the response has fueled faster spread, including transmission to neighbouring Uganda. Insecurity in eastern DRC complicates control efforts, and about 70% of deaths occur at home, underscoring the need for greater community engagement. The current outbreak is the second-largest by cases and the largest in the DRC, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak (2,299 deaths, 3,481 cases). It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC with the fastest growth since declaration. Uganda declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from the DRC) and 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain has a 30–50% fatality rate; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱は流行が公式発表される4カ月前から流行し始めていた
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における過去最大級のエボラ流行であり、ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既に7月28日にエボラ終息宣言済みだが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCでの流行は過去最大規模であり、地域の治安不安が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: 香港6月底以來錄得7宗兒童染流感嚴重個案 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong has recorded 7 severe influenza cases in children since the end of June | Telecom
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong has recorded seven severe pediatric influenza cases since late June, including one death. The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a severe case in a 20‑month‑old boy who presented with fever on Aug 7, developed convulsions at a clinic, and was rushed to the emergency department with influenza A complicated by septic shock; he remains in critical condition. Preliminary investigation shows the child had not received last year’s seasonal flu vaccination and had no travel during the incubation period. The centre’s director expects influenza activity to stay high in the coming weeks and urged continued personal and environmental hygiene. Current surveillance shows high influenza activity: last week’s positive rate for influenza in respiratory specimens was 9.94%, and public hospitals’ influenza-related admission rate was 0.73 per 10,000 people. The predominant viruses detected are influenza A (H3) and influenza A (H1); influenza B cases are fewer.

triage.headline_ja: 香港、6月末以降に小児の重症インフルエンザ症例7件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 香港で小児の重症インフルエンザ症例（死亡1例含む）が継続的に報告され、インフルエンザ活動が高水準にあるため、衛生当局が調査・注意喚起を行っており、社会的関心と重症度の観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常サーベイランス報告だが、小児重症例・死亡例の増加とH3N2/H1N1の流行が続いているため、続報や重症化傾向の推移を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: UniKL RCMP deepens Vietnam research ties on infectious diseases - Xpress UniKL
article.articleSummary: Five-day research mobility (16–20 March 2026) at VG-CARE in Hanoi, Vietnam deepened UniKL RCMP’s infectious-disease collaboration. Dr Vignesh Ramachandran, under the UniKL Global Research Mobility Incentive 2026, studied infectious disease research, outbreak preparedness, molecular diagnostics and translational biomedical work. The visit strengthens UniKL’s engagement with the Pan ASEAN Coalition for Epidemic and Outbreak Preparedness (PACE-UP), of which UniKL became an official partner in 2025. Ramachandran gained hands-on exposure to specimen processing, molecular diagnostics, biosafety and lab workflows across microbiology, genetics, mycobacteriology and parasitology, while clinical infectious disease units in Hanoi covered tuberculosis, sepsis, respiratory infections, food-borne infections and hepatitis. Discussions explored bacteriophage research, mobile laboratory deployment, and using patient cohorts and archived specimens for future studies. Anticipated outcomes include DREAM4HEALTH grant progress, new PACE-UP projects, joint publications and supervised PhD work, with WHO-Vietnam alignment and SDGs 3 and 17.

triage.headline_ja: UniKL RCMP、ベトナムとの感染症研究協力関係を深化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は研究者の学術交流・研究協力に関する内容であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は研究機関間の学術連携・人材交流を報じるものであり、特定の感染症流行や公衆衛生事象を報告するものではない。結核・肝炎等は臨床部門で扱われている疾患として言及されているに過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: Pemerintah deteksi dini penyakit tuberkulosis warga binaan lewat CKG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The government conducts early detection of tuberculosis among inmates via CKG.
article.articleSummary: On 10 August 2026, in East Jakarta, Indonesia, the Ministry of Immigration and Public Corrections (Imipas) and the Ministry of Health (Kemenkes) conducted Free Health Checks at Cipinang Penitentiary to enable early detection of tuberculosis among inmates and correctional staff. The initiative aims to enhance TB surveillance within the prison environment, screen residents and personnel, and support timely treatment and containment. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation or case counts, focusing on the launch of the screening activity and inter-ministerial collaboration to address infectious diseases in a closed institutional setting.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、CKGを通じて受刑者の結核を早期発見
triage.triage_reason: 既知の結核に対する定期的な早期検診プログラムの開始を報じたもので、異常な発生や新規感染拡大の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報もない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核検診プログラムの開始を報じる内容であり、症例数や検査結果の詳細は含まれていない。結核は既知の疾患であり、閉鎖施設での通常のスクリーニング活動として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: OMS: el ébola comenzó a circular en la RDC cuatro meses antes de declararse la epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola began circulating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo four months before the outbreak was declared.
article.articleSummary: Ebola began circulating in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo in February, four months before the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, according to WHO. Genetic studies led by Congo's National Public Health Institute's Ahuka indicate circulation since February; WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Yakub Janabi noted the four-month lead means the response lagged behind the virus in Ituri province's Bunia. Transmission is faster than in prior outbreaks; the virus crossed into Uganda, where Ebola-free status was declared on 28 July after 20 confirmed cases, 15 imported from DRC and two deaths. The Bundibugyo strain has a case fatality of 30-50%; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Approximately 70% of patients die at home; communities must be engaged. The current outbreak is the second-largest by infections and the fastest-growing in DRC's history, 17th epidemic, surpassing 2018-2020 outbreak (2,299 deaths, 3,481 cases).

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラはコンゴ民主共和国で流行が公式に宣言される4か月前から既に拡大していた
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ流行はIHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急速拡大、国際的拡大＝ウガンダへの越境）に該当し、WHO自身が対応の遅れを認めている重大事案であるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例が報告されているが、ウガンダ自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療法未承認、致死率30-50%、DRC史上2番目に大きく最速の流行という点で高リスク事案。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола в Конго унесла жизни почти двух тысяч человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo has claimed nearly two thousand lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused nearly 2,000 deaths and over 4,000 cases since the outbreak began, according to World Health Organization Africa regional director Mohammed Janabi. On May 17, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Congo and Uganda. The epidemic is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant; vaccines currently do not protect against this strain, and diagnostic tests are difficult to use for detection. A major information gap is cited, with up to 70% of fatalities occurring at home. In Uganda, authorities halted transmission and declared the outbreak over in late July after 42 days of monitoring following the discharge of the last patient. Uganda confirmed 20 cases: 15 arrivals from Congo and 5 infections acquired in Uganda. Russian officials say the risk of Ebola entering Russia remains minimal, with border controls monitoring all arrivals.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、約2000人の死者を出す
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言したエボラ流行で、死者数約2000人・症例数4000人超と深刻。ワクチンが効かない変異株であることや家庭内死亡率の高さから国際的拡大リスクも高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既に流行終息を宣言済み。ロシアは自国への流入リスクは低いとしているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため対象国リストにも該当せず除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says Congo's Ebola outbreak started months before it was declared
article.articleSummary: WHO says Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo began in February 2026, months before it was officially declared on May 15. Sequencing data cited by WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Yakub Janabi indicate an early start, with some cases initially misattributed to malaria and typhoid. Described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak to date, the report provides no case or death counts, no specific laboratory confirmations beyond sequencing, and no information on infection sources or imported/exported cases. Details on clinical symptoms are not described in the article. Transmission is ongoing in Bunia, eastern Congo, as authorities monitor the progression of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ流行は公式発表の数ヵ月前から始まっていたと発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ東部で「史上最速の拡大」とされる流行として継続しており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの観点からIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事には症例数・死亡数・診断確定情報が不足しており、詳細はWATCH的だが、エボラという疾患特性と「史上最速拡大」という表現からPICKUP判定とした。続報で規模・拡大範囲の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Médica ganhadora do BBB alerta seguidores sobre o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The doctor who won BBB warns followers about measles.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks are rising in Brazil and the Americas as of 2026-08-10. Brazilian physician and BBB 23 winner Amanda Meirelles used Instagram to warn followers about measles, emphasizing its high contagiousness and potential for serious complications in unvaccinated individuals. The report highlights vaccination as the primary prevention and urges maintaining an up-to-date immunization schedule. In a video, Meirelles outlines key points about measles and reinforces the importance of vaccination. The article notes the ongoing increase in measles cases across the region and showcases public health messaging from a high-profile medical professional advocating immunization to curb transmission. No case counts or laboratory confirmation details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: BBB優勝の医師が麻疹について フォロワーに警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル及び米州で麻疹症例が増加しているとの記述はあるが、具体的な症例数や検査確認情報がなく、著名医師によるSNS上の啓発メッセージが主内容であるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの著名人（BBB優勝医師）によるInstagramでの麻疹予防啓発が主旨であり、具体的な症例数・地域データは提供されていない。カナリア諸島（スペイン）は対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: How climate change is reshaping Africa's malaria risk
article.articleSummary: Malaria transmission in Africa is reshaped by warming temperatures, altering patterns across the continent. The WHO African Region accounts for about 95% of global malaria cases and deaths, with Nigeria contributing 31.9%, the Democratic Republic of Congo 11.7%, and Niger 6.1% of regional deaths; children under 5 years account for about 76% of regional deaths. The RTS,S/AS01 malaria vaccine is recommended in moderate-to-high transmission zones; pilot programs in Ghana, Kenya and Malawi reduced all-cause mortality among vaccine-eligible children by 13.2%. Transmission peaks near 25°C and declines when temperatures fall below 16°C or exceed 34°C, as parasite development in mosquitoes is temperature-dependent. Climate change is making southern Africa and high-elevation East Africa more suitable for transmission, while parts of West Africa become too hot for optimal transmission. Health systems must intensify malaria programs, sustain funding, and prepare to expand control in cooler areas amid rising risk.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動がアフリカのマラリアリスクを再形成している
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動によるマラリア流行地域の変化に関する一般的・分析的記事であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクや異常事象の報告ではないが、長期的な公衆衛生上の懸念として継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア流行の気候変動による構造的変化を扱う分析記事であり、個別の突発的アウトブレイクの報告ではない。DRCとガーナは対象国リストに含まれるため列挙したが、他の言及国（アンゴラ、モザンビーク、ケニア、マラウイ、ニジェール、ナイジェリア）は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Três Lagoas mantém trabalho permanente de vigilância, prevenção e controle da leishmaniose visceral - Perfil News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Três Lagoas City Hall maintains ongoing surveillance, prevention and control efforts for visceral leishmaniasis - Perfil News.
article.articleSummary: Visceral leishmaniasis (aka kala-azar) in Três Lagoas, Brazil, remains under active surveillance and control by the City Hall, the Municipal Health Secretariat (SMS), and the Epidemiological Surveillance Department. Coinciding with Brazil’s National Day for Combating and Controlling Leishmaniasis on August 10, 2026, authorities emphasize prevention, surveillance, and community engagement. The disease is transmitted by the phlebotomine sand fly; at-risk groups include children, pregnant women, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals. Prevention focuses on home maintenance and vector control; in Santa Júlia, Santa Rita and part of Vila Alegre, dogs wear deltamethrin-impregnated collars. After a human case is confirmed, treatment is provided by the Ministry of Health, while local teams conduct entomology (traps), endemias (environmental management and spraying), and canine leishmaniasis testing, plus health education. Year-round monitoring targets priority areas with ongoing trap deployment and reinstallation to assess vector activity. Suspected human cases require fever, weight loss, weakness, and splenomegaly/hepatomegaly.

triage.headline_ja: トレス・ラゴアス市役所が内臓リーシュマニア症の監視・予防・制御活動を継続実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・トレス・ラゴアス市における内臓リーシュマニア症の定常的な監視・予防活動に関する記事であり、新規の異常な発生や急増を示す情報はなく、既存の対策継続が主題である。
triage.notes: 内臓リーシュマニア症はブラジルの地域流行病であり、本記事は国内啓発日に合わせた定例的な広報・啓発記事。感染者数の増加や新規発生を示す具体的データはない。

article.articleHeadline: What Is African Swine Fever? Disease Detected Among Pigs at Kunnamkulam Farm in Kerala
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) detected among pigs at the Pig Breeding Unit of Kerala's Animal Husbandry Department in Kunnamkulam on Aug 10, 2026. Samples tested at the National Institute for High Security Animal Diseases laboratory in Bhopal confirmed infection. ASF is highly contagious among pigs and does not infect humans. The district declared a 1-km infected zone and a 10-km surveillance zone around the farm, with movement controls on pigs and pork distribution under the Centre's Plan of Action; restrictions began Aug 9. A Rapid Response Team is coordinating disease-control measures. Strict biosecurity guidelines urge farmers to avoid introducing new pigs for at least three weeks, isolate newcomers, restrict visitors and vehicles, and disinfect footwear, vehicles and equipment. Swill feeding should be avoided or boiled for 20 minutes if unavoidable; avoid feeding slaughterhouse waste. Farmers should prevent contact with wild boars and report abnormal pig deaths immediately.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱とは？ケララ州クンナムクラムの養豚場で豚に感染確認
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱(ASF)はヒトに感染せず、発生農場周辺で移動制限・監視区域設定など既に対応が講じられている局所的な動物疾病事案であり、公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、当局が既に感染区域・監視区域を設定し防疫措置を実施済み。畜産分野の影響に限定され、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: In 2016, Singapore began releasing millions of non-biting male mosquitoes carrying Wolbachia. Years later, the bold experiment produced one of the world's most successful dengue-control
article.articleSummary: Singapore began releasing Wolbachia-infected male Aedes aegypti in 2016 to suppress dengue transmission. The males do not bite; when they mate with females lacking the same Wolbachia strain, their eggs do not hatch, reducing the vector population over time. Singapore now releases more than 10 million mosquitoes per week, the largest public-sector deployment of Wolbachia technology. A New England Journal of Medicine study found the intervention significantly reduced Aedes aegypti density and lowered dengue risk by more than 70%. Wolbachia blocks transmission of dengue, Zika and chikungunya, though mosquitoes can still bite. Globally, programs exist in Colombia (World Mosquito Program began Medellin in 2015, later Cali; dengue cases in Antioquia reportedly fell by 95%), Indonesia and Brazil, with plans in El Salvador. In the United States, another Wolbachia-based approach uses male tiger mosquitoes for residential control. Efficacy is influenced by local geography and intervention scale.

triage.headline_ja: 2016年、シンガポールはワクバチアを持つ非吸血性の雄蚊数百万匹を放出開始。数年後、その大胆な実験は世界で最も成功したデング熱対策の一つとなった
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクバチア技術によるデング熱対策の成功事例を紹介する解説記事であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の媒介蚊制御技術（ワクバチア）に関する成功事例の紹介であり、シンガポール、コロンビア、米国、エルサルバドルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジル・インドネシアは対象国だが、記事の主題はアウトブレイクではなく既存の対策プログラムの紹介。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյի Դեմոկրատական ​​Հանրապետությունում Էբոլայի հաստատված դեպքերի թիվը գերազանցել է 4200-ը
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,200.
article.articleSummary: As of 10 August 2026, confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 4,200, with 4,209 cases and 1,916 deaths reported by the Ministry of Health via ATS. Ituri province remains the outbreak’s epicenter, accounting for 86.5% of all cases. WHO regional director Mohammed Janabi described the situation as bad and urged intensified efforts to alert the public to seek urgent medical care. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation methods, transmission sources, or imported/exported cases. The figures indicate ongoing transmission within the DRC, highlighting a sustained high public health risk and the need for heightened response and public awareness to prompt timely medical attention.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ確定患者数が4,200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例が4,200人超・死亡1,916人と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、WHOも警戒を強めていることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州が症例の86.5%を占め、依然として流行の中心。WHOが医療機関への早期受診を呼びかけるなど懸念が強い状況。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫官员说刚果（金）埃博拉疫情或在2月就已开始
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO official says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) may have begun as early as February.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) may have started as early as February, according to WHO Africa regional director Mohammed Janabi, with the current surge centered in Ituri (Bunia), North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele, and Tshopo provinces. Declared May 15, 2026, the outbreak’s genomic sequencing suggests months of transmission before detection. A major challenge is that about 60–70% of deaths occur outside Ebola treatment centers, compounded by security instability in eastern DRC that hampers control efforts. Authorities call for an 8–12 week push to strengthen community engagement, improve early detection, and decentralize treatment to reverse the trend. By July 7, 2026, the outbreak had 4,209 confirmed cases and 1,916 deaths, marking the largest Ebola outbreak on record in the DRC and the 17th since 1976.

triage.headline_ja: WHO当局者、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は2月に始まっていた可能性があると発言
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行（確定4,209例、死亡1,916例）が継続し、検知前に数ヵ月間伝播していた可能性があり、治安不安が対応を阻害しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模のDRCエボラ流行（1976年以降17回目）。60-70%の死亡が治療施設外で発生し、東部の治安不安が対応を阻害。既知の大規模流行であるためフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Why Congo's Ebola outbreak should worry the world | News.az
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak with 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths, and 694 patients in isolation. Affected health zones cover 53 of 140 across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo. Approximately 77.7% of identified contacts are being followed. Declared on 15 May, the outbreak has been designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, spreading faster than prior events; it reached 1,000 confirmed cases within about 40 days after response activation (versus ~235 days in 2018). There is currently no licensed vaccine or specific approved treatment for Bundibugyo virus disease; vaccines mainly target Zaire Ebola virus. Transmission tracing is challenging, with cases arising outside monitored networks, delayed recognition, and factors like conflict, mobility, and limited diagnostics, testing national and international health systems’ ability to prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が世界に懸念を与える理由
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC指定済みで4,053例・1,850死亡という大規模流行であり、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、5州に拡大、国境を越える伝播リスクがあるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 既にPHEIC指定されており、史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行かつ拡大速度が過去最速。ブンディブギョ型のため既存ワクチン（ザイール型対象）が効果不明で対応が困難。

article.articleHeadline: New virus strain heightens African swine fever risk in Quang Ngai
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks in Quang Ngai province, central Vietnam, since early July 2026 have intensified, with 34 communes affected through Aug 4 and more than 1,600 pigs infected, dead, or culled, weighing nearly 95 tonnes. Since July 1, over 1,000 pigs have been culled across 19 localities that have not cleared the 21-day post-infection window. The surge is concentrated on smallholder farms with weak biosecurity. A recombinant ASF strain combining genotypes I and II is detected, raising transmission rates; environmental persistence, variable weather weakening immunity, and high live hog prices driving expansion exacerbate risk. Authorities urge enhanced monitoring, early sampling, outbreak resolution, vaccination where possible, environmental disinfection, and transport controls, while farmers are urged to uphold biosecurity and report suspected cases. Separate outbreaks in Can Tho (113 pigs culled) and Quang Tri (100 pigs culled) are also noted.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ省でアフリカ豚熱の新たな変異株がリスクを高める
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム中部で組換え型ASF株（ジェノタイプI/II）による豚の大量感染・処分が続いているが、ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり直接的な公衆衛生インパクトはない。貿易・食料安全保障面の影響は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ASF（アフリカ豚熱）はヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、IHR Annex2は主にヒト公衆衛生事象を対象とするため直接的な該当性は限定的。ただし新規組換え株の出現、豚肉価格上昇による感染拡大、複数省への拡大（Can Tho、Quang Tri）など経済・食料安全保障・貿易への影響があり、続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolom zaraženo više od 4.000 ljudi, preminulo skoro 2.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 people infected with Ebola, nearly 2,000 have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 4,200 confirmed cases with 1,916 deaths. The outbreak spans 53 districts across five provinces, with Ituri province remaining the epicenter, accounting for about 86.5% of cases. Mohamed Džanabi, WHO Regional Director, says the situation remains extremely serious and urges intensified efforts to inform communities about seeking prompt medical care. Notably, 60–70% of fatalities occurred in people’s homes, underscoring the need to continue public education on the importance of timely presentation to healthcare facilities. Ongoing surveillance and community engagement are essential to reduce home deaths and improve access to care in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者4,000人超、死者は約2,000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,200例超・死者1,916人と大規模かつ深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、複数州にわたる拡大と致死率の高さからIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHO地域局長が状況を『極めて深刻』と表明し、コミュニティでの死亡が60-70%を占めることから医療アクセス改善と地域社会への啓発強化が急務とされている。継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en RD Congo: Alarma de la UNICEF por 743 casos confirmados entre niños
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DR Congo: UNICEF warns of 743 confirmed cases among children.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is the worst and fastest-growing on record. By August 2, 2026, 743 cases (0–17) and 330 deaths have been confirmed; children account for a quarter of cases and nearly one-third of deaths, with under-five mortality disproportionately high (over 60% of confirmed cases in this age group fatal). The outbreak has disrupted health services, triggering a 42% drop in essential health service use in Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nizi, and Rwampara, and about 13% province-wide. Routine vaccinations plummeted: first-dose measles down 69% in Mongbwalu; pentavalent booster down 22%; second measles dose down 18%. Maternal health visits declined 13%, with deliveries falling 38%, 30%, and 70% in Bunia, Rwampara, and Nizi. UNICEF and partners mobilized ~13,000 workers, reached ~2.4 million people with prevention messaging, conducted >505,000 home visits, and supplied IPC materials to eight treatment centers; mental health support served >21,000 people (5,100 children).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ユニセフが子ども743人の感染確定に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で記録上最悪・最速拡大のエボラ流行が発生し、743例・330死亡（多くが小児）に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にルワンダ（Kigali Province等）が含まれるが、記事本文はDRCイトゥリ州の流行のみを主題としており、ルワンダでの発生の記述はないため除外した。麻疹ワクチン接種率の急落も報告されており、二次的な麻疹流行リスクにも注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Teknologi Jadi Kunci Percepat Deteksi TB, Indonesia Hadapi Beban Kasus Tinggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Technology Is the Key to Accelerating TB Detection, Indonesia Faces a High Burden of TB Cases.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia faces a high TB burden, demanding rapid integration of technology into detection. The Global Tuberculosis Report 2025 notes 2024 global TB cases at 10.6 million with 1.3 million deaths; Indonesia is responsible for about 10% of cases (≈1.08 million) and ranks second after India. To accelerate control, strategies must shift from passive case management to proactive, risk-based case finding. High‑risk groups include household contacts of TB patients, people living with HIV, diabetes, malnutrition, prior TB, and residents of crowded environments. Digital chest radiography with artificial intelligence is highlighted as a powerful screening and triage tool to determine who requires molecular confirmation. In addition to sputum, research is expanding testing to urine, blood, tongue swabs, respiratory aerosols, and infection‑responsive biomarkers. The call is for a paradigm change, not merely incremental innovation, to achieve TB elimination in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: 技術がTB検出加速の鍵に、インドネシアは高い結核症例負担に直面
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性的な結核流行に関する政策・技術動向の記事であり、突発的な公衆衛生上の異常事態ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアの既存の結核流行と検出技術に関する内容で、インドは比較のための言及のみであり実際の発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Biden Cancer Update; Trump on Fauci Prosecution; Cyclosporiasis Rebound Cases
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10, Ebola in Congo persists with more than 4,000 confirmed cases and over 1,850 deaths, with experts warning that Bundibugyo virus involved in the outbreak may be mutating. In the United States, cyclosporiasis rebound symptoms are reported amid ongoing cyclosporiasis outbreaks. A multistate Cyclospora outbreak linked to iceberg lettuce has prompted Taylor Farms to recall some salsa and guacamole due to potential Salmonella contamination from jalapeños. In Maryland, Cunningham Falls State Park was closed after rabid beavers attacked park-goers, underscoring wildlife rabies risk. NPR notes a promising live-attenuated Shigella sonnei vaccine candidate in trials. Other items in the report are health-system and political in nature and do not add new infectious-disease details.

triage.headline_ja: バイデン氏がん治療の最新情報／トランプ氏がファウチ氏訴追に言及／サイクロスポーラ症の再発症例
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyoウイルス）が4,000例超・死者1,850人超に達し、ウイルスの変異が懸念されている点はIHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）に2つ以上該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の政治・医療ニュースを中心とした雑多な記事だが、コンゴのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyoウイルスの変異懸念）に関する重要な続報を含むため、DRCについてのみPICKUP対象とした。米国におけるサイクロスポーラ症・狂犬病は対象国外のため評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）本轮伊波拉疫情或早在2月就开始传播
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo's current Ebola outbreak may have started spreading as early as February.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola Virus Disease outbreak, declared May 15, 2026, may have started spreading as early as February according to WHO. Genomic sequencing indicates transmission months before detection, making this the largest Ebola outbreak on record in DR Congo, spanning five provinces including Ituri (capital Bunia). As of July 7, total confirmed cases reached 4,209 with 1,916 deaths. About 60–70% of deaths occurred outside Ebola treatment centers, underscoring access barriers. Ongoing security instability in eastern areas hampers response. Experts urge eight to twelve weeks of intensified community mobilization, earlier case finding, and decentralization of treatment services to reverse the trajectory. This marks DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、今回のエボラ流行は2月にはすでに拡大していた可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を複数満たし（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、WHOも関与する史上最大規模のエボラ流行であるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOのゲノム解析により2月からの潜在的拡散が示唆され、コンゴ史上最大規模（累計4,209例、死亡1,916例）のエボラ流行。治安不安が対応を阻害しており、国際支援と地域分散化した治療体制強化が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: Wie fehlende Mittel die Krise verschärfen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: How Lack of Resources Is Exacerbating the Crisis.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 4,000 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 1,750 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the largest outbreak there to date. About 20,000 contacts are being traced. Beate Kampmann warns the response is lagging behind the outbreak, and ongoing funding cuts—US support down by more than $1 billion in a year—hamper surveillance, laboratories, healthcare workers, and emergency coordination. In the field, there is urgent need for isolation units, therapeutics, IV fluids, and protective gear; a single protective suit costs $10–$20 and must be changed hourly, stretching budgets in a conflict-affected region. Long-term solutions require effective vaccines (in early trials), with CEPI-supported programs and Africa-based production to boost resilience. Monoclonal antibodies exist but are costly and not widely available. Germany advises containment at the source and preparation for possible imported cases, not broad travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：資金不足が危機を悪化させている
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（約4000例確定・1750人死亡）が進行中であり、資金・資材不足で対応が追いついていないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツは資金援助・輸入例への備えに関する言及であり、発生国はDRCのみ。過去最大規模の流行であり、資金削減が対応能力を著しく損なっている点が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Source.ba:Ebolom zaraženo više od 4.000 ljudi, preminulo skoro 2.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Source.ba: More than 4,000 people infected with Ebola, nearly 2,000 have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak has infected more than 4,000 people and caused nearly 2,000 deaths across 53 districts in five provinces, with Ituri Province as the epicenter, responsible for about 86.5% of confirmed cases. As of 2026-08-10, the World Health Organization's Regional Director Mohamed Džanabi says the epidemiological situation remains extremely serious and demands intensified efforts to inform communities about the importance of seeking medical care promptly rather than staying at home. He notes that roughly 60-70% of fatalities occur at patients' homes, highlighting the critical need for proactive outreach, rapid case finding, and timely treatment to reduce mortality. The report emphasizes continued public education and community engagement to encourage early presentation to healthcare facilities and helps prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: Source.ba:エボラ感染者4,000人超、死者は約2,000人に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,000人超が感染し約2,000人死亡という大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: WHO地域局長のコメントを含む大規模エボラ流行。死亡の60-70%が自宅で発生しており、症例発見・治療の遅れが問題視されている。フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says Congo's Ebola outbreak started months before it was declared
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10, Congo's eastern Ebola outbreak centered on Bunia has 4,200 confirmed cases and over 1,900 deaths. WHO sequencing indicates the outbreak began in February, months before its May 15 declaration, with early cases misattributed to malaria and typhoid. The Bundibugyo virus driving this outbreak has no approved vaccines or treatments, and initial tests targeted a more common Ebola type, delaying recognition. Described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, new cases are doubling in some hotspots, and 60–70% of new infections occur outside of monitored contacts, signaling rapid spread. Access to healthcare is hampered by rebel conflict near borders with South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda. Tedros warned Ebola is spreading faster than efforts to contain it, while health workers protest over pay. In perspective, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak caused >11,000 deaths from ~28,000 cases over about eight months to 1,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは正式発表の数ヶ月前から始まっていたと発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部でのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）アウトブレイクは4,200例・1,900人超の死亡と規模が深刻で、ワクチン・治療薬が存在せず監視外感染が60-70%に及ぶなど急速拡大とヒトーヒト感染のリスクが高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSudan, Angola, Rwanda, Ugandaが含まれるが、記事本文では主要な発生地はコンゴ（ブンィア）のみであり、他国は国境近接地としての言及に過ぎないため除外。ルワンダ・ウガンダ・南スーダンは国境地域として言及されているが、実際の感染確認例の記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Confira como se vacinar contra o sarampo sarampo cinco estações do Metrô
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Find out how to get vaccinated against measles at five metro stations.
article.articleSummary: As of 10 August 2026, São Paulo Metro, in partnership with the Municipal Health Secretariat (SMS), launches a new stage of the measles–mumps–rubella (MMR) vaccination campaign at five metro stations, running through 28 August. The focus is measles (sarampo) prevention, with vaccination sites at Corinthians-Itaquera, São Mateus (17, 19, 21 Aug; 10:00–20:00), Vila Prudente (17–21 Aug; 10:00–16:00), Tucuruvi (10–14 and 17–21 Aug; 10:00–16:00), and Vila Matilde (27–28 Aug; 10:00–16:00). Tucuruvi is emphasized due to recent cases in the northern zone. A total of 16 confirmed cases have been reported, ranging from infants to adults (0–2 years and 20–50 years). State MMR coverage stands at 77.5% first dose and 65.5% second dose, well below the 95% target. Authorities urge individuals six months to 59 years in three priority cities to update vaccination; a zero-dose for 6–11 months is available as added protection, not a substitute for routine vaccines at 12 and 15 months.

triage.headline_ja: 地下鉄5駅で麻疹ワクチン接種を実施、サンパウロ州
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹16例確認、ワクチン接種率が目標(95%)を大幅に下回っており(77.5%/65.5%)、麻疹排除国での再興という異常性と流行しやすさが認められるため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 麻疹はブラジルで一度排除認定された疾患であり、低ワクチン接種率下での再興は公衆衛生上注視すべき事象。ただし症例数(16例)は限定的で重症度情報も不明のため、続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento de Casos de Sarampo no Brasil Eleva Risco de Novos Surtos Mesmo com Baixa Circulação Endêmica - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in measles cases in Brazil raises the risk of new outbreaks even with low endemic transmission - BH 24 Hours
article.articleSummary: As of 10 August 2026, Brazil reported 18 measles cases, 16 in São Paulo state, while the country remains free of endemic transmission. Experts warn outbreaks remain possible if vaccination coverage is uneven. Measles is highly airborne, spreading via aerosols and often circulating before typical symptoms appear. Vulnerable groups include infants under one year and immunocompromised adults; pneumonia is the most frequent complication and a cause of death in young children, with encephalitis possible. In pregnancy, measles raises risks of maternal pneumonia, preterm birth, fetal loss, and low birth weight. Prevention hinges on vaccination: at least 95% coverage with two doses of the MMR vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella), given by 12 and 15 months; adults who are not fully vaccinated should catch up per Ministry of Health guidance. Early detection, isolation, contact tracing, and ring vaccination are essential to interrupt transmission, especially for imported cases reaching low-coverage communities.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで麻疹症例が増加、地域流行は低いままでも新たな集団感染のリスクが上昇
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹18例（うち16例がサンパウロ州）が報告されているが、地域流行はなく重症例・死亡の報告もないため即時のフルRRAは不要だが、ワクチン接種率のばらつきによる再燃リスクがあり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 現時点では小規模な輸入例が中心であり、ワクチン接種率が低い地域での二次感染拡大が今後の焦点となる。続報での症例数・重症度の変化を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Zdravstveni pregledi za strane radnike: Cilj je spriječiti širenje zaraznih bolesti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health screenings for foreign workers: The aim is to prevent the spread of infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Croatia’s Ministry of Health, by late July, mandated that third-country nationals entering Croatia on visa regimes and renewing temporary residence must undergo a health examination for acute and chronic infectious diseases and receive vaccinations as needed based on vaccination status. Applicable to residents from visa-requiring countries such as India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Pakistan, the Philippines, and Egypt, the process requires Form 18a to assess health and vaccination status. A key condition for granting temporary residence is proof of no active tuberculosis and not being a carrier of typhoid (Salmonella Typhi) or paratyphoid (Salmonella Paratyphi). If not fully immunized against diseases in Croatia’s compulsory vaccination program, revaccination is performed. Individuals with TB or carrier status are ineligible. For renewals, the health examination must be issued by the Croatian Institute of Public Health (HZJZ) and relevant county public health institutes, with Form 18a submitted by a registered home-country health facility.

triage.headline_ja: 外国人労働者への健康診断：感染症の蔓延防止が目的
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はクロアチアにおける外国人労働者向け入国時健康診断制度の説明であり、特定国での感染症発生や流行を報じるものではないため、シグナルとして取り上げる根拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事はクロアチアの入国・在留手続きにおける健康診断（結核・腸チフス・パラチフスのスクリーニング）制度を説明したものであり、インド・ネパール・バングラデシュ・パキスタン・フィリピン・エジプトはビザ対象国として名前が挙がっているだけで、これらの国で実際に疾病が発生・流行しているという内容ではない。従って対象国での発生事例として扱うべきではなく、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला का प्रकोप आधिकारिक घोषणा से कई महीने पहले शुरू हुआ था : डब्ल्यूएचओ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo began several months before the official declaration: WHO.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak began in February, with the official declaration on May 15, 2026, according to WHO Africa Regional Director Mohammad Yakub Janabi. Genomic sequencing indicates February origins, and some early cases were misdiagnosed as malaria and typhoid. It has become the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record. WHO says it is making continuous efforts to halt transmission, but the virus is spreading more rapidly than response measures. The report does not provide case or death counts. The situation underscores the need for rapid detection, strengthened surveillance, and genomic analysis to trace transmission chains in the eastern Congo region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行は公式発表の数か月前から始まっていた:WHO
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が史上最速の拡大を示しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、対応の遅れが確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 感染者数・死亡者数の具体的な数値は記事内に記載なし。史上最速拡大との記述があり、続報でのケース数・対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Face au risque d'Ebola, la République centrafricaine renforce sa préparation
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In response to the Ebola risk, the Central African Republic strengthens its preparedness.
article.articleSummary: Central African Republic strengthens Ebola preparedness with a preventive vaccination campaign conducted January–April 2026 across 35 health districts in seven regions, backed by WHO and partners. Although no Ebola cases have been recorded in the country, authorities face ongoing risk due to proximity and shared borders with the Democratic Republic of Congo, which has experienced multiple outbreaks, raising concern of imported or internal transmission. The campaign delivered 52,010 ERVEBO doses and vaccinated 41,442 people, achieving a national coverage of 83.9%, including 28,935 health professionals and frontline workers. Beyond vaccination, efforts improved surveillance, data monitoring, training, and community sensitization, reinforcing health system preparedness. Personal testimonies, such as Bangui-based community health worker Pinda Astrid and Lakouanga 6 resident Yamba Jordan, reflect growing trust in vaccination as a preventive measure. As of August 10, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラリスクに対し、中央アフリカ共和国が対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 中央アフリカ共和国ではエボラ症例は確認されておらず、予防的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施報告に留まる。DRCとの国境共有リスクは継続するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は中央アフリカ共和国（CAR）における予防接種キャンペーンであり、CARは対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCは国境を接する潜在的リスク要因として言及されているのみで、現時点でCAR国内での実際のエボラ発生は報告されていないため、DRCも本イベントの発生地域としては含めない。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ: Kongo'daki Ebola salgını mayısta değil şubatta başlamış olabilir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in Congo may have started in February rather than May.
article.articleSummary: Genetic sequencing suggests the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo began in February, not May, according to WHO Africa Region Director Muhammed Yakub Janabi, who spoke in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, was officially declared on 15 May. As of 7 August, authorities reported a total of 4,209 confirmed cases and 1,916 deaths. The press conference in eastern DRC's Ituri highlighted that the virus may have circulated for months before detection. Laboratory sequencing underpins the early circulation finding. No details on imported or exported cases are provided. The figures remain part of an ongoing outbreak in the region, with Ituri as the focal point.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴのエボラ流行は5月ではなく2月に始まった可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが4,209例・1,916死亡（CFR約45%）に達し、遺伝子解析で流行開始が公式発表より数ヶ月早かった可能性が示された。重大な公衆衛生上の影響とヒト-ヒト感染のリスクからPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョ株によるDRCでの大規模流行。致死率約45%と非常に高く、WHOが公式に検出時期の遅れを認めている点は流行対応の課題を示唆。既知の継続中アウトブレイクであり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says Congo's fast-moving Ebola outbreak started months before it was declared
article.articleSummary: Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record is unfolding in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, driven by Bundibugyo virus with no approved vaccines or treatments. As of 2026-08-10, confirmed cases exceed 4,200 with more than 1,900 deaths. The outbreak began in February and was officially declared May 15; sequencing indicates the start earlier, with early cases misattributed to malaria and typhoid. WHO notes the virus is “ahead of us.” Response is hampered by unpaid health worker strikes, rebel threats, misinformation, and large displacement, along with shortages of protective gear. Remote, unpaved roads and scarce reliable water complicate handwashing and case management. About 60–70% of new cases occur outside monitored contacts, and some hotspots see rapid doubles in case counts. The region near South Sudan, Uganda and Rwanda faces ongoing access challenges; health centers are avoided by some pregnant women. The outbreak is spreading faster than containment efforts, unlike many previous Ebola events.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴの急速に拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行は発表より数ヶ月前に始まっていたと発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準も5つ全て該当し、記録上最速の感染拡大を見せるエボラ出血熱の流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ、スーダン、ルワンダが記載されているが、記事本文では主にDRC東部での流行拡大が焦点であり、これらの国境付近でのアクセス課題として言及されているのみで、実際の感染発生国としては確認できないため対象国リストにはDRCのみを含めた。ブンディブギョウイルスによる記録上最速の流行で、ワクチン・治療法未承認、医療従事者ストライキ、反政府武装勢力の脅威、大規模な避難民発生など対応が極めて困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola avança na RDC, e medo afasta pacientes de hospitais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola advances in the DRC, and fear keeps patients away from hospitals.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 1,800 people and infected about 4,000 confirmed cases nationwide as of August 10, 2026. Declared May 15 with Bunia as the epicenter, it represents the largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the DRC and the second-largest by cases in history. Transmission has accelerated in the eastern region, with roughly 1,500 deaths reported in the first 11 weeks, compared with 279 deaths in the same period of the 2014 West Africa outbreak. Fear among patients, families, and health workers is driving people away from hospitals, complicating response efforts. It underscores ongoing outbreak dynamics, surveillance gaps, and urgent need for safe care access in affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがDRCで拡大、恐怖で患者が病院を避ける
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、死者1,800人超・感染者約4,000人と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大リスクも否定できないためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文ではDRC国内(Bunia含む東部地域)のみが主題であり、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : ITG start nieuw onderzoek naar immuunrespons op ebolavariant
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: ITG launches a new study into the immune response to an Ebola variant.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths, with Ituri spreading to North Kivu and Bunia as the eastern epicenter. Since mid-May the 17th outbreak shows sustained transmission, and authorities suspect the virus was present as early as January. The Institute for Tropical Medicine (ITG) has expanded clinical work and begun a descriptive immune-response study on the Bundibugyo variant, alongside trials of existing therapies that may lower mortality. Sampling is underway to describe how the variant behaves, its health and immune-system effects, and potential complications. The old Zaïre vaccine may offer suboptimal protection; no vaccine or drug exists yet for Bundibugyo, though Ervebo is being considered for rapid testing. Three vaccine candidates are in development but won’t be field-ready for months; funding shortfalls hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:ITGがエボラ変異株に対する免疫応答の新たな研究を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,053例・1,850人死亡という大規模なエボラ（ブンディブジョ変異株）流行が継続しており、既存ワクチン・治療薬が不十分で国際的拡大リスクもあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブジョ変異株には既存ワクチン（旧Zaïre株ワクチン）の効果が限定的とされ、資金不足が対応の障害となっている点は重要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says DR of Congo's Ebola outbreak began months before it was declared | BreakingNews
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, began in February and was officially declared on May 15. By 2026-08-10, confirmed cases total 4,200 with more than 1,900 deaths. WHO sequencing indicates the outbreak started months earlier, with early cases misattributed to malaria and typhoid, meaning the virus has been “ahead of us.” This is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record and has no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo. Early testing focused on the more common Ebola strain, contributing to delays. The outbreak is spreading rapidly, with new cases doubling in some hot spots; 60–70% of new cases occur outside monitored contacts. The affected region is remote, near borders with South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda; health workers have protested pay, and officials in Kinshasa emphasize intensified response. Previously, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak remained deadlier with about 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は公表数ヶ月前に始まっていたと発表
triage.triage_reason: 確定4,200例・死亡1,900人超、承認済みワクチン/治療薬なしのブンディブジョ株による史上最速拡大のエボラ流行であり、国境地域への拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSudan、Angola、Rwanda、Ugandaが含まれるが、記事本文では国境近接の言及のみでこれら国での発生は確認されていないため除外。DRCのみを確定地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola circulou quatro meses antes de epidemia ser declarada na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola circulated four months before the outbreak was declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 10 August 2026, Ebola circulated in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo as early as February 2025, four months before the outbreak was officially declared on 15 May 2025. Genomic studies led by Steve Mundeke Ahuka show undetected circulation, with Ituri province’s Bunia as the epicenter. WHO Africa Regional Director Mohamed Yakub Janabi notes the outbreak is spreading faster than previous ones and has reached Uganda; the Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, with case fatality estimated between 30% and 50%. About 70% of patients die in their communities, prompting calls for greater community involvement and strategy reassessment as hospital visits decline. The current outbreak is the second largest in history and has the most infections recorded in the DRC, surpassing 2018–2020 totals (2,299 deaths and 3,481 cases). Uganda declared Ebola-free on 28 July after 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が公式発表される4か月前から感染が拡大していた
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行が発生し、ウガンダにも拡大、致死率30-50%でワクチン・治療法未承認のため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。既に7月28日にウガンダはエボラ終息を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو بدأ قبل أشهر من الإعلان عنه
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo began months before it was announced.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo began in February 2026, months before its official announcement on May 15, 2026. In a press conference, WHO Africa Regional Director Mohamed Yakub Janabi said genetic sequencing pointed to the outbreak's start, and that some early cases were misattributed to malaria and typhoid. The outbreak has become the fastest-spreading instance of Ebola to date. The report provides no specific case or death counts.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は発表の数ヶ月前から始まっていた
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がWHOにより「史上最速の感染拡大」と評価され、検出遅延や誤診（マラリア・腸チフスとの誤認）が判明しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 感染者数・死亡者数の具体的データは記事に記載なし。WHOのプレスカンファレンスに基づく報道であり、遺伝子配列解析により発生開始時期が2026年2月と特定された点が特徴的。早期症例がマラリア・腸チフスと誤診されていたことが検出遅延の一因とされる。

article.articleHeadline: "Wir jagen dem Virus hinterher": Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo begann schon im Februar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "We are chasing after the virus": Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo began as early as February.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant; genomic sequencing suggests the outbreak began in February 2026. Officials formally confirmed on May 15, 2026, and the WHO designated it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later. There is no licensed vaccine or approved specific therapy for Bundibugyo. Early cases were misattributed to malaria or typhoid, and standard Ebola diagnostics initially failed to detect infection. The outbreak has expanded at an unprecedented pace for Bundibugyo, with current Congolese government data reporting 4,200 confirmed cases and more than 1,900 deaths. The situation underscores diagnostic challenges and the need for rapid response, with authorities noting: "We are chasing after the virus; the virus is one step ahead of us."

triage.headline_ja: 「私たちはウイルスを追いかけている」：コンゴのエボラ発生は2月に始まっていた
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のPHEIC指定済み大規模流行で、致死率・拡大速度ともに深刻。IHR基準の複数項目に該当し、国際的関心・支援の必要性も高い。
triage.notes: WHOはすでにPHEICを宣言済み。ワクチン・特異的治療法未承認、診断遅延が拡大に寄与しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole u Kongu počela mjesecima prije nego što je zvanično proglašena
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo began months before it was officially declared.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo’s Ebola outbreak began in February 2026, earlier than the 15 May declaration, according to the World Health Organization. Genomic sequencing indicates earlier transmission, with some early cases misattributed to malaria or typhoid. As of 10 August 2026, 4,200 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 1,900 deaths have been reported. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved vaccines or therapies. Response efforts are hindered by strikes by unpaid health workers, threats from armed groups, community distrust, and misinformation that Ebola is not real. Field teams operate on remote, unpaved roads with limited PPE while displaced populations lack reliable water for hygiene. WHO notes 60–70% of new cases are detected outside existing contact networks. The region borders South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda; ongoing conflict has limited access to care, with some pregnant women avoiding clinics.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行は正式発表の数カ月前から始まっていた
triage.triage_reason: 希少株ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスによる大規模流行（4200例、死者1900人超）で、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認、周辺国への拡大リスクや対応の困難さが顕著なためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・南スーダン・ルワンダとの国境地域における感染拡大リスクに言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。マラリア・腸チフスとの誤診による発見遅延が流行拡大の一因とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Rio de Janeiro sediará II Fórum Uma Só Saúde focado no combate à leishmaniose e zoonoses - Diário do Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro will host the Second One Health Forum focused on combating leishmaniasis and zoonoses - Diário do Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro hosts the second One Health Forum focusing on leishmaniasis and zoonoses, at OAB-RJ in downtown Rio on Aug 13-14, 2026. The event, organized by ABRAESCA with CRMV-RJ and OAB-RJ during Green August, convenes experts to advance integrated human-animal-environment health. Visceral and cutaneous leishmaniasis are the technical axis. Municipal data (Jan–Jun 2026) show 615 canine inquiries, 139 positives, and 111 epidemiological investigations completed, evidencing active transmission by the sandfly vector Lutzomyia longipalpis in the city. The forum discusses the new Ministry of Health Manual for Visceral Leishmaniasis Surveillance and Control, promoting evidence-based protocols and non-euthanasia strategies to replace outdated methods.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ、リーシュマニア症とズーノーシス対策に焦点を当てた第2回ワンヘルスフォーラムを開催
triage.triage_reason: 内容は学術フォーラム開催の告知であり、新規流行や急性の公衆衛生危機を示すものではない。既存の監視データ（犬の陽性例など）の紹介に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事はリーシュマニア症の流行拡大ではなく、既存の監視・対策に関する学術フォーラムの開催告知。犬における媒介動物調査データは継続的な監視活動の一環として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: धमतरी के बनियापारा वार्ड में गंदे पानी की सप्लाई से हड़कंप, पीलिया और टाइफाइड की चपेट में आए डेढ़ दर्जन लोग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panic Over Dirty Water Supply in Dhamtari's Bania Para Ward; Eighteen People Contract Jaundice and Typhoid.
article.articleSummary: Jaundice and Typhoid outbreak in Bania Para Ward, Dhamtari city, Chhattisgarh, linked to contaminated drinking water from a defective pipeline. More than 15 residents affected, with several hospitalized and two in critical condition. Water reportedly foul and insect-infested; residents had raised concerns for days, but officials initially did not act. After media attention, Nagar Nigam’s Water Chairperson Akhilesh Sonker visited, ordered laboratory testing of water samples, and initiated pipeline repairs. Citizens are advised not to consume tap water, and many are buying bottled water. Water samples have been sent to a laboratory; results are awaited. Affected individuals include Ahmed Raza and numerous others from Bania Para Ward; locals demand a high-level investigation and accountability for negligent officials amid an ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ダムタリ市バニヤパラ地区の汚水供給問題で大混乱、18人が黄疸・腸チフスに感染
triage.triage_reason: 地域限定の水質汚染による腸チフス・黄疸の集団発生であり、国際的拡大の可能性は低いが、原因未特定で被害拡大の恐れがあるため継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 単一地区（Dhamtari市Bania Para地区）内での水道汚染による局地的発生。重症者2名を含み15名以上が罹患。当局が対応を開始しており、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないが、続報（検査結果等）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Man Nearly Died After Vietnam's Malaria Victory Emptied Medicine Shelves
article.articleSummary: Severe malaria near-fatalities in Vietnam highlight a procurement vulnerability. On July 23, 2026, a 30-year-old worker returning from Nigeria arrived at Ho Chi Minh City’s Hospital for Tropical Diseases in deteriorating condition with zero artesunate in southern Vietnam. Vietnam’s malaria success—246 nationwide cases in 2025 with no deaths; Ho Chi Minh City malaria-free since 2020; early 2026 only 25 cases—created a structural shortage because artesunate is procured on demand. Only Bạch Mai Hospital in Hanoi held stock; a volunteer retrieved the drug and a Vietnam Airlines crew transported it as hand luggage, arriving at Nội Bài and routed to HCMC, with treatment starting by 10 p.m. The patient recovered by Aug 10, 2026. Imported malaria risk is rising from sub-Saharan Africa (Angola, Guinea, Nigeria); 2024–2026 cases noted, WHO donated 150 doses to Bạch Mai. The root issue: lack of a national buffer stock for a life-saving medicine.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのマラリア制圧勝利が薬局の在庫を空にした後、男性が死の淵に立たされた
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム国内でのマラリア排除成功に伴う抗マラリア薬（アルテスネート）の国家的緊急在庫欠如という構造的脆弱性が明らかになり、WHOの緊急支援も発生しているため、公衆衛生システムの管理可能性に関する懸念からフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 輸入元のナイジェリア・ギニア・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事の主題はベトナム国内における薬剤供給体制の脆弱性であり、輸入マラリア症例自体は単発的だが、国家的な抗マラリア薬バッファストック欠如という構造的問題がWHO支援を招いている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Startup de Rio Grande desenvolve dispositivo de diagnóstico de tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande-based startup develops a tuberculosis diagnostic device.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande, Brazil-based startup Nernst, housed at the Federal University of Rio Grande (FURG) and incubated in Innovatio, is validating a portable tuberculosis diagnostic device designed to deliver results in five minutes, versus about two hours with current bench methods. The system uses a sputum sample and a biosensor strip within a handheld unit that features a display, enabling point-of-care testing in clinics or remote regions. Derived from doctoral work by Ana Paula Lopes, the device aims to cut costs by ~70% and reduce required sample volume by ~98% compared with traditional diagnostics. The seven-person team collaborates with FURG labs and Tecnopuc in Porto Alegre, supported by the Hangar program, with commercialization anticipated around 2029. Looking ahead, the platform could offer multi-disease readouts, including tuberculosis, COVID-19, Chagas disease, and dengue.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ発のスタートアップが結核診断デバイスを開発
triage.triage_reason: これは新しい診断機器の技術開発に関する報道であり、実際の疾病発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核・COVID-19・シャーガス病・デング熱の迅速診断デバイス開発に関する技術/イノベーション報道であり、疾病アウトブレイクの発生を示すものではないため対象国なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo, coqueluche e meningite: por que doenças preveníveis ainda preocupam especialistas? - CBDL
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles, whooping cough and meningitis: why preventable diseases still worry experts? - CBDL.
article.articleSummary: Measles, pertussis (whooping cough), and meningitis remain a concern in Brazil due to declining vaccination coverage, with cases reported across regions. Vaccines have dramatically reduced incidence, but lower immunization rates allow viruses and bacteria to circulate, putting children under five, the elderly, pregnant women, and the immunocompromised at risk. Nurse Elisa Lino of Clínica Vacinne warns that many people assume these diseases have vanished and neglect updating their vaccination cards, but lifelong boosters are essential to maintain herd immunity. Measles is a highly contagious viral infection that can cause pneumonia, encephalitis, and death. Pertussis causes severe coughing fits and can lead to respiratory failure in infants. Meningitis can progress rapidly, causing permanent disabilities or death. Lifelong vaccination includes boosters for adolescents, adults, pregnant women, and seniors; if unsure, consult a vaccination clinic to review the card and determine needed boosters or age-specific vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹、百日咳、髄膜炎：予防可能な疾患が専門家をなお懸念させる理由とは？ - CBDL
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン接種率低下に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、具体的なアウトブレイクや症例数の急増、緊急対応の必要性を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は専門家によるワクチン接種の重要性に関する一般的な解説記事で、具体的な発生状況（症例数、地域、期間）の記載はない。
