The response plan includes adding 400 beds for Ebola patients and 100 beds for other health services. Communities and traders are urged to participate in prevention, including the installation of handwashing stations. A more decentralized response and earlier case management could improve the situation in the coming months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：死亡の大半は医療施設から遠い地域で発生
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によるDRCでの死亡者数が1900人を超え、地域感染継続と国際的拡大リスクが存在するため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（Bunia、Aru）における進行中のエボラ流行に関するもので、WHOによる分散的医療体制の構築や接触者追跡の効果が報告されている。国際的拡大の直接的証拠はないが、エボラの性質上リスクは高いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Outbreak Began Months Earlier Than Reported, WHO Says
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus, began as early as February but was officially declared in mid-May, delaying containment. As of this week, confirmed cases have reached about 4,200 with at least 1,900 deaths, making it one of the deadliest and fastest-growing outbreaks on record. WHO notes rapid growth, with new cases doubling in some hotspots, and cites obstacles including unpaid healthcare worker strikes, threats from rebel groups, distrust in traumatized communities, and widespread misinformation. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments; vaccination efforts hinge on Ervebo (Zaire strain) trials that may offer limited protection, while a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine is preferred, with two candidates in early-stage trials and a third in development. The situation underscores delays in declaration, ongoing surveillance, and global coordination, echoing lessons from the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、WHOによれば報告より数か月早く始まっていた
triage.triage_reason: 確定4,200例・死亡1,900人以上という記録的な規模と急速な拡大、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、治安・社会的要因による対応困難が重なり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事本文はDRC国内の状況のみを主題としており、Angolaでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。Angolaは対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat records 225 suspected Chandipura cases; death toll rises to 25 - Bilkul Online
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10, Gujarat reports 225 suspected Chandipura virus cases since June 30, with 39 laboratory-confirmed infections and 25 deaths among confirmed patients. Suspected cases rose from 184 in July; 212 of 225 have been lab-tested, with 13 results pending, so counts may still change. The outbreak began in Panchmahal in early July, where two children died, prompting intensified surveillance, testing, and vector-control measures. By mid-July, 63 suspected cases were reported, 12 positive, with eight results pending. By early August, Gujarat had 184 suspected, 35 confirmed, and 22 deaths. Chandipura virus is vector-borne, causing acute encephalitis syndrome, transmitted by sandflies and peaking during the monsoon, with most confirmed patients reportedly under 15. Health authorities urge rapid referral of suspected pediatric cases to oxygen/ventilator-equipped hospitals and ongoing testing and vector-control.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルス疑い症例225件、死亡者数25人に増加 - Bilkul Online
triage.triage_reason: インド・グジャラート州で小児を中心とした急性脳炎症候群（チャンディプラウイルス）の疑い症例が225件、確定39件、死亡25件と拡大しており、公衆衛生への影響が深刻かつ症例数増加が続いているためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサンドフライ媒介性で主に小児に急性脳炎症候群を引き起こす。ヒト-ヒト感染の明確な報告はないが、致死率が高く（確定39例中25例死亡）、モンスーン期に流行拡大が継続中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo volta a acender alerta no Brasil: quem precisa se vacinar? Veja perguntas e respostas sobre a doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles raises alarm again in Brazil: who needs to be vaccinated? See questions and answers about the disease.
article.articleSummary: 24 measles cases in Brazil as of August 7: 23 in São Paulo state and 1 in Rio de Janeiro. Two imported cases; others linked to importation, though infection sources are not identified for all. The rise follows outbreaks in Americas, including the United States’ largest in 35 years, driven by vaccine hesitancy and misinformation; travel sustains importation. In response, São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo are vaccinating all residents aged 6 months to 59 years, regardless of vaccination history, to interrupt transmission. Cases have been identified and containment measures implemented; surveillance is active. Measles is highly contagious and airborne; transmission can occur six days before to four days after rash. Symptoms include high fever and red rash; pneumonia occurs in about 1 in 20 children, and encephalitis in 1-4 per 1,000. Vaccination remains two-dose MMR (12 and 15 months); older unvaccinated individuals should start or complete two doses.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで麻疹への警戒再燃：ワクチン接種が必要な人は？疾患に関するQ&A
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州を中心に麻疹24例が確認され、輸入例を起点とした感染拡大とワクチン拒否の問題が指摘されており、行政による緊急ワクチン接種対応や社会的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 米国など米州全体での麻疹アウトブレイクを背景に、ブラジルでも輸入例による感染が継続。サンパウロ州・グアルーリョス・サンベルナルド・ド・カンポで大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンが開始されている。現時点で症例数は限定的だが、ワクチン拒否・誤情報の影響で今後拡大する可能性があり、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño Puts 756 Latin American Hospitals at Risk as Dengue Cases Top 624,000
article.articleSummary: 624,085 suspected dengue cases across the Americas through epidemiological week 12 of 2026, with Brazil adding 62,707 suspected cases in the first five weeks of the year—a 64% drop from the same period in 2025, though uptrends may resume. In 2025, 4.46 million suspected and 1.68 million confirmed dengue cases were reported region-wide, including 8,966 severe cases and 2,207 deaths. Brazil bore the largest burden in 2025: 1.66 million probable cases, 1.45 million confirmed, 1,793 deaths; incidence 775.7 per 100,000. All four dengue serotypes circulated in Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Mexico, Panama, and Puerto Rico. A July 2026 PAHO analysis warns El Niño 2026-2027 could expose 756 emergency hospitals to coastal flooding; drought may paradoxically boost transmission via open-water storage. PAHO’s response emphasizes surveillance, vector control, clinical training, and vaccine guidance, while noting climate disruptions could delay campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョによりラテンアメリカの756病院がリスクに、デング熱症例は62万4000件を超える
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はラテンアメリカで既知の流行病であり、本記事は既存の症例統計とエルニーニョによる将来リスクの分析報告であるため、新規シグナルというより継続監視事案と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はPAHO（米州保健機関）による地域全体のデング熱統計とエルニーニョに関連する将来的な医療インフラリスク分析。ブラジルが最大の症例数を占めるが、他の対象国（パナマ、コロンビア、メキシコ等）はBluedotリスト対象国に含まれないため除外。今後のエルニーニョ関連の感染拡大動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Atração infantil em São Paulo dá desconto para quem tomar vacina contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Children's attraction in São Paulo offers a discount to those who receive the measles vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination promotion runs in São Paulo to boost immunization during a multivaccination campaign from Aug 3 to Sep 1 in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo. In São Paulo, the incentive is 10% off at Parque Inflável Turma da Mônica at the outside parking lot of Shopping Eldorado, in the western zone, on Aug 12, 13, 14, 19, 20, and 21; customers must show a vaccination card proving the measles dose was administered during the campaign; tickets must be bought at the park's box office. The 1,200 m² inflatable park features ball pit, maze, climbing wall, central slide; timed play slots and day-use options. The park in São Paulo runs until Oct 12, after which it will move to other cities. The project is a partnership between InHaus and MSP Estúdios.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの子供向けアトラクション、はしかワクチン接種者に割引を提供
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の予防接種促進キャンペーンに関する広報記事であり、実際の感染事例や発生状況の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種促進のプロモーションイベントに関する内容であり、麻疹の発生・流行に関する情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS: el ébola comenzó a circular en la RDC cuatro meses antes de declararse la epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola began circulating in the DRC four months before the outbreak was declared.
article.articleSummary: Ebola began circulating in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province, Bunia) in February, four months before the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. Genetic studies led by Steve Mundeke Ahuka show the virus circulating prior to confirmation. WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Yakub Janabi warned that response lags by about four months, with the virus ahead of the response, noting faster spread and transmission into neighboring Uganda amid insecurity in eastern DRC. There are no vaccines or official treatments for this Ebola strain. About 70% of deaths occur in communities, indicating many patients do not reach hospitals and highlighting gaps in awareness. The epicenter is Ituri, with Bunia a key hub. The report calls for reevaluating strategy to improve hospital access and community engagement, as of 2026-08-10.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ出血熱はDRCで流行が公式に宣言される4か月前から拡大していた
triage.triage_reason: DRC・イツリ州でのエボラ出血熱が公式宣言前から4か月間水面下で拡大し、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されており、ワクチン・治療法が存在しないなどIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき事例。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの伝播が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。当該エボラ株にはワクチン・治療法が存在しない点、および死亡の約70%が地域社会内で発生している点は重症度・対応の課題として重要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: Ebola is killing people before they ever reach a doctor
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri province with Bunia as epicenter, has killed more than 1,900 people, with 60–70% of deaths occurring in communities far from care. The Bundibugyo virus, more lethal and for which no approved vaccine exists, drives the mortality burden three months after the outbreak was declared on 15 May. WHO Africa Regional Director Dr. Mohamed Janabi says the response must shift from city-centric care to closer-to-home facilities and earlier referrals. Transport delays and lack of nearby treatment centres push patients to Bunia only after illness has worsened, sometimes returning bodies to villages and spreading transmission. Aru has shown a positive pattern—no new cases for two weeks after rapid contact tracing and community outreach, prompting plans to establish additional Ebola beds (400) and 100 other health beds, and to expand community handwashing and local centres outside Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱、医師にかかる前に人々を死に至らせている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で1900人以上が死亡する大規模エボラ出血熱流行が継続中で、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株による高致死率と地域への感染拡大リスクがあり、WHOも対応強化を呼びかけている。
triage.notes: 1900人以上の死者を出す大規模流行で、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株による高致死率、地方への医療アクセス不足が感染拡大の一因。WHOの対応方針転換（地域密着型医療への移行）が報じられている。

article.articleHeadline: 161 bitten in 24 hours: Stray dog terror in Kalyan leaves hospital swamped
article.articleSummary: Stray dogs in Kalyan West unleashed a 24-hour attack, biting more than 160 people between Sunday afternoon and Monday; an 11-year-old girl was seriously injured and evacuated to Mumbai for treatment. The feral dog first attacked near Sandeep Hotel on Birla College Road, spreading through the Birla College area, old RTO office, and Bhoirwadi as pedestrians, riders, and commuters were bitten. Rukminibai Hospital treated 58 dog-bite patients on Sunday and 103 by Monday afternoon; 46 with deep, bleeding wounds were admitted. Anti-rabies vaccines/injections are available stock at the hospital. KDMC officials, including Commissioner Abhinav Goyal and Mayor Harshali Thavil, visited the dog sterilisation center and ordered speeding up sterilisation and vaccination of caught dogs. Residents blame the authorities; political leaders demanded quicker action. The infection risk includes potential rabies; no laboratory confirmation mentioned; no fatalities reported in article.

triage.headline_ja: 24時間で161人が咬まれる：カリヤンで野良犬の脅威、病院が対応に追われる
triage.triage_reason: 野良犬による咬傷事件であり、狂犬病の検査確認や死亡例の報告はない。地域的・一時的な動物咬傷対応事案であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病の検査確認は記事内で言及されておらず、死亡例もない。野良犬による集団咬傷事件であり、地方自治体（KDMC）が不妊化・ワクチン接種の対応を進めている。感染症としてのシグナルよりも動物管理・公共安全の問題としての側面が強い。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात में चांदीपुरा वायरस के 225 संदिग्ध मामले, मरने वालों की संख्या बढ़कर 25 हुई - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Gujarat, 225 suspected Chandipura virus cases, death toll rises to 25 - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus outbreak in Gujarat, India, with 225 suspected cases since June 30 and 212 awaiting lab results as of August 10, 2026. Laboratory confirmation stands at 39 cases, with 25 deaths among confirmed patients (up from 22). Earlier figures reported 184 suspected, 35 confirmed, and 22 deaths. First detected in Panchmahal district in early July after two child deaths; outbreak subsequently expanded across districts during the monsoon. Chandipura virus is a vector-borne infection transmitted mainly by sandflies and can cause acute encephalitis syndrome in children; all confirmed cases were under 15 years in the prior report. Health authorities, including Health Minister Praful Pansearia, are enhancing surveillance, reviewing travel histories, and strengthening vector control. 13 pending lab results could adjust confirmed case counts; monitoring continues across Gujarat.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルスの疑い例225件、死亡者数25人に増加
triage.triage_reason: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルスによる脳炎症候群が拡大し、死亡者数が増加している（確定39例中25死亡）。小児を中心に重症化率が高く、複数地域に拡大している点でIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介性で、過去にもグジャラート州で流行歴があるが、今回は6月30日以降225疑い例・39確定例・25死亡と規模が大きく、小児の死亡率が高い点で注視が必要。ヒト-ヒト感染は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात में चांदीपुरा वायरस के 225 संदिग्ध मामले, मरने वालों की संख्या बढ़कर 25 हुई
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Gujarat, 225 suspected Chandipura virus cases; the death toll has risen to 25.
article.articleSummary: Gujarat, India, reports 225 suspected Chandipura virus cases from June 30 to August 10, with 39 lab-confirmed infections and 25 deaths among confirmed cases. Of the 225 suspects, 212 have been lab-tested and results for 13 samples are pending, so the confirmed tally could still rise. Chandipura virus is vector-borne, spread mainly by sandflies, and can cause acute encephalitis syndrome in children; outbreaks peak during the monsoon. The first signals appeared in Panchmahal district in July after two child deaths, prompting intensified surveillance, testing, and vector-control measures, with cases later detected across the state. On July 20, 63 suspected cases were reported, 12 positives, eight samples pending. By early August, the state had 184 suspected, 35 confirmed, and 22 deaths. Health Minister Pansearia said authorities continue monitoring, review travel history, and strengthen vector-control; 13 lab results remain awaited. Earlier reports noted all confirmed patients were under 15.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルスの疑い例225件、死者数25人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 小児を中心とした急性脳炎症候群の集団発生で死亡例が多数（確認例39件中25人死亡）、公衆衛生への影響が深刻でIHR基準を2つ満たすためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介の既知の病原体でモンスーン期に周期的に発生するが、今回は死亡率が高く（確認例の約64%）、小児への影響が大きい点で注視が必要。国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात में चांदीपुरा वायरस के 225 संदिग्ध मामले, मरने वालों की संख्या बढ़कर 25 हुई | Gujarat records 225 suspected Chandipura cases; death toll rises to 25 (Photo: IANS)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gujarat records 225 suspected Chandipura virus cases; death toll rises to 25 (Photo: IANS).
article.articleSummary: Gujarat has 225 suspected Chandipura virus cases since June 30, with 39 lab-confirmed infections and 25 deaths among confirmed patients as of Aug 10, 2026. Of the 225 suspected cases, 212 have been lab-tested and 13 samples await results, so the confirmed count could rise. The outbreak began in Panchmahal district, where early July deaths of two children prompted intensified surveillance, testing, and vector-control measures. By July 20, 63 suspected cases were reported, 12 were positive, with results for eight more samples pending. Health Minister Praful Panseeriya said authorities are closely monitoring areas, reviewing travel histories, and strengthening vector-control. By August, Gujarat recorded 184 suspected cases, 35 confirmed infections, and 22 deaths; all confirmed patients were under 15 years, and cases across multiple districts. Chandipura virus is vector-borne, transmitted mainly by sandflies, and can cause acute encephalitis in children during the monsoon; rapid lab confirmation and hospital care are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルス感染疑い225例、死者25人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 小児を中心に高い致死率（確定39例中25死亡）を示すチャンディプラウイルス（媒介性脳炎）の集団発生であり、IHR基準の重大性・異常性を満たすためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介の急性脳炎で、モンスーン期にグジャラート州の小児に多発。死亡例は全例15歳未満で確定患者の致死率が高い。国際的拡大の可能性は低いが、国内公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事案。

article.articleHeadline: Inside Mongbwalu: Where DR Congo's Ebola fight began
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Mongbwalu, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, identified as the Bundibugyo strain. Mongbwalu, a high-traffic mining area with about 140,000 residents, is believed by WHO to be the outbreak’s origin, with population movement complicating transmission. The episode notes a recovery: Deogratias Kasereka was the first Ebola patient cured in Mongbwalu and, on that day, the only patient to recover among all confirmed Ebola cases; others died. Kasereka now travels through local communities urging quick recognition of Ebola symptoms and prompt treatment. Response efforts are hampered by insecurity, weak infrastructure, and funding shortages. Healthcare workers have faced attacks, including the burning of a treatment tent in May, which undermines care-seeking. Security guarantees are deemed essential to ensure an effective response and sustained outbreak containment.

triage.headline_ja: モングワル潜入:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応が始まった場所
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北東部モングワルでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の発生は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、治安・資金不足により対応が困難で国際支援が必要な状況にある。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のエボラ出血熱流行に関する現地ルポであり、感染拡大そのものの新規報告ではないが、治安悪化・医療従事者への攻撃・資金不足など対応上の重大な懸念が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: DRK: Epidemia eboli trwa od lutego
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRK: The Ebola epidemic has been ongoing since February.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been ongoing since February, revised from May according to AP reporting cited by the World Health Organization. Government data record 4,200 cases and 1,900 deaths. WHO Africa regional director Dr. Mohamed Yakub Janabi said viral sequencing traced the outbreak to February, clarifying that early hemorrhagic fever cases were misclassified as typhoid or malaria. The corrected timeline emphasizes that transmission began earlier than widely recognized, affecting outbreak response and case finding. The report highlights the importance of laboratory confirmation and genomic sequencing in identifying the true onset and tracking spread within DR Congo. No details on transmission sources or exported/imported cases are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: DRK：エボラ出血熱の流行は2月から続いている
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の流行が2月から継続しており、4,200例・1,900名の死亡という高い致死率を伴う重大な公衆衛生事象であり、当初の診断が誤分類されていた点も異常性が高い。
triage.notes: 感染源・輸出例に関する情報は記事に記載がなく不明。WHOによる遺伝子配列解析で発症時期が2月に遡ることが判明し、当初はチフスやマラリアと誤診されていた点が特徴的。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo volta a acender alerta no Brasil: quem precisa se vacinar? Veja perguntas e respostas sobre a doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Again Raises Alarm in Brazil: Who Needs to Get Vaccinated? See Questions and Answers About the Disease.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in Brazil total 24 (Aug 7): 23 in São Paulo state and 1 in Rio de Janeiro. Two cases were imported; the rest are linked to importation, with sources unidentified. The rise mirrors increased measles activity in the Americas, including the U.S.’s 35-year high. Health authorities say declining vaccination coverage—and antivaccine misinformation—facilitates spread. In São Paulo, Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo temporarily offer the measles vaccine for residents aged six months to 59 years, regardless of vaccination history, to interrupt transmission. Measles is highly contagious, potentially transmitting to up to 90% of susceptible contacts via airborne spread, from six days before to four days after rash onset. Symptoms include high fever and red rash; cough, conjunctivitis, and malaise may occur; pneumonia and encephalitis are possible complications, with immune suppression. Routine vaccination remains two doses (MMR): 12 and 15 months; adolescents/adults with incomplete schedules should start or complete.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで麻疹が再び警戒レベルに:誰がワクチン接種が必要か?麻疹に関する質問と回答
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹症例が増加し(24例)、ワクチン接種率の低下と誤情報により感染しやすい状況が続いており、米州全体での麻疹活動増加と連動した国際的拡大の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはスペイン・カナリア諸島・米国が含まれているが、記事本文はブラジル国内(サンパウロ州・リオデジャネイロ州)の麻疹症例増加が主題であり、これらの国は主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: बालाघाट में मलेरिया-डायरिया से बैगा अंचल बेहाल, 7 बच्चों की मौत; 45 बच्चे अस्पताल में भर्ती
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Balaghat, the Baiga belt is hit by malaria and diarrhea; 7 children dead, 45 children admitted to hospital.
article.articleSummary: Malaria, diarrhea, typhoid, pneumonia, and skin infections are affecting children in Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, India, particularly in Baiga belt villages of Korka, Bondari, Kundeksa, and Adori in the Birsa area during the monsoon. In the last ~1.5 months, 7 children (ages about 4–10) have died, while 45 children are admitted at the district hospital, many in serious condition. Health teams have been deployed to screen and treat pediatric patients, and to promote clean water, sanitation, and preventive measures during the rainy season. Medical College Jabalpur and ICMR Jabalpur teams visited to assess health and sanitation issues. Local MLA Anubha Munjare and Civil Surgeon Dr. Nilay Jain announced ongoing surveillance and care to identify cases early and prevent further spread and outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: バラガートでマラリアと下痢によりバイガ地区が混乱、子供7人死亡、45人入院
triage.triage_reason: インド・マディヤプラデーシュ州の先住民族地区でマラリア・下痢・腸チフス等の季節性感染症により小児7人死亡・45人入院と重症例が多いが、地域限定的な発生で国際的拡大のリスクは低く、続報を注視すべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にChad、Ukraineが含まれるが記事内容と無関係（BluedotのGeo付与ミスと思われる）。実際の発生地はインド・マディヤプラデーシュ州バラガート地区のBaiga部族地域（Korka、Bondari等の村）。モンスーン期の季節性疾患の集団発生であり、地元医療チームと保健当局が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Boletim Epidemiológico: MS registra 9.832 casos confirmados de chikungunya - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã - MS e Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemiological Bulletin: Mato Grosso do Sul records 9,832 confirmed chikungunya cases - Ponta Porã Informs - News from Ponta Porã - Mato Grosso do Sul and Pedro Juan Caballero, Paraguay.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10 (week 30), Mato Grosso do Sul reports 12,579 probable chikungunya cases in 2026, with 9,832 laboratory-confirmed and 30 chikungunya deaths across Dourados, Bonito, Jardim, Fátima do Sul, Douradina, Guia Lopes da Laguna, Itaporã, Ponta Porã, and Nioaque; 114 confirmed chikungunya cases occur in pregnant women. Dengue totals reach 4,669 probable and 1,873 confirmed, including one dengue death in Bonito and one death under investigation. In the prior 14 days, confirmed dengue incidence is low in Novo Horizonte do Sul, Juti, Paranhos, Rochedo, Bodoquena, Mundo Novo, and Ponta Porã. Dengue vaccination data: 241,030 doses received, 223,322 administered, with 201,349 in the target population. The two-dose schedule (three months apart) targets ages 10–14 years, 11 months and 29 days, a group with high dengue hospitalizations (6–16 years). Public guidance: seek care for symptoms, avoid self-medication, and eliminate water-holding containers to curb Aedes aegypti breeding.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学速報：マットグロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニア熱確定例9,832件を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部州における定期疫学速報で、チクングニア熱・デング熱の症例数と死亡例（合計31名）が報告されているが、毎年見られる季節性のベクター媒介感染症の通常の流行パターンであり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。継続的な症例増加と死亡例のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 地方州（Mato Grosso do Sul）の公式疫学速報に基づく記事。チクングニア熱・デング熱ともにブラジルで毎年流行する既知の蚊媒介感染症であり、ワクチン接種など対策も進行中。国レベルでの新規異常事象ではなく、地域の定期モニタリング事案と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola started in DR Congo earlier and officials are playing catch-up, WHO warns
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo began at least three months before the May 15 declaration, with WHO warning authorities are still chasing the virus. Since declaration, more than 1,900 deaths and 4,294 confirmed cases (1,960 deaths) have been reported by DR Congo’s health ministry. The epicentre is in the east, where insecurity hampers control efforts and health workers reach only about 30% of cases, leaving many to die at home. The virus likely began spreading in February and was initially misdiagnosed as malaria or typhoid. Traditional burial practices and distrust of authorities complicate containment. There are now several dedicated treatment centres and faster diagnosis, but no approved vaccine or recognized therapeutics for Bundibugyo. The 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak remains the largest on record with 11,325 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行、当局は後手に回っているとWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当（重症度高・管理困難・流行しやすさ）。WHOが公式に警告し国際メディアで報道されているため社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRC（特に東部）のみに言及しており、Angolaでの発生は確認されていないため除外した。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में H1N1 का तांडव: मानसून में पांच गुना बढ़े मामले, बच्चों और बुजुर्गों के लिए बढ़ा खतरा - h1n1 cases soar 5x in delhi monsoon children most affected
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 havoc in Delhi: cases rise fivefold during the monsoon, danger to children and the elderly has increased.
article.articleSummary: As of August 10, 2026, Delhi’s H1N1 (Swine Flu) cases have surged during the monsoon, reaching 1,344 this season—about five times higher than 229 cases last year. Children are most affected; common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, breathing difficulty, and fatigue. July saw 11 confirmed cases at Safdarjung Hospital, with additional cases reported in August; PSRI and other private hospitals also note sharp rises. Government hospitals such as RML, Lok Nayak, and GTB are treating flu-like patients, with suspected cases tested per NCDC guidelines. A private hospital reported the death of a four-year-old girl with H1N1 and a rare brain complication. Transmission is human-to-human influenza A; not mosquito-borne, and the virus can mutate. Preventive measures include masks, hand hygiene, ventilation, avoiding crowds, consulting doctors promptly, avoiding self-medication with antibiotics, and vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1が猛威：モンスーン期に感染者数が5倍増加、子供と高齢者への危険が増大
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1感染者数がモンスーン期に前年比5倍に急増し、小児の死亡例も報告されており、ヒト-ヒト感染と重症化リスクからWPRO基準を複数満たし社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: H1N1はインドで季節性流行を繰り返している既知の病原体だが、今季デリーでの5倍増加と小児死亡例（稀な脳合併症）は注視すべき動向。国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: Metrô de SP terá campanha de vacinação contra sarampo em cinco estações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo Metro Will Host a Measles Vaccination Campaign at Five Stations.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination campaign using the measles-mumps-rubella (triple viral) vaccine will be offered at five São Paulo Metro stations from Aug 10 to Aug 28. Stations: Corinthians-Itaquera (Line 3) and São Mateus (Line 15) will vaccinate on Aug 17, 19, and 21 from 10:00 to 20:00; Vila Prudente (Lines 2 and 15) from Aug 17–21, 10:00–16:00; Tucuruvi (Line 1) from Aug 10–14 and Aug 17–21, 10:00–16:00; Vila Matilde (Line 3) on Aug 27–28, 10:00–16:00. Tucuruvi is highlighted as the most important site due to recent measles cases in the North zone. The São Paulo Municipal Health Secretariat aims to improve access during commuting and boost citywide vaccination coverage. Information provided by Agência Brasil.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ地下鉄、5駅で麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ北部地域での麻疹発生を受けたワクチン接種キャンペーンの案内記事であり、感染拡大の規模や重症度に関する情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種キャンペーンの案内が主であり、麻疹の症例数・重症度・死亡等の具体的な疫学情報は記載されていない。Tucuruvi地区で最近麻疹症例があったとの言及のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Nécessité d'intensifier la sensibilisation contre Ebola dans les cours et tribunaux à Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Need to intensify Ebola awareness in the courts and tribunals in Beni - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola awareness in courts and tribunals in Beni, North Kivu, DR Congo, should be intensified. Me Muhindo Lwanga, a lawyer near the Beni TGI, highlights large courtroom attendance and urges judicial authorities to strengthen preventive messaging. Measures already in place include handwashing stations in courts, prosecutors’ offices, and prisons, with emphasis on barrier measures to halt transmission; the central Beni Kangbayi prison also uses such devices, and a physician is on site to care for detainees before potential hospital transfer. He notes no specific circulars from professional bodies yet, but the bar association leadership is ready to back awareness efforts. Residents of Beni and Butembo are urged to educate Bunia and others, stressing family dialogue on prevention. Health professionals should also inform the prison population. Previous Ebola outbreaks in Beni/Butembo have caused social and economic disruption; community engagement and robust media coverage are pivotal to defeat the disease.

triage.headline_ja: ベニの裁判所・法廷におけるエボラ啓発強化の必要性 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラは重大な感染症だが、本記事は北キブ州ベニの裁判所での啓発活動に関する内容で、新規感染者数や死亡者数など具体的な流行状況データは示されていないため、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既存の予防対策（手洗い設備、法曹関係者の啓発活動等）の強化を促す内容であり、新規発生や患者数の記載はない。DRCは過去に複数回エボラ流行を経験しており、現状の疫学状況を確認するための続報監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie eboly, která byla oficiálně vyhlášena 15. května, vypukla v Kongu již v únoru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak, which was officially declared on May 15, had already broken out in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as early as February.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak officially declared on May 15 had already emerged in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as early as February. Health officials warn the Ebola virus in Congo could mutate, prompting plans to greatly broaden containment measures. The strategy includes door-to-door outreach and active case finding to identify infected individuals. In a separate development, Moroccan authorities have started investigations into about 90 people linked to events in Ceuta, the Spanish enclave, where last week, per Spanish authorities, 72,000 people illegally crossed from Morocco. The Moroccan human-rights group AMDH reported the numbers involved, though authorities did not disclose how many are under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 5月15日に公式発表されたエボラ出血熱の流行は、実は2月にはすでにコンゴ民主共和国で発生していた
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行が公式発表前から数ヶ月間潜行していたことが判明し、ウイルス変異の懸念も報告されているため、公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事後半のセウタ（スペイン領）・モロッコに関する内容はエボラとは無関係の別ニュースであり、感染症イベントとしては対象外。発生地域リストに含まれるCeuta/Spain/Moroccoは主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 30 Suspected Dengue Cases Reported In Ulhasnagar, Civic Body Intensifies Monsoon Health Measures
article.articleSummary: Ulhasnagar reports 30 suspected dengue cases based on data from private laboratories, prompting intensified monsoon health measures. Waterlogging from open drains, leaking pipelines, and inadequate drainage raises mosquito breeding risk, with malaria also a concern during the monsoon. Health department reviews led by Health Committee Chair Savita Torane-Ragde and Medical Health Officer Satyam Gupta plan intensified inspections to identify breeding sites around homes, including stagnant water, uncovered water tanks, flower pots, discarded tyres, and other containers. Cleanliness drives and public awareness campaigns are being reinforced, with residents urged to observe a weekly ‘dry day’ to empty and clean water storage containers and prevent stagnation. Authorities will deepen vector-control efforts across Ulhasnagar and maintain ongoing monitoring, relying on public cooperation to prevent further spread of dengue and other seasonal diseases during the monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: ウルハスナガルでデング熱疑い例30件が報告、市当局がモンスーン期の健康対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 地域限定的な季節性デング疑い例の増加であり、通常のモンスーン対応の範囲内で異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 毎年モンスーン期に見られる典型的なデング・マラリア対策の記事であり、症例数も少なく重症度・死亡例の報告はない。地元当局のみで対応可能な事案。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo volta a acender alerta no Brasil: quem precisa se vacinar? Veja perguntas e respostas sobre a doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles once again raises alarm in Brazil: who needs to be vaccinated? See questions and answers about the disease.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Brazil with airborne transmission capable of infecting up to 90% of nearby non-immune individuals. Contagious from six days before to four days after rash onset. Classic symptoms include high fever and red blotchy rash, plus cough, conjunctivitis, and malaise; rash often starts on the face and behind the ears. Complications can be severe: pneumonia in about 1 in 20 children and acute encephalitis in 1–4 per 1,000 cases, with potential involvement of lungs and other organs and temporary immune suppression. Routine vaccination uses two MMR doses: first at 12 months and second at 15 months. For unvaccinated or partially vaccinated adolescents and adults, start or complete two doses after health evaluation. In São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, a campaign now invites people aged 6 months to 59 years to vaccinate regardless of history to quickly raise coverage; a dose zero is given to 6–11 month olds in these cities, not replacing routine doses. If unsure about vaccination, visit a vaccination unit to verify doses post-1 year.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで麻疹への警戒再燃：ワクチン接種が必要な人は誰か？疾患に関する質疑応答
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ周辺で麻疹の再流行がみられ、複数都市でワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されるなど行政の対応が取られており、重症化リスク（肺炎・脳炎）や高い感染力から要注意事案と判断。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため採用。記事は主にサンパウロ州・グアルーリョス・サンベルナルド・ド・カンポでの麻疹再流行とワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する内容で、教育的側面が強いが行政対応（大規模接種キャンペーン）が実施されている点から監視継続が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: जमशेदपुर में 72 घंटे में डेंगू के 2 नए मामले, मलेरिया जांच में मिले 38 मरीज; पोटका बना मलेरिया का हॉटस्पॉट - jamshedpur dengue malaria surge 2 dengue 38 malaria cases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two new dengue cases in Jamshedpur within 72 hours; 38 malaria patients detected in malaria testing; Potka has become a malaria hotspot.
article.articleSummary: As of 10 August 2026, dengue cases in Jamshedpur and nearby areas rose, with two new infections in 72 hours. An 11-year-old in Sitaramdera tested positive at MGM Medical College lab after fever, body pains and weakness; a earlier case involved a TMH Nursing Hostel student. Health authorities ordered intensified cleaning, regular fogging and larvicidal spraying, and directed hospitals to maintain dengue isolation wards. Civil Surgeon Dr. Sahir Pal urged residents to prevent water stagnation and seek prompt medical care for fever. Malaria reports show 38 new infections from 5,119 tested samples, with Plasmodium falciparum 31 and Plasmodium vivax 7. Potka is now a malaria hotspot with 11 cases, followed by Patmda (9) and Musabani (6). Emphasis remains on vector-control and surveillance during the monsoon to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプルで72時間以内にデング熱新規2例、マラリア検査で38人陽性；ポトカがマラリアのホットスポットに
triage.triage_reason: 地域的な季節性のデング熱・マラリア感染増加であり、既存の対策（防疫措置・監視強化）で対応可能な範囲。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節における媒介蚊由来感染症（デング熱・マラリア）の地域的増加であり、地元当局が防疫対応（燻蒸、幼虫駆除、隔離病棟整備）を実施中。重症例や死亡の報告はなく、既存の公衆衛生対応能力内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Une aide américaine de 242 millions de dollars face à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. aid of $242 million to tackle Ebola.
article.articleSummary: US announces 242 million dollars in aid to tackle Ebola in the DRC and Uganda, funding immediate response, prevention, and humanitarian relief. By August 8, the DRC faced its largest Ebola outbreak in its history, with about 4,200 confirmed cases and 1,916 deaths; Uganda had said it was no longer affected by late July. WHO warns the true case load could be three to four times higher, keeping cross-border transmission risk elevated. The State Department frames the funding as protecting Americans, and the CDC has imposed a 21-day entry restriction for anyone who has been in the DRC. Separately, some US observers tie aid to renewing mining talks over cobalt, coltan, and copper, amid concerns about mineral access. Ituri hosts most confirmed cases, while North Kivu and South Kivu include key mining sites. Despite questions about motives, Congolese see the aid as vital to ending Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策に2億4200万ドルの米国支援
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行（確定約4,200例、死亡1,916人）が継続し、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクが高い上、米CDCが入国制限を課すなど渡航制限も発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは7月末時点で感染終息と報告されているため、現時点での発生国としてはDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。米国は資金援助国であり感染発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en el Congo comenzó meses antes de declararse: OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo began months before it was declared: WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo began in February and was declared in mid-May; sequencing shows the virus started earlier than officially acknowledged. In Bunia and the eastern DRC, response teams note that early cases were misattributed to malaria and typhoid fever. WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Yakub Janabi said the outbreak is the fastest-growing on record, with 4,200 confirmed Ebola cases and over 1,900 deaths as of August 10, 2026. Incident manager Thierno Balde and virology lead Steve Ahuka of the INRB oversaw genetic sequencing to track spread. The article underscores that the virus has been advancing ahead of public detection, highlighting the need for rapid surveillance and response to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の発生は、WHOが宣言するより数ヶ月前に始まっていた
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が確認され、感染確認4,200例・死亡1,900例超と深刻な公衆衛生被害があり、初期検知の遅れやヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクが高いためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: WHOが『史上最速の拡大』と評価しており、初期症例がマラリアや腸チフスと誤診されていたことが検知の遅れにつながった点が重要な示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | понедельник: Украина, Колумбия, Йемен, Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top News of the Day | Monday: Ukraine, Colombia, Yemen, Ebola
article.articleSummary: Civilian casualties across Ukraine over the last three days, including children, with humanitarian work disrupted. In Dnipro, a World Health Organization warehouse was destroyed; in Kherson region a World Food Programme partner’s truck was hit, as aid agencies continue assistance. Colombia experienced a 7.4-magnitude earthquake centered in the central region; tremors felt nationwide, with rural outages and evacuations underway; media report dozens killed; the UN is prepared to assist. Yemen faces the highest risk of renewed large‑scale conflict since April 2022, with UN Special Envoy Hans Grundberg urging restraint and de‑escalation talks under UN auspices. Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused over 1,900 deaths, with 60–70% dying at home due to long travel distances and lack of nearby facilities; WHO emphasizes improving access to care.

triage.headline_ja: 本日の主要ニュース｜月曜日：ウクライナ、コロンビア、イエメン、エボラ出血熱
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ出血熱流行で死者1,900人超、うち60-70%が医療施設に届かず自宅で死亡しているとの報告があり、重症度・アクセス問題・支援必要性の観点からWPRO基準を複数満たすため、フルリスク評価への移行を推奨。
triage.notes: 本記事は国連の日次ニュース総合記事であり、ウクライナ・コロンビア・イエメンの話題も含むが、対象国リストに合致するのはDRCのエボラのみ。エボラの新規発生ではなく既存流行の継続報告と見られるため、続報や既存RRAとの重複確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la RDC se rapproche de 2000 décès (rapport)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the DRC nears 2,000 deaths (report).
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues with five provinces and 53 health zones affected. Ituri Province includes health zones Aru, Bunia, Drodro, Mangala, Tchomia, and others; North Kivu includes Beni, Goma, Butembo, Katwa, Mabalako, Lubero; Sud-Kivu reports Miti-Murhesa as the sole affected zone, with 73 days without a new confirmed case; Haut-Uele zones include Isiro, Boma Mangbetu, Pawa, Rungu, and Wamba; Tshopo includes Makiso-Kisangani, Wanie-Rukula, Bafwasende, Kabondo, Lubunga. Cumulative confirmed cases: 4,294; currently isolating or hospitalized: 722; recovered: 849; deaths: 1,960; overall case fatality rate: 45.6%; contact tracing coverage: 84.6%. Ongoing surveillance and case investigation are maintained, with suspected cases transferred to treatment or isolation. Community mobilization and risk communication are underway, including outreach to traders, households, community leaders, and moto-taxi drivers, plus home visits and rumor clarification.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:コンゴ民主共和国、死者数が2000人に近づく(報告)
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5州53保健地域にわたるエボラ出血熱の流行が継続し、死者1,960人・CFR45.6%と深刻な公衆衛生被害が生じており、国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクもあるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 多州にわたる大規模エボラ流行で死亡者数が2000人に迫る状況。CFRが45.6%と非常に高く、接触者追跡率は84.6%。継続的な監視・地域動員が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie eboly v Kongu měsíce unikala pozornosti, vypukla už v únoru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo went unnoticed for months and broke out as early as February
article.articleSummary: As of August 10, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, officially declared May 15, began as early as February. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no approved vaccines or treatments. The outbreak has reached about 4,200 confirmed cases and over 1,900 deaths, making it the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history. It has spread from Ituri into North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo, and crossed into neighboring Uganda. Early cases were misattributed to malaria and typhoid. Health teams contend with strikes over unpaid wages, armed conflict, misinformation denying Ebola, PPE shortages, and large displaced populations with limited water for handwashing. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, organ damage, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、数か月間注目を逃れていた—実際は2月に発生
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が約4,200例・1,900人以上の死亡に達し、ウガンダへも越境した史上最速拡大の流行であり、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、武力衝突やスト等で対応が困難なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、越境拡大の事実は国際的拡大リスクの評価に反映した。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株による史上最速の流行であり、武力衝突・ストライキ・誤情報・PPE不足など対応上の重大な障害が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: MS chega a quase 10 mil casos confirmados de chikungunya em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Reaches Nearly 10,000 Confirmed Chikungunya Cases in 2026
article.articleSummary: Published 2026-08-10: Mato Grosso do Sul reports 9,832 confirmed chikungunya cases and 30 deaths in 2026, with over 12,500 probable infections, per the 30th epidemiological week bulletin. Fatalities occurred in Dourados, Bonito, Jardim, Fátima do Sul, Douradina, Guia Lopes da Laguna, Itaporã, Ponta Porã and Nioaque; 114 chikungunya cases have been confirmed in pregnant women. Dengue totals include 1,873 confirmed cases and one death in Bonito, with another death under investigation; probable dengue exceeds 4,600. In the last 14 days, low incidence was recorded in Novo Horizonte do Sul, Juti, Paranhos, Rochedo, Bodoquena, Mundo Novo and Ponta Porã. Health authorities urge seeking care for symptoms and avoid self-medication. Dengue vaccination has delivered over 241,000 doses, with 223,322 administered in 2026 (201,349 in the target group). The two-dose vaccine requires a three-month interval; the 10–14-year-olds, 11 months 29 days, are the primary vaccination segment, which bears the most hospitalizations (6–16 years).

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州、2026年のチクングニア熱確定例が1万人近くに達する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州における季節性のチクングニア熱・デング熱の流行報告であり、死者・重症例は一定数あるが、既存の公的サーベイランス・ワクチン接種対応が進行中であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないため、続報を注視するレベルと判断。
triage.notes: 季節性の蚊媒介性感染症（チクングニア熱・デング熱）の年次流行報告。ワクチン接種プログラムが既に実施中であり、州保健当局による定期的なサーベイランス体制下にある。妊婦感染例（114件）や死亡例（30件）があるが、地域的拡大や異常な特徴は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura inicia mapeamento de casas para implantação de armadilhas de Aedes aegypti em Boa Vista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall begins household mapping for deployment of Aedes aegypti traps in Boa Vista.
article.articleSummary: Boa Vista, Brazil, began mapping homes for ovitrampas to monitor Aedes aegypti as part of a targeted arbovirus surveillance program. Over 14 neighborhoods with higher numbers of probable dengue, Zika and chikungunya cases—Alvorada, Caranã, Cauamé, Cidade Satélite, Dr. Silvio Botelho, Dr. Silvio Leite, Jardim Equatorial, Jóquei Clube, Nova Cidade, Pintolândia, Raiar do Sol, Santa Tereza, Senador Hélio Campos and São Bento—will be surveyed this week to identify installation sites. Installation starts on Aug 17. Ovitrampas lure female mosquitoes to lay eggs, enabling the city to map vector presence and intensify prevention accordingly. About five to seven days after installation, the inner palettes will be collected for analysis, informing measures across city regions. Consent from residents is required; agents gather signatures and provide home-care guidance. Do not remove traps or obstruct entry; continue eliminating standing water and maintaining clean yards.

triage.headline_ja: ボア・ヴィスタ市、ネッタイシマカ捕獲器設置に向け家屋マッピングを開始
triage.triage_reason: 通常のベクター監視・予防活動に関する行政広報であり、異常発生や重症例報告はなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の媒介蚊監視プログラムの実施報告であり、症例数増加や流行拡大を示す具体的データはない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、通常の予防活動報告のためverified_locationsには含めない判断も可能だが、疾患自体はブラジルで発生している媒介蚊対策の文脈のため実質的にイベントとしての重大性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 10 bairros de Boa Vista vão receber armadilhas contra mosquito da dengue; saiba quais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 10 neighborhoods in Boa Vista will receive traps to combat dengue-carrying mosquitoes; find out which ones.
article.articleSummary: Boa Vista, Brazil will deploy ovitraps in 14 neighborhoods to monitor the dengue, Zika, and chikungunya vector, Aedes aegypti. The selected areas—Alvorada, Caranã, Cauamé, Cidade Satélite, Dr. Silvio Botelho, Dr. Silvio Leite, Jardim Equatorial, Jóquei Clube, Nova Cidade, Pintolândia, Raiar do Sol, Santa Tereza, Senador Hélio Campos and São Bento—were chosen due to higher numbers of probable arboviral cases. Installations begin Monday, August 17, 2026, after mapping started August 10; Endemic Disease Control agents will visit residences to identify those eligible to receive ovitraps, with installation contingent on homeowner authorization. Ovitraps attract gravid female Aedes aegypti to lay eggs; collected paddles inside the traps will indicate mosquito presence and circulation across the city. About 5–7 days post-installation, paddles are retrieved for analysis. After installation, traps must not be moved; residents should continue eliminating standing water and keeping yards clean.

triage.headline_ja: ボア・ビスタの10以上の地区にデング熱媒介蚊対策の捕獲器が設置される予定。対象地区を確認
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の媒介蚊対策として通常の公衆衛生モニタリング活動（オビトラップ設置）を報じる内容であり、異常な流行や重篤な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は媒介蚊監視のための通常の予防的対策（オビトラップ設置）についての内容であり、具体的な感染者数や重症例、アウトブレイクの規模に関する記述はない。地域の保健当局による日常的な対応であり、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉确诊病例超4200例 病死率达45.5%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 4,200; case fatality rate reaches 45.5%.
article.articleSummary: As of August 10, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Bundibugyo-type Ebola virus disease outbreak has reached 4,209 confirmed cases and 1,916 deaths (case-fatality rate 45.5%), per the DRC Ministry of Health. World Health Organization analyses indicate transmission began well before official notification, with genome sequencing suggesting the virus circulated as early as February and the outbreak formally declared on May 15. WHO warns the virus is spreading more rapidly and calls for strengthened control measures. The public health response has shifted from traditional contact tracing to door-to-door, area-wide screening to identify hidden infections. Officials expect that expanded surveillance will drive reported cases higher in the coming weeks as coverage broadens and more communities are screened.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定例が4,200例超、致死率45.5%に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（確定例4,209例、致死率45.5%）で、WHOが感染拡大を警告しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: WHOはウイルスの伝播が公式発表前の2月頃から始まっていた可能性を指摘し、感染拡大速度の増加と対策強化を要請。ドアツードアの地域一斉スクリーニングにより今後さらに報告数が増加する見込み。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors report 20-30% rise in influenza and other viral fever cases across city
article.articleSummary: Pune records a 20% rise in influenza and other viral fever cases this monsoon month, with vector-borne fevers (dengue, chikungunya) remaining substantial. Patients of all ages are affected; some require hospitalisation, especially those with comorbidities. Dr. Anand Kalaskar notes more than 10 daily viral-fever/ILI visits, up from prior weeks, and fever-related consultations up about 30% from last month. Unhealthy food and contaminated water, alongside monsoon conditions, contribute. Common symptoms include sudden fever, headaches, body pains, dry cough and high fever; chikungunya may show prominent joint pain. Eastern parts of the city report a similar rise. Clinicians warn against self-medication until dengue is ruled out, avoiding aspirin or ibuprofen due to bleeding risk. Hospitalization is advised for dehydration, breathing difficulty, severe weakness, repeated vomiting, bleeding or altered sensorium. First-line care emphasizes bed rest, hydration, and timely medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 医師らがインフルエンザおよびその他のウイルス性発熱の症例が市内で20〜30%増加していると報告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のインフルエンザ・デング・チクングニアの増加が報告されているが、通常のモンスーン期の傾向であり異常性や国際的拡大リスクは低い。地域内での継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: プネー市内でのモンスーン季節性のインフルエンザ・デング熱・チクングニア熱の増加報告。重症化例や入院例もあるが、地域内での通常の季節的増加とみられ、国際的な懸念は現時点で低い。続報があれば経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Outbreak Passes 4,000 Cases as Most New Infections Fall Outside Known Contact Chains
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases (4,053) and 1,850 deaths through Aug. 5, with 694 hospitalized. Across 53 of 140 health zones in five provinces (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo), 60–70% of new infections arise from community transmission not on contact lists, signaling major surveillance gaps. Contact tracing is not working; only 59% of contacts traced in Ituri; 90% of admitted patients were not previously monitored. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved targeted treatment; early supportive care improves survival. Transmission occurs in households, markets, health facilities, and during unsafe funerals; 63% of deaths occur outside treatment centers. CDC says no US cases and very low importation risk. Speed to 1,000+ cases in 40 days (17th Ebola outbreak in DRC).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が4000例を超える、新規感染の大半は既知の接触チェーン外で発生
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,053例・1,850死亡に達し、新規感染の60-70%が接触者追跡外のコミュニティ感染であり、サーベイランス機能不全と拡大継続が確認されるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国(United States)はCDCコメントとしてのみ言及され、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。ワクチン・承認治療薬がないBundibugyoウイルスによる大規模流行で、コンタクトトレーシングが破綻している点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Leishmaniose: Botucatu reforça alerta sobre transmissão e prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leishmaniasis: Botucatu reinforces warning about transmission and prevention.
article.articleSummary: Leishmaniasis in Botucatu, Brazil, is being addressed during the National Week of Control and Combat, with municipal health and animal health teams reiterating prevention, transmission, and signs in dogs. The disease affects animals and humans but is not dog-to-human directly; transmission occurs via a sand fly bite from an infected animal to a person or another animal. Infected dogs may show weight loss, non-healing wounds, hair loss, overgrown nails, fatigue, appetite loss, enlarged lymph nodes, and eye changes; some dogs are asymptomatic. Sand flies thrive in moist, shaded areas with decomposing organic matter; reduce risk by clearing debris, keeping yards clean, and managing animal habitats. Regular veterinary checks and protective measures (collars, repellents) are advised. Botucatu has intensified visceral leishmaniasis surveillance under a One Health approach to curb transmission among humans, animals, and the environment.

triage.headline_ja: リーシュマニア症:ボトゥカトゥ市が感染経路と予防について注意喚起を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル対象国だが地域啓発活動を伝える通常の公衆衛生広報記事であり、新規発生や異常な拡大の情報はない。
triage.notes: 内容は地方自治体による定期的な啓発・予防キャンペーンであり、感染者数の急増や異常発生を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Stray dog-bite crisis in UP: Lucknow gives 15k anti-rabies shots a month, Ghaziabad 10k
article.articleSummary: UP grapples with a stray dog-bite crisis as anti-rabies vaccination campaigns show high exposure. Lucknow averages 15,000 post-exposure shots monthly, Ghaziabad about 10,000 (Jan 2024–Sept 2025), with Lucknow sometimes exceeding 20,000 (Feb 2024). Agra, Kanpur Nagar and Varanasi also report high caseloads. Experts warn official counts may underrepresent ground reality due to rural and marginalised populations not accessing post-exposure care. Central data record UP dog-bite totals: 2022 1,91,361; 2023 2,29,921; 2024 1,64,009; Jan 2025 20,478. RTI from Gorakhpur shows Jan–Sept 2024 monthly vaccinations 2,051–3,452, rising to 11,987 (Jan 2025) and 13,085 (Feb 2025); Kanpur Dehat reports 6,463 (Jan 2024) rising to 9,293 (Mar 2025). A Lucknow bench seeks a two-week inter-departmental committee on shelters, sterilisation, vaccination and public awareness. May 19, 2026 Supreme Court judgment upholds Article 21 right to movement and allows stray removal from sensitive zones; Animal Birth Control Rules 2023 do not grant an absolute public-space right.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州の野良犬咬傷危機：ラクナウで月1.5万件、ガジアバードで月1万件の抗狂犬病ワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: インドUP州における野良犬咬傷・狂犬病ワクチン接種の慢性的な公衆衛生課題であり、新規性・異常性は低いが、暴露人口の多さと行政対応（裁判所命令・委員会設置）から継続観察が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドで地域流行病であり、本記事は野良犬咬傷とワクチン接種需要の増加、行政・司法対応（Lucknow裁判所命令、動物出産制限規則2023）に関する内容。新規アウトブレイクではなく、継続的な公衆衛生課題として経過観察が適当。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue count rises to 15 in Gurgaon, Haryana tally 105
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Gurgaon, Haryana: 15 confirmed cases in Gurgaon, taking Haryana’s tally to 105 (66 government, 39 private hospitals). District counts show Jhajjar 24, Karnal 10, Sonipat 8. Most infections are mild with high fever and low platelets; several cases show advanced symptoms, but dengue shock syndrome/ARDS have not been seen. Severe thrombocytopenia requiring platelet transfusion and fluid buildup in pleural/abdominal cavities have occurred. Max Hospital reports more advanced symptoms; about one dengue patient per day in OPD; Manipal notes a modest rise (4-5% vs last year) with one serious case. Labs: 27 dengue testing laboratories; 39,054 samples tested to date, 449 today. Public health measures include 1.5 crore house visits with 17,113 houses having larvae; 267 wards and 1,070 beds reserved; private labs restricted to Rs 600 for NS1/IgM ELISA testing.

triage.headline_ja: グルガオンのデング熱感染者15人増加、ハリヤナ州の累計は105人に
triage.triage_reason: ハリヤナ州で季節性デング熱の患者数が増加しているが、重症化例は一部あるものの死亡やショック症候群の報告はなく、行政も通常の対策（家屋調査・病床確保）を実施しており異常性は低い。
triage.notes: SFTSウイルスが疾患名リストに含まれているが、記事本文・サマリーには一切言及がなく、デング熱に関する季節性の地域報道のみである。

article.articleHeadline: In 10 days of Aug, South Goa district hospital sees 71 dengue cases, 27 admissions
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever surged at the South Goa District Hospital in Panaji, Goa. In the first 10 days of August, 71 dengue cases were detected with 27 hospital admissions. Lab detections rose from 9 in May to 39 in June and to 91 in July, with admissions scaling from 8 (May) to 29 (June) to 79 (July) and 27 (August, so far). Medical Superintendent Dr. Rajendra Borkar attributes the spike to pre-monsoon and peri-monsoon conditions, with intermittent rain promoting breeding in clean stagnant water around homes. He notes dengue is an indoor biter and breeder and that there is no specific antiviral treatment; management is supportive care. The hospital urges people with fever and headache lasting more than 2–3 days to get tested promptly and to implement measures to prevent mosquito breeding in surroundings.

triage.headline_ja: 8月の最初の10日間で、南ゴア地区病院でデング熱71例、入院27例を確認
triage.triage_reason: インド・ゴア州における季節性のデング熱増加であり、毎年見られる雨季パターンの範囲内と考えられる。重症度や蚊媒介感染の継続リスクはあるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限リスクは低く、社会的関心の高まりも不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱の季節性増加を報じるローカルニュースで、南ゴア地区病院に限定された報告。5月から8月にかけて検査陽性数・入院数が増加傾向にあるが、地域病院レベルでの対応が可能とされており、外部支援の必要性を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）：埃博拉病毒在患者尚未就医前便已夺走他们的生命
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The Ebola virus had already claimed their lives before patients sought medical care.
article.articleSummary: More than 1,900 people have died in DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, most before reaching treatment centers. In Ituri province’s Bunia, 60–70% of fatalities occur in communities far from care, a gap WHO aims to close. No approved vaccine exists, and Bundibugyo ebolavirus remains highly lethal, challenging the response three months into the outbreak. WHO emphasizes a community-centered strategy: bring treatment closer to people, improve referrals and transit conditions, and prevent transmission during transport or after death. Long distances force patients to Bunia; some are sent home, and bodies returned to villages, raising infection risk. Aru town offers a model: after one case, 159 contacts identified and 121 suspected; nearby facilities and outreach reduce the need to travel to Bunia. Plans include 400 Ebola beds and 100 general beds, plus market handwashing stations. Expect impact in 2–3 months as operations decentralize care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルスは患者が医療を受ける前に既に命を奪っていた
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱流行（死者1900人超、承認済みワクチンなし）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス種による流行で承認済みワクチンが存在せず、致死率が高い。発症から3ヶ月経過し、コミュニティベースの対応強化が進行中。WHOが国際支援を主導している。

article.articleHeadline: SZO: Najbrže širenje epidemije ebole počelo mesecima pre zvaničnog proglašenja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The fastest spread of the Ebola epidemic began months before the official declaration.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo — The World Health Organization says the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic to date began in February, several months before its official declaration in mid-May. Genomic analysis of the virus showed when the outbreak started, according to regional Africa director Mohamed Jakub Džanabi at a press briefing. He noted that some of the earliest cases were misattributed to other diseases, including malaria and typhoid, potentially delaying recognition and response. The findings highlight the role of genetic surveillance in tracing the outbreak's origin and transmission, informing public health measures. The article does not provide updated case or death counts, nor details on infection sources or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ流行の最速拡大は公式発表の数ヵ月前から始まっていた
triage.triage_reason: WHOがゲノム解析により、DRCで史上最速の拡大を見せたエボラ流行が公式発表より数ヵ月前に始まっていたと発表。深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と異常性（誤診による対応遅延）が確認され、IHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のDRCエボラ流行に関するWHOの事後的なゲノム解析結果の報告であり、最新の症例数・死亡者数の更新は含まれていない。マラリアや腸チフスとの誤診による対応遅延が指摘されている点は、サーベイランス体制の脆弱性を示す重要な情報。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв Эболы в ДР Конго возросло до 1960 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 1,960.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has grown to 1,960 deaths from 4,294 confirmed cases. As of August 10, 2026, 722 patients are in isolation or hospitalized and 849 have recovered. The hardest-hit provinces are Ituri (where the outbreak began), North Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Chopo; South Kivu has had no new confirmed cases for 73 days. The virus has crossed borders to Uganda, which declared itself Ebola-free on July 28 after reporting 20 cases and 2 deaths linked to the outbreak. The continuing transmission underscores persistent regional risk and the need for sustained surveillance, cross-border coordination, and vaccination/public health interventions to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ死者数が1960人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ流行（死者1960人、感染者4294人）が継続し、既に国境を越えてウガンダに拡大した実績があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既にエボラ根絶宣言（7月28日）済みのため、現状の発生国はDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde de Campinas vacina 64 animais contra raiva perto do Cemitério da Saudade
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas Health Department vaccinates 64 animals against rabies near Saudade Cemetery
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil, on August 8, 2026, vaccination of 64 dogs and cats was conducted within 300 meters of Saudade Cemetery after rabies was confirmed in a cat found there. The feline developed neurological symptoms and died after clinic care; the identified virus variant is bat-origin, causing paralytic rabies, while the furious form is not circulating in the region. Campinas had not recorded rabies in cats since 2016. The effort includes cemetery-based education and ongoing prevention, with house-to-house vaccination and vaccination of local cats. Free anti-rabies vaccines for dogs and cats are available year-round at the Unidade de Vigilância de Zoonoses (UVZ) by appointment at (19) 2515-7044 (Mon-Fri, 8:00–17:00). Prevention tips: annually vaccinate, leash pets, avoid unknown street animals, and seek care if bitten; report to UVZ. Bat surveillance is year-round; four bats tested positive in Campinas in 2024.

triage.headline_ja: カンピナス市保健局、サウダーデ墓地付近で動物64頭に狂犬病ワクチンを接種
triage.triage_reason: 動物（猫）における狂犬病確認と予防的ワクチン接種の事例であり、ヒトへの感染や大規模な公衆衛生上の脅威は報告されていない。管理下にあるルーティンの動物衛生対応。
triage.notes: 感染は猫（動物）に限定され、ヒトへの感染例は報告されていない。地域保健当局による通常の予防対応（ワクチン接種、監視）が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Descartan casos de ébola en el barco interceptado de camino a la capital de RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases ruled out on the intercepted boat en route to the DRC capital.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases ruled out on an intercepted boat en route to Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The 255-passenger vessel, intercepted about 65 km from the capital, carried a passenger with symptoms compatible with Ebola. Health Minister Roger Kamba said there are no Ebola cases in Kinshasa. The boat, originating from Mongala and having sailed for more than 22 days, had gone 21 days without detecting any case. The alert followed the death of a passenger who disembarked with fever, diarrhea and vomiting, but laboratory testing could not confirm Ebola. An erroneous report claimed the ship came from Kisangani; it actually departed Mongala, a region currently free of the virus. Seven people aboard showed symptoms, but all tests were negative. The vessel resumed its voyage after confirming absence of cases. Ebola has caused 1,916 deaths and 4,209 confirmed cases as of 2026-08-10.

triage.headline_ja: RDC(コンゴ民主共和国)の首都に向かう途中で臨検された船舶でのエボラ感染は否定される
triage.triage_reason: 船上での症例は否定されたが、記事はコンゴ民主共和国で進行中の大規模エボラ流行（確定4,209例、死亡1,916例）を示しており、首都への感染拡大リスクや国際的関心の高さから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は船内でのエボラ症例が否定されたことを報じるものだが、背景として大規模な流行（確定4,209例、死亡1,916例）が継続中であることが示されており、首都キンシャサへの拡大懸念が高い。継続的なモニタリングと最新の流行状況確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rýchlo sa šíriaca epidémia eboly v Kongu sa začala mesiace pred jej vyhlásením, tvrdí WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A rapidly spreading Ebola epidemic in the Congo began months before its declaration, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has an ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo that began in February and was declared on May 15. It is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history, with 4,200 confirmed cases and more than 1,900 deaths, per latest government data. The outbreak started in Ituri Province and has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, with cross-border cases in Uganda. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo Ebola. WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Yakub Janabi noted that some early cases were misattributed to malaria and typhus. Health efforts face extreme challenges: remote, unpaved travel, PPE shortages, armed conflict, misinformation that Ebola exists, and large displaced populations lacking safe water for handwashing. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, organ damage, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの急速に拡大するエボラ流行、WHOによれば宣言の数デ月前から始まっていた
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が発生し、4200例・1900人超の死者、ウガンダへの越境例も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認されたワクチン・治療薬がない点、武装勢力による活動制約、誤情報の拡散など管理困難要因が多数存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Lomami : lancement de la vaccination contre la rougeole et la rubéole | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Lomami: launch of measles and rubella vaccination | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: In Lomami province, Governor Iron-Van Kalombo Musoko launched the measles–rubella combined vaccine introduction in Kabinda on 10 August 2026. The free campaign runs 11–15 August across 16 health zones and targets children aged 6 months to 14 years, with a catch-up component for children under 2 years overdue in their vaccination schedules. The governor urged parents to vaccinate their children. According to the Provincial Health Division, Lomami recorded 202,296 suspected measles cases and 45 deaths from week 1 to week 29 of 2026. This campaign marks the introduction of the measles–rubella vaccine in Lomami.

triage.headline_ja: ロマミ州:麻疹・風疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCロマミ州で2026年第1〜29週に麻疹疑い症例202,296件・死亡45件という大規模な流行が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と管理可能性の観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 報告された症例数・死亡数の規模が非常に大きく、麻疹・風疹ワクチン導入キャンペーンが緊急対応として実施されている点から、続報や公式統計の精査が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Estações de trem e Metrô iniciam campanha de vacinação contra Sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Train stations and the subway begin a measles vaccination campaign.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination campaign underway in São Paulo, Brazil, from August 10–28 to curb an outbreak with 23 confirmed measles cases in the state. The effort uses the measles-mumps-rubella (triple viral) vaccine at metro and rail stations: Tucuruvi, Vila Prudente, Corinthians-Itaquera, São Mateus, and Vila Matilde. Schedules vary: Corinthians-Itaquera and São Mateus on August 17, 19, and 21 from 10:00 to 20:00; Vila Prudente August 17–21 from 10:00 to 16:00; Tucuruvi August 10–14 and August 17–21 (times not listed). Dosing guidance: dose zero for children 6–11 months 29 days; 12 months–29 years should receive two doses; 30–59 years at least one dose; health workers two doses regardless of age. Dose zero does not substitute later doses. Symptoms of measles include fever, red rash, cough, runny nose, and red eyes; vaccination remains the primary preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: 電車駅と地下鉄で麻疹予防接種キャンペーン開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹確定例23件の発生に対しワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されているが、深刻な公衆衛生影響や国際拡大の兆候は現時点で確認されず、情報も限定的。
triage.notes: 地方自治体主導の大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されており、当局の関心は高いが、感染拡大の規模や重症度に関する詳細情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Smrtonosna zaraza kosi ljude, skoro 2.000 mrtvih! Hitno se oglasila SZO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly outbreak is wiping out people, nearly 2,000 dead! WHO issues urgent statement.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, reaches 4,200 confirmed cases and over 1,900 deaths as of 2026-08-10. The World Health Organization notes this is the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic in history, started in February and officially declared on May 15. Genomic analysis led by Steve Ahuke at the National Institute for Biomedical Research in DR Congo traced early cases misattributed to malaria and typhoid, highlighting rapid spread. WHO Africa Regional Director Mohamed Jakub Džanabi says the global risk is low since Bundibugyo ebolavirus is not airborne, with cases outside the affected area quickly identified and controlled and no sustained onward transmission. There are no approved vaccines or therapies for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak caused over 11,000 deaths among at least 28,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的な感染症が人々を襲い、死者数はほぼ2000人に！WHOが緊急発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が史上最速の拡大を見せ、確認例4,200例・死者1,900人超に達しており、IHR基準の複数（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが対象国リストに存在しないため除外。記事はDRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が主題であり、史上最速拡大かつ死者2,000人近くに達している重大イベント。WHOは国際的リスクは低いとしているが、症例数・死亡数・拡大速度から見て優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Larva comedora de carne humana já infectou mais de 500 pessoas no México
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flesh-eating larva has already infected more than 500 people in Mexico.
article.articleSummary: New World screwworm fly–induced myiasis has infected more than 500 people in Mexico. In a study of 202 patients, 72% were men; ages 12–93 (mean 61), with 77% having at least one comorbidity such as diabetes, alcoholism, cancer or skin disease. Lesions most often affected legs and feet (55%), followed by head and neck (including nose and eyes); infections also occurred on arms, trunk, ears and genitals. Without treatment, myiasis can invade muscle, cartilage and bone, causing infection, sepsis and death. Mexico eradicated the fly in 2003; a Panama barrier was breached in 2022. Since 2024 animal cases rose; USDA cites over 36,000 animal cases in Mexico, with nearly 2,000 active as of Aug 5. In the US, first animal cases appeared in Texas in June (45 total); no travel-associated human cases reported. Brazil reports elderly cases, including an 87-year-old woman who died in Ribeirão Preto after oral/nasal larvae.

triage.headline_ja: 人肉食い幼虫、メキシコで500人以上に感染
triage.triage_reason: ニューワールドスクリューワームによるヒト蠅蛆症がメキシコで500人超に感染し、死亡例（ブラジル）も報告されており、動物・ヒトへの拡大と重症化リスクが確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はメキシコ・米国（テキサス州）・パナマでの動物・ヒト感染拡大だが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルはリベイランプレトでの高齢女性の死亡例が報告されており対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: L'engagement communautaire principal levier de la réponse contre Ebola en Ituri (Directeur régional de l'OMS pour l'Afrique) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Community engagement: the main lever of the Ebola response in Ituri (WHO Regional Director for Africa) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease response in Ituri province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, centers on community engagement as the main lever, per WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Janabi at a Bunia press conference on 10 August 2026. He notes initial logistical hurdles have given way to engagement challenges, with deaths described as community-driven. Strengthening community involvement is essential to promote prevention measures, improve early warning, and expedite care for suspected cases. He stressed ongoing collaboration with community leaders, local authorities, and residents to detect cases quickly, report deaths, and steer ill individuals to care facilities. Security concerns persist in some areas, hindering response teams' access to affected populations. The press conference, led with the incident manager, framed community engagement as central to consolidating gains and preventing new transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: 地域社会の関与がイツリ州でのエボラ対応の主要な梃子である（WHOアフリカ地域局長）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州でのエボラ出血熱の継続的な発生とWHOによる対応活動が報告されており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクのある既知のPICKUP事案。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はDRCで既知の継続的発生であり、コミュニティの抵抗やセキュリティ上の懸念が対応を妨げていると報告されている。WHOアフリカ地域局長が直接言及しており、国際的な注目度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uele : une institution entrepreneuriale appelle ses membres à rejoindre la riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haut-Uele: An entrepreneurial institution calls on its members to join the Ebola response - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Isiro, Democratic Republic of Congo, 10 August 2026 — Ebola remains a focus in Haut-Uele, northeast DRC. The Federation of Small and Medium Enterprises of Congo (FENAPEC), Haut-Uele branch, calls on members to observe barrier prevention measures and to sensitize the public to support the provincial Ebola response led by Governor Jean Bakomito. FENAPEC President Jean-Pierre Tshongo said SMEs have begun outreach in affected health zones, leveraging daily interactions with customers and markets to reinforce prevention and awareness. Members are urged to provide hand-washing kits at each establishment and to educate to avoid actions that could increase transmission. Disinfection of transport vehicles and passenger surveillance are being implemented at parking areas and checkpoints across the province, with vehicles required to be disinfected after every 100 km on each traffic axis.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州：企業家組織がエボラ対策への参加を会員に呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCオー・ウエレ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する報道であり、コミュニティレベルでの対応強化（検疫所設置、車両消毒、感染防止教育）が実施されている。エボラは重篤度・異常性・国際拡大リスクいずれも高く、フルRRA対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 記事は新規発生の報告ではなく、既存のエボラ対応活動（地域企業による感染防止協力、検疫・消毒措置の継続）に関する内容。感染者数・死亡者数など具体的疫学データは記事中に記載なし。継続中のアウトブレイクとして経過を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Capivaras entram no alerta da febre maculosa, mas o risco para quem visita o parque está no carrapato escondido na vegetação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Capybaras enter the spotted fever alert, but the risk for park visitors is the tick hidden in the vegetation.
article.articleSummary: Spotted fever (febre maculosa) poses rising risk in urban and rural parks where tall vegetation harbors the star tick, transmitted by tick bites rather than direct contact with wildlife. Capybaras and horses are amplifying hosts for the star tick, increasing local tick populations in grassy, moist areas. Infection is caused by bacteria of the genus Rickettsia; incubation is 2–14 days after a bite. Early symptoms include abrupt high fever, severe headache and chills; a progression can include small red spots on the palms and soles. Informing healthcare providers about park exposure speeds diagnosis; prompt antibiotics improve outcomes. Prevention focuses on clothing and repellents: wear long light-colored pants tucked into high socks, closed shoes; apply icaridine-based repellents; perform a careful body check every two hours; avoid sitting on grass in flagged zones. If a tick attaches, remove with clean tweezers, disinfect the bite site, and monitor for fever and seek care.

triage.headline_ja: カピバラも紅斑熱の警戒対象に、しかし公園利用者にとっての危険は植生に潜むマダニ
triage.triage_reason: 紅斑熱（リケッチア感染症）に関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、特定の異常発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。既知の風土病リスクに関する注意喚起に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内の公園における紅斑熱（febre maculosa）予防に関する一般啓発情報で、特定の異常な発生増加や集団感染の報告ではない。既知の媒介動物（マダニ、カピバラ、馬）による既知のリスクの説明が中心。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uele : aucun cas suspect d'Ebola enregistré dans la zone de santé de Niangara( Médecin Chef de Zone) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Upper Uele: no suspected Ebola case recorded in the Niangara Health Zone (the Zone's Chief Medical Officer) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of August 10, 2026, in Niangara Health Zone, Haut-Uele, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, no suspected or confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases have been recorded since the official outbreak declaration. Alerts have been raised but not confirmed. The Zone Chief Medical Officer, Didier Amudiandroy, said surveillance has been strengthened at all health centers, hospitals, areas, and health posts within Niangara, and health-care workers have been briefed on the disease and on maintaining surveillance. The population is urged to observe barrier measures, including regular hand washing and social distancing. Ebola symptoms cited include sudden fever, vomiting, diarrhea, myalgias, and bleeding. The authorities emphasize preparedness and vigilance to halt transmission, rather than ongoing case detection in the zone.

triage.headline_ja: オーウエレ州：ニアンガラ保健地区でエボラ疑い例は記録されていない（地区首席医師）－ACP
triage.triage_reason: 記事はDRC北東部で既に公式のエボラ発生宣言がなされている状況下での続報であり、当該地区では症例なしとされるものの、進行中のアウトブレイクに関する情報としてフルRRAでの状況確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事自体はNiangara保健地区での疑い例なしという安心材料的内容だが、'official outbreak declaration'との記載からDRCで公式にエボラ発生が宣言されている背景があり、他地域での状況確認が必要。地域はNiangara/Haut-Uele（DRC国内）のみで、DRC全体のアウトブレイク状況の詳細は本記事では不明。

article.articleHeadline: ДР Конго: Эбола уносит жизни людей, не имеющих возможности своевременно обратиться к врачу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola is claiming the lives of people who cannot access medical care in a timely manner.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces a severe Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri Province, with more than 1,900 deaths and the majority of fatalities occurring in communities lacking timely medical care. About 60–70% of deaths among transported patients happen because care is unavailable en route, and many patients are taken to Bunia, a central hub, arriving too late. Bundibugyo ebolavirus currently has no approved vaccine. Three months after the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, WHO, Congolese authorities and partners plan an emergency scale-up to bring care closer to communities, improve patient transport, and intensify community information. Bunia remains overloaded; Aru district reports two weeks with no new cases after identifying a single case and tracing 159 contacts (121 suspected). Proposed expansions include 400 Ebola beds and 100 other beds, plus new treatment centers outside Bunia and enhanced hand-washing campaigns among market traders.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ:エボラ出血熱が、適時に医療を受けられない人々の命を奪っている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(Bundibugyoエボラウイルス、ワクチン未承認)によりイツリ州で1900人以上が死亡する深刻な流行が継続し、WHOと国際支援による緊急対応拡大が計画されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行でワクチン未承認、致死率が高く医療アクセス不足が主要因。WHOと現地当局による緊急対応拡大計画あり。国際的拡散リスクについては近隣国への越境報告は記事中に明記されていないが、地域規模の深刻な流行として国際的関心・支援が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Kinshasa respire après les tests négatifs des cas suspects d'Ebola dans un bateau - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinshasa breathes a sigh of relief after negative tests for suspected Ebola cases on a boat - ACP
article.articleSummary: Seven suspected Ebola cases aboard the Yingfeng 2, a boat from Mongala Province, were tested negative at Maluku's Bende-Bende port, 65 km from Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Investigations by INRB and INSP ruled out Ebola virus disease, including the Bundibugyo strain, after symptomatic passengers with high fever underwent examination. More than 250 passengers and crew were temporarily isolated in a mobile camp at the port; they were later allowed to return to Kinshasa, a metropolis of over 12 million. The alert followed the Aug 5 arrival of the vessel from Mongala. In response, authorities intensified river surveillance on the Congo River, instituting routine temperature checks and travel-manifest screening for boats heading toward Kinshasa, and establishing permanent controls 65 km from the capital. The measures aim to enable rapid detection and proper care, as part of ongoing Ebola preparedness in the country, the 17th outbreak domestically.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ、船内で疑われたエボラ症例の検査結果陰性を受けて安堵 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 疑い例は検査で陰性となりエボラ発生は確定していないが、DRCでのエボラ警戒体制強化の一環であり続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疑い例は検査で陰性が確認され、エボラ感染は否定された。国内で継続中のエボラ流行（17回目のアウトブレイク）に対する監視体制強化の文脈で報告されたもの。
