article.articleHeadline: 染甲流併發敗血性休克 20個月大男嬰危殆 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 influenza infection complicated by septic shock; 20-month-old boy in critical condition | am730
article.articleSummary: As of 11 August 2026, Hong Kong reports a severe pediatric case of H1N1 influenza complicated by septic shock in a previously healthy 20-month-old boy. The child developed fever and convulsions, was admitted via the Queen Elizabeth Hospital Emergency Department to the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit with hypotension, and respiratory swabs confirmed influenza A (H1N1). The diagnosis is influenza A with septic shock; the patient remains critically ill. The Centre for Health Protection notes the child did not receive the 2025/26 seasonal flu vaccine and had no travel during the incubation period. A household contact recently developed mild upper respiratory symptoms, tested positive by rapid antigen test, and has recovered. Since late June, seven severe pediatric influenza cases have been recorded, including one death. The government has completed procurement for the 2026/27 seasonal flu vaccine program and plans vaccination arrangements, urging schools and parents to participate in the school outreach vaccination program.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1インフルエンザ感染により敗血性ショック合併、生後20か月の男児が危篤状態 | am730
triage.triage_reason: 香港で季節性H1N1インフルエンザによる重症小児例（死亡1例含む重症例7件）が報告されているが、既知の季節性株であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは示されていないため、経過観察が適切と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）による重症小児例で、香港衛生防護中心（CHP）が監視・ワクチン接種計画を実施中。国際的な異常性や拡大リスクの明確な兆候はなく、局地的な季節性流行の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Onça de Pitangui reforça combate à dengue com apoio de drones
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pitangui's Onça strengthens the fight against dengue with drone support.
article.articleSummary: Onça de Pitangui, Brazil uses drone-assisted surveillance to bolster dengue and arbovirus control by identifying potential Aedes aegypti breeding sites, especially in hard-to-reach areas. The technology expands monitoring, helping uncover sites that might be overlooked and integrating with local prevention and control actions. However, community participation remains essential, with most measures conducted at homes and in backyards. Residents are advised to eliminate water-holding containers, keep water tanks sealed, clean gutters regularly, and avoid conditions that promote mosquito reproduction. Because even small amounts of standing water can become breeding sites, vigilance must be ongoing. A combined approach—technology, field teams, and community engagement—aims to strengthen prevention and protect public health in Onça de Pitangui. Information from Jornal Panorama and the Prefeitura de Onça de Pitangui.

triage.headline_ja: オンサ・デ・ピタングイ市、ドローンを活用してデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの一地方自治体による日常的なデング熱予防（ドローンを使った蚊の発生源調査）に関する内容で、異常な流行拡大や重症例増加の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体の日常的なデング熱予防活動（ドローン監視）を紹介する内容であり、感染者数の急増や異常事態を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Semana de Combate à Leishmaniose tem ações de prevenção em Sidrolândia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leishmaniasis Control Week Includes Prevention Actions in Sidrolândia.
article.articleSummary: Leishmaniasis Control Week launches in Sidrolândia, Brazil (Aug 10–15) to boost prevention and awareness. Coordinated by the Municipal Health Surveillance, activities run daily from 07:00–11:00 and 13:00–15:00, featuring educational pamphlets, guidance, and disease clarifications. At Praça Tancredo Neves in the São Bento neighborhood, dogs will be tested for canine leishmaniasis to identify possible animal cases. In the rural zone, efforts target Community Health Agents (ACS) with information on transmission and prevention. Leishmaniasis can affect both animals and humans; residents are advised to monitor for signs and seek health care if suspected. The program focuses on prevention and community outreach as part of ongoing public health measures in Sidrolândia.

triage.headline_ja: シドロランジアでリーシュマニア症対策週間、予防活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・シドロランジアにおけるリーシュマニア症予防週間の啓発活動に関する定例的な公衆衛生広報であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定例の予防・啓発活動の報道であり、感染拡大や異常事態を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО : Епидемија еболе почела мјесецима раније него што се мислило
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak began months earlier than previously thought.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10, the WHO reports the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record began in February in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kinshasa communications) and was officially declared on May 15. Genetic analysis shows an earlier onset, with early cases misattributed to malaria and typhoid. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, for which there are no approved vaccines or therapies. Confirmed cases reach about 4,200, with more than 1,900 deaths. Global risk is considered low since Ebola is not airborne; transmission occurs via bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces, including bedding and clothing. Cases outside the affected area have been rapidly identified and contained, with no sustained transmission. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak caused over 11,000 deaths among at least 28,000 cases, and it took about eight months to reach 1,000 deaths in that event.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ流行は考えられていたよりも数か月早く始まっていた
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行が発生し、確定4200例・死亡1900例超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョウイルスによるものであるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリー中にAngolaでの発生に関する具体的記述はなく、主題はDRCでの流行であるためverified_locationsから除外した。国際的拡大については、感染地域外での症例確認・封じ込めの記述があるが、越境事例か国内拡大かは記事から明確ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 世衛警告伊波拉病毒擴散速度超前｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola virus is spreading faster than expected.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that Ebola is spreading faster than expected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Bundibugyo strain outbreak centers in eastern DRC, with Bunia as a focal point. Transmission began at least three months before formal notification on May 15, 2026. As of the latest figures, there are 4,294 confirmed cases and 1,960 deaths, making it the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak on record after 2014–2016 West Africa. No approved vaccines or licensed therapies exist for Bundibugyo Ebola, complicating treatment amid regional instability. Dr. Mohamed Janabi, WHO Africa regional director, said the virus has likely been circulating since February and was initially misdiagnosed as malaria or typhoid. Only about 30% of patients have contact with healthcare workers; distrust and traditional burial practices further hinder prevention efforts. Eastern DRC has established multiple treatment centers to improve diagnosis and care.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関(WHO)、エボラウイルスの感染拡大が予想を上回るスピードで進んでいると警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが4,294例・死者1,960人に達し、史上2番目に死亢率の高い流行となっており、ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつ地域不安定化により国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（ブニア含む東部）でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行に関するもの。アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず除外した。当初マラリアや腸チフスと誤診されていた点も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Vai viajar para um destino tropical? Saiba como prevenir doenças transmitidas por mosquitos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Are you traveling to a tropical destination? Learn how to prevent mosquito-borne diseases.
article.articleSummary: Mosquito-borne diseases continue to pose a risk in tropical and subtropical regions. Before travel, a travel health consultation 4–8 weeks beforehand helps tailor vaccination, chemoprophylaxis, hygiene, and mosquito-bite prevention to the itinerary and traveler profile. Prevention centers on reducing bites: apply insect repellent to exposed skin, apply sunscreen before repellent, wear long, light-colored clothing, use bed nets, stay in air-conditioned or screened accommodations, limit outdoor time during peak mosquito activity, and remove standing water near the lodging. The main diseases include dengue, Zika, and chikungunya (Aedes); yellow fever (Aedes or Haemagogus); malaria (Plasmodium; Anopheles); and West Nile virus (Culex). Africa, Asia, and Latin America are most affected; Brazil is noted as having all tropical diseases on the WHO list. After returning, monitor for flu-like symptoms and seek medical care, informing clinicians of countries visited to enable early diagnosis or exclusion.

triage.headline_ja: 熱帯地域へ旅行予定ですか？蚊媒介感染症の予防方法を知りましょう
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクではなく、旅行者向けの一般的な蚊媒介感染症予防に関する啓発記事であり、具体的な発生事例や異常性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生事例を報じるものではなく、旅行医学的な一般的予防啓発コンテンツ。ブラジルは「WHOリストの熱帯病がすべて存在する国」として例示的に言及されているのみで、具体的な発生イベントの主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Montes Claros realiza bloqueio contra a raiva após caso positivo em morcego | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Montes Claros carries out rabies containment after a positive bat case
article.articleSummary: Rabies containment underway in Montes Claros after a bat tested positive for the rabies virus in the neighborhoods of São Judas Tadeu, São Judas II and Vila Greice. The Center for Zoonoses Control (CCZ) is leading a free vaccination campaign for dogs and cats over three months old that have not received a rabies vaccine in the past six months. The campaign runs daily from 8:00 to 16:00 through Friday the 14th at three vaccination points: São Judas Tadeu Basic Health Unit (Avenida Padre Vieira, 620); Our Home Square (Praça O Nosso Lar), Geraldo de Souza Lima Street, São Judas II; and São Judas Tadeu Square (Rua Santa Marta), São Judas Tadeu, beside Viação São Pedro. Rabies is a deadly disease that can be transmitted among animals and to humans; vaccination is a primary method of prevention and control.

triage.headline_ja: モンテスクラロス市、コウモリの狂犬病陽性事例を受けて封じ込め対応を実施
triage.triage_reason: コウモリでの単発の狂犬病陽性事例に対する地域的なワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、ヒトへの感染例の報告はなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも見られないため。
triage.notes: ヒト感染例は報告されておらず、動物（コウモリ）での陽性検出に対する予防的な地域ワクチン接種活動である。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola deja 1.960 muertos y cerca de 4.500 casos confirmados en...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola leaves 1,960 dead and nearly 4,500 confirmed cases in....
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,960 deaths and 4,294 confirmed cases, per the latest tally covering up to last Saturday. There are 722 patients in isolation or hospitalized, and 849 have recovered. Transmission remains active in four of five provinces: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo; South Kivu has had 73 days with no new confirmed cases. The Bundibugyo strain is involved, for which no approved vaccine exists. Declared May 15, the outbreak has concentrated in Ituri, where militia attacks have displaced people and severely impeded containment efforts. The World Health Organization warns of the extreme gravity of the situation, marking this as the worst outbreak ever recorded in the country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により1,960人死亡、確認感染者数約4,500人に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WHOが過去最悪規模の流行と警告している大規模アウトブレイクであるため。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチンが存在しないBundibugyo株による流行で、民兵による攻撃が対応を妨げている。WHOはコンゴ史上最悪の流行と警告。南キブ州は73日間新規感染者ゼロだが、他4州で感染継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Guarulhos amplia vacinação contra o sarampo com Vacimóvel e ações em instituições de ensino - Click Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guarulhos Health Department expands measles vaccination with Vacimóvel and activities in schools - Click Guarulhos.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination push in Guarulhos, Brazil, via Vacimóvel and university/school clinics as part of the Multivaccination Campaign through September 1. From August 10–14, the Vacimóvel will operate at Terminal Metropolitano Taboão (Avenida Natalia Zarif, 59) from 9:00 to 16:00, offering measles and influenza vaccines with minimal disruption to daily routines. Six institutions—Eniac, Uninove, Anhanguera, Universidade Guarulhos (UNG), São Judas, and Unisa—will host vaccination sessions for students and staff, complementing weekend house-to-house efforts that immunized 3,695 people across 2,984 properties in priority UBS areas (Marcos Freire, Jacy, Cumbica, Mário Macca, Jandaia). The current epidemiological context includes one measles case registered in the region (Guarulhos, São Paulo, and São Bernardo do Campo). During the campaign, individuals aged six months to 59 years may receive the dose regardless of prior vaccination, provided no contraindication and a 30-day interval for doses in children 6–15 months. The tríplice viral vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella) is free at Guarulhos UBSs and the Ambulatório da Criança e do Adolescente (Rua Oswaldo Cruz, 151).

triage.headline_ja: グアルーリョス保健局、ヴァキモーヴェルと教育機関での活動により麻疹ワクチン接種を拡大
triage.triage_reason: 記事はブラジル・グアルーリョス市における通常の麻疹（はしか）ワクチン接種キャンペーンの広報内容であり、地域内の麻疹症例は1件のみと報告されている。アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響も見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種キャンペーンの案内記事であり、疫学的緊急事態を示すものではない。地域内で麻疹症例が1件確認されているが、詳細な感染拡大状況は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում էբոլայի հաստատված դեպքերի թիվը գերազանցել է 4200-ը
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the number of confirmed Ebola cases has exceeded 4,200.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports Ebola with over 4,200 confirmed cases and about 1,900 deaths, per WHO via AP. The outbreak began spreading in February 2026, several months before official confirmation on May 15. Early cases were misdiagnosed as malaria or typhoid, slowing detection. It is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this strain exists, though trials are evaluating therapies and vaccines. The eastern DRC and security challenges, population movement, weak health infrastructure, and hard-to-reach areas have accelerated transmission. WHO is assisting Congo authorities with enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, exploration of treatment options, and preventive measures in border regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ確定患者数が4,200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 確定患者4,200人超、死者約1,900人という重大なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、ワクチン未承認株であること、国境地域での拡大リスクが指摘されているためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株で承認済みワクチン・特効薬がなく、東部DRCの治安不安・人口移動・脆弱な医療体制が感染拡大を助長。WHOが監視強化・接触者追跡・国境地域の予防対策を支援中。

article.articleHeadline: MS registra mais duas mortes por chikungunya - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health reports two more Chikungunya deaths - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreaks in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, have reached 30 deaths in 2026, with 9,832 confirmed and 12,579 probable cases, per the SES epidemiological bulletin released on 10 August 2026. Two new deaths were reported: a 62-year-old woman from Corumbá (died July 28) and a 46-year-old woman from Dourados (died July 8); both had preexisting conditions. Dourados accounts for the most probable cases (5,169), followed by Corumbá (1,662). Douradina shows the highest incidence rate at 4,517.7 per 100,000 inhabitants. Overall, 23 municipalities are in high-incidence status, and the state-wide incidence is 456.3 probable cases per 100,000. There are 114 confirmed chikungunya cases among pregnant women, concentrated in Dourados. Numbers are preliminary and subject to updates.

triage.headline_ja: MSでチキングニアによる死亡者がさらに2人報告 - Boca do Povo News
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マットグロッソドスル州で2026年にチクングニア熱による死者30人、確定9,832例・疑い12,579例と大規模な流行が継続しており、州衛生局の疫学速報として公的に報告されているため、フルリスク評価への移行が適切と判断。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱はブラジルで季節性に流行する既知の蚊媒介感染症だが、死者数・症例数の規模が大きく、23市町村が高発生率状態にあるため継続的な注視が必要。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: SZO : Epidemija ebole počela mjesecima ranije nego što se mislilo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola epidemic began months earlier than was thought.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports the Ebola outbreak in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, began in February, months before its official declaration on May 15. Genetic sequencing led by Stiva Ahuke, head of the virology department at the National Institute for Biomedical Research, traced the outbreak to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with some early cases misattributed to malaria and typhoid. DR Congo government data show about 4,200 confirmed cases and over 1,900 deaths. Global risk is considered low since the virus is not airborne, and cases detected outside the affected region have been quickly identified and contained with no sustained transmission. This outbreak is the fastest-growing on record and involves a virus with no approved vaccines or therapies. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak killed over 11,000 people among at least 28,000 cases. Ongoing surveillance and public health measures are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: エボラ流行は考えられていたよりも数か月早く始まっていた
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キンシャサでのエボラ出血熱流行は確定例約4,200人、死者1,900人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、発生時期の遅れた特定など異常性も認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・キンシャサでのエボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）に関するもの。アンゴラは発生地域として付与されているが記事本文では言及がなく除外した。国際的拡大リスクはWHOにより低いと評価されているが、ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつ史上最速の拡大速度である点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: 甲流併發敗血性休克 男嬰留醫深切治療部危殆 - 20260811
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 influenza complicated by septic shock; male infant in ICU in critical condition - 20260811
article.articleSummary: In Hong Kong, a previously healthy 20-month-old male infant is in critical condition in the pediatric intensive care unit with influenza A complicated by septic shock. Fever began on Aug 7, 2026; after convulsions, he was taken to a private clinic and then transferred to Queen Elizabeth Hospital. Respiratory samples tested positive for influenza A, diagnosed as influenza A with septic shock. He had not received the 2025/26 seasonal flu vaccine and had no travel during the incubation period. One household contact, his grandfather who recently had influenza, has recovered; another household member with mild symptoms tested positive by rapid antigen and has also recovered. Since late June, the Centre for Health Protection reports seven severe pediatric influenza cases, including one death, with influenza A subtypes A(H3) and A(H1) each about 45%, and influenza B about 10%. Activity is expected to remain high in the coming weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 甲型インフルエンザが敗血性ショックを併発、男性乳児がICUで危篤状態 - 20260811
triage.triage_reason: 香港での個別の重症小児インフルエンザ症例報告であり、季節性インフルエンザの通常の重症化パターン内と考えられるが、重症例7件・死亡1件の報告があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（A(H3)、A(H1)、B型）の通常の流行パターン内での重症小児例。香港衛生防護中心（CHP）は6月末以降7件の重症小児例、1件の死亡を報告しており、今後数週間活動が高い状態を維持すると予想している。個別ケースとしては重篤だが、国際的な異常事象とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Da a conocer la OMS que el brote de ébola en el Congo inició meses antes de declararse
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reveals that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo began months before it was declared.
article.articleSummary: 4,200 confirmed Ebola cases in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, including over 1,900 deaths, mark the fastest-growing outbreak on record. The outbreak, centered around Bunia, began in February but was not declared until May 15, according to the World Health Organization. Sequencing indicated an earlier start; early cases were misattributed to malaria and typhoid fever. The responsible virus is Bundibugyo, a rare Ebola strain with no approved vaccines or treatments, and initial testing focused on the more common strain, delaying confirmation. Health workers face strikes, rebel threats, community distrust, and widespread misinformation, while remote roads and water scarcity hinder response and infection control. About 60–70% of new cases occur outside monitored contacts, and the outbreak is spreading at an alarming pace. The region borders South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda; the West Africa outbreak of 2014–2016 is cited for comparison. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesu noted cases doubling in some hotspots.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が宣言の数ヵ月前に始まっていたことを明らかにした
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で史上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ（Bundibugyo株）の流行が確認され、確定4,200例・死亡1,900例超と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国境を接するスーダン・ウガンダ・ルワンダへの国際的拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 希少株Bundibugyoによる流行で承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、当初はマラリアや腸チフスと誤診されていた。医療従事者のストライキ、反政府勢力の脅威、住民の不信感、誤情報の拡散が対応を阻害しており、国境地帯（南スーダン、ウガンダ、ルワンダ）への拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola deja 1.960 muertos y cerca de 4.500 casos confirmados en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola leaves 1,960 dead and about 4,500 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 1,960 deaths and 4,294 laboratory-confirmed cases, the worst outbreak ever recorded in the country, according to the latest evening update covering through last Saturday. Authorities report 722 patients in isolation or hospitalized and 849 recoveries. Active transmission persists in four of five provinces: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo; South Kivu has recorded 73 days with no new confirmed cases. The World Health Organization warned last week about the extreme gravity of the situation. The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola (no approved vaccine exists) was declared on May 15 and has been concentrated in Ituri since, with militia attacks driving displacement and severely hampering containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱による死者1,960人、確認感染者約4,500人に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常性（史上最悪の流行）」の2つが該当し、WHOも極度の重大性を警告しているためフルRRAへ移行すべき事案。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による流行で承認済みワクチンが存在せず、民兵による攻撃が対応を阻害している。史上最悪規模とされ、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の有無については記事内に明示的情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns it is 'chasing' Ebola as death toll surpasses 1,900
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has reached 4,200 confirmed cases and more than 1,900 deaths. Declared May 15, the outbreak began in February, with genetic sequencing showing an earlier start and initial cases misdiagnosed as malaria or typhoid. The Bundibugyo virus responsible has no approved vaccines or treatments, complicating response. WHO notes the worldwide risk is low since Ebola is not airborne; cases outside the region have been promptly contained with no sustained transmission. The incident unfolds under extreme conditions: unpaid health workers striking, rebel threats, misinformation, remote roads, PPE shortages, and a large displaced population lacking reliable water for handwashing. Fatality rate is exceptionally high and rapid, with new cases doubling in some hotspots. Region lies near South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda; care-seeking declines among pregnant women exacerbate risks.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはエボラ死者数が1900人を超え『追いかけている』状態にあると警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部でのブンディブジョ型エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（確定4,200例、死者1,900人超）で、致死率が高く承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、医療体制崩壊や人口移動などの要因により国際的拡大リスクも否定できないため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダは近隣国として言及されているが、これらの国での実際の発生は記事内で確認されておらず、また対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ブンディブジョ型エボラウイルスに対するワクチン・治療薬が未承認であることが対応を著しく複雑化させている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Resultado das ovitrampas orienta força-tarefa contra o Aedes aegypti em Várzea Grande
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Result of ovitraps guides the task force against the Aedes aegypti in Várzea Grande
article.articleSummary: On August 10, 2026, Vector Control teams in Várzea Grande, Mato Grosso, Brazil, continued the second stage of Aedes aegypti control using ovitraps to monitor dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission. In July, 211 ovitraps were installed citywide; after five days eggs were collected and counted in a laboratory to map areas with higher mosquito activity. In Sector 1 (Grande Cristo Rei), including Parque do Lago, Santa Luzia, Santa Clara, Dom Bosco, and Cristo Rei, Block 22 in Parque do Lago showed the highest egg counts and was designated a priority area. The task force delimited and blocked the area to eradicate the vector in the positive block and surrounding properties, performing door-to-door inspections, inspecting yards, removing containers that collect water, and applying larvicide when needed, along with resident guidance. Emphasizes community involvement and preventive actions before rains to curb dengue, Zika, and chikungunya.

triage.headline_ja: 産卵トラップの結果がヴァルゼア・グランデでのネッタイシマカ対策タスクフォースの方針を導く
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マト・グロッソ州の一都市における日常的なベクター(蚊)監視・防除活動の報告であり、実際の患者数急増や異常な流行を示す内容ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的なベクター対策活動（産卵トラップ調査、家屋点検、殺幼虫剤散布など）の実施報告であり、デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の症例増加や流行拡大を示す情報は含まれていない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、内容が定常的な蚊対策であるためDISMISSと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Leishmaniose: entenda os riscos e as medidas de prevenção em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leishmaniasis: Understand the Risks and Preventive Measures in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Visceral leishmaniasis remains a São Paulo urban health challenge, transmitted by bites of infected female sandflies (phlebotomine), not direct dog-to-human contact. In São Paulo state, 2021–2025 data show 336 cases and 37 deaths; through May 2026, 17 cases and 1 death were registered. In humans, symptoms include prolonged fever, hepatomegaly, splenomegaly, anemia, weakness, and weight loss; diagnosis relies on clinical and laboratory evaluation. Dogs can serve as reservoirs and may exhibit skin peeling, wounds around eyes/ears, hair loss, weight loss, overgrown nails, and bleeding; repellents, collars, and vet-prescribed insecticides are used for protection. Prevention prioritizes environmental management (yard cleanliness and removal of leaves) and barrier measures (fine-mesh screens, bed nets). Repellents and limiting outdoor activity at dusk/night are advised. SES-SP conducts ongoing surveillance with municipalities, epidemiological investigations, professional training, and chemical vector-control interventions when indicated. Semana Nacional de Controle reinforces vigilance in São Paulo.

triage.headline_ja: リーシュマニア症：サンパウロにおけるリスクと予防策を理解する
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で流行している既知の内臓リーシュマニア症に関する啓発・予防情報記事であり、症例数の異常な増加や新規性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はサンパウロ州保健当局(SES-SP)による媒介動物対策・予防啓発の一環であり、2021-2025年の累積データ(336例/37死亡)と2026年5月までの17例/1死亡という既存の流行状況を説明する内容。新規アウトブレイクや異常増加を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | понедельник: Украина, Колумбия, Йемен, Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top News of the Day | Monday: Ukraine, Colombia, Yemen, Ebola
article.articleSummary: On 10 August 2026, UN agencies report civilian casualties across Ukraine from recent strikes, with harm to humanitarian operations; a WHO warehouse in Dnipro was destroyed and a municipal evacuation vehicle damaged in Kherson, while aid continues. Colombia experienced a 7.4 magnitude earthquake centered in the central part of the country, with widespread aftershocks and communication outages; dozens of fatalities are reported by media, with the government beginning evacuations and damage assessments and the UN ready to assist. In Yemen, UN Special Envoy Hans Grundberg warns of the highest risk of renewed large-scale conflict since the April 2022 truce and calls for de-escalation and negotiations under UN auspices. The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has claimed over 1,900 lives, with 60–70% dying at home due to insufficient nearby treatment centers; WHO emphasizes expanding access to care.

triage.headline_ja: 今日の主要ニュース｜月曜日：ウクライナ、コロンビア、イエメン、エボラ
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行により死者数が1900人を超え、60-70%が医療施設に到達できず自宅で死亡しているという深刻な状況が報告されており、WPRO基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に複数該当し、WHOによる国際支援の必要性も示されている。
triage.notes: 本記事はウクライナ・コロンビア地震・イエメン情勢・DRCエボラの複合ニュースまとめであり、エボラに関する記述は簡潔だが、死者数の多さと家庭内死亡率の高さから継続中の重大な公衆衛生危機であることが示されている。対象国リストにないウクライナ・イエメン・コロンビアは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns it is 'chasing' Ebola as death toll surpasses 1,900: 'The virus is ahead of us'

New cases double in some hotspots; 60-70% occur outside monitored contacts; borders with South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda complicate care access.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはエボラ感染拡大に「追いつけていない」と警告、死者数1,900人超え：「ウイルスが我々より先を行っている」

article.articleHeadline: 10/08/2026 - Lauro de Freitas vacina quase 8 mil cães e gatos em dois Dias D de combate à raiva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 10/08/2026 - Lauro de Freitas vaccinates nearly 8,000 dogs and cats in two D-Day rabies vaccination campaigns.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination campaign in Lauro de Freitas, Bahia, Brazil reports 2,886 dogs and cats vaccinated on Municipal Day D (Aug 8), bringing the total to 7,883 since the Day D State event on July 25, about 35.58% of the year’s estimated dog and cat population. The effort uses decentralized logistics with fixed vaccination posts and mobile units across the city, with Health Secretary Elba Brito visiting sites. Public Health Surveillance head José Mário Benedictis says the campaign will be intensified to reach underserved areas and will run through August 31; after that, vaccination continues daily via house-to-house visits, fixed points, and by appointment. Rabies is a deadly zoonotic disease affecting animals and humans; owner participation is essential to protect animals and strengthen surveillance and public health in Lauro de Freitas.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年8月10日 - ラウロ・デ・フレイタス市、2日間の狂犬病予防接種デーで犬猫約8,000匹にワクチン接種

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarampión aumentan ocho veces y OPS lanza alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases rise eightfold, and PAHO issues an alert.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in the Americas rose to 47,459 in 2026, with 44 deaths, up eightfold from 5,123 a year earlier, prompting OPS to declare an epidemiological alert as transmission persists. The tally from 16 countries and one territory is the highest since 2004, marking the region's largest outbreak in 22 years. Guatemala leads with 30,371 cases and 26 deaths; Mexico has 12,255 cases and 17 deaths; the United States 2,260; Peru 1,277, together about 95% of regional confirmations. In Paraguay a prior San Pedro outbreak (49 cases, no deaths) stemmed from an imported case, spurring house-to-house vaccination by the Expanded Immunization Program, reaching 429,510 of 476,727 target children (90%). Authorities urge immediate vaccination and completion of the schedule (first dose at 12 months, second at 18 months) and advise travelers to have measles vaccination two weeks before mass events, noting fever, rash, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and swollen lymph nodes.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹症例が8倍に増加、PAHOが警戒宣言を発令
triage.triage_reason: 南北アメリカで麻疹症例が前年の8倍（47,459例、44人死亡）に急増し、22年ぶりの最大規模の流行としてPAHOが警戒宣言を発令。IHR基準複数該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はグアテマラ、メキシコ、米国、ペルー、パラグアイ、スペイン（カナリア諸島）など南北アメリカ・欧州地域の麻疹流行を主題としており、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する国は記事本文に一切言及がない。発生地域にPhilippines/Calabarzonが含まれるがこれはBluedotの位置情報付与の誤りと判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola started in DR Congo earlier and officials are playing catch-up, WHO warns
article.articleSummary: Bundibugy o Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo ( Bundibugyo variant ) began officially on 15 May, with evidence of circulation at least three months earlier. As of 2026-08-10, 4,294 confirmed cases have been reported and 1,960 deaths, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (11,325 deaths). Diagnosis was delayed because infections were misdiagnosed as malaria or typhoid, allowing continued transmission. Ongoing insecurity in the eastern DRC hampers control efforts, with health workers reaching roughly 30% of cases and many patients dying at home. Cultural burial practices and distrust of authorities further drive spread. There are no approved vaccines or widely recognized therapies specifically for the Bundibugyo variant. Recently established dedicated treatment centers across eastern provinces have improved diagnostic speeds and access to care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱はコンゴ民主共和国でより早くから発生していた、当局の対応は後手に回っているとWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が史上2番目の規模（4,294例、死亡1,960人）に達し、診断の遅れ・治安不安・埋葬慣習等により流行が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にアンゴラが含まれているが、記事本文ではDRC東部での発生のみが言及されており、アンゴラへの拡大は確認されていないため除外した。マラリア・腸チフスとの誤診による診断遅延が流行拡大の一因とされている点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Tropical illnesses ON THE RISE in Ireland - what is behind the hike?
article.articleSummary: Ireland sees tropical illnesses rising, with recorded malaria, leprosy, Mpox, giardiasis, West Nile fever, typhoid and dengue fever. After Covid lull, travel rebounds drive cases, including holiday, business, and NGO work in Congo. Mosquitoes are expanding into northern Europe; malaria cases in Europe rose, totaling 71 in 2025, with Ireland's cases acquired abroad rather than locally due to climate and mosquito scarcity. Vectors hitch rides on planes; four baggage handlers at Frankfurt Airport contracted malaria without traveling, illustrating imported transmission risk. West Africa’s hot, humid climate supports longer mosquito lifecycles; East Africa is more seasonal. Zika remains a concern for pregnant travelers; infection post-travel warrants testing due to potential microcephaly. Ireland reports limited local mosquito presence (Swords, Dublin) but no sustained transmission; warming temperatures and increased travel are driving factors.

triage.notes: 記事はアイルランド・ドイツにおける輸入熱帯感染症の傾向を扱った解説記事。コンゴ（DRC）はNGO活動での渡航先として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での発生イベントを報じるものではないため対象国から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura anuncia queda superior a 95% em casos de hepatite A em Juiz de Fora | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall Announces a Decrease of More Than 95% in Hepatitis A Cases in Juiz de Fora | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A in Juiz de Fora, Brazil shows early-to-mid-2026 fluctuations with monthly counts: January 70, February 185, March 428 (peak), April 313, May 184, June 65, and July 20 (as of July). As of August 4, 2026, preliminary Sinan data confirm these figures and report two deaths: a 37-year-old man and a 60-year-old woman. Authorities intensified surveillance, sanitary inspections, health-education campaigns, epidemiological investigations of confirmed cases, and contact tracing alongside outbreak-block vaccination. The July Yellow Campaign included a Day of Testing for viral hepatitis. About 9,000 vaccination doses have been administered in 2026, with 3,248 doses to children under 2 years, a vaccination-coverage of 77.13% in that age group. Preventive measures emphasize proper hand hygiene, treated water, and safe food handling. Data may change as investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: 市役所がジュイス・デ・フォラでのA型肝炎症例が95%以上減少したと発表

triage.notes: 記事は流行の終息・対策の成功を報告する内容であり、2名の死亡例はあるが全体としては症例数が大幅減少し、ワクチン接種率も高く管理下にある。新たなリスク評価の必要性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola a débuté en février, des mois avant d'être déclarée, selon l'OMS | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak began in February, months before it was declared, according to the WHO | L'actualité
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the deadliest and fastest-spreading on record. It began in February, months before it was declared on May 15; genomic sequencing linked early cases to Bundibugyo ebolavirus and revealed initial misdiagnoses as malaria and typhoid. As of the latest government figures, 4,200 confirmed cases and over 1,900 deaths have been reported. The World Health Organization regards global risk as low because Ebola is not airborne, and imported cases have not sustained transmission. The virus has no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. Frontline teams face unpaid health-worker strikes, rebel threats, misinformation, and severe PPE shortages, with health zones difficult to reach near water sources and displacement camps in one of the most remote, vulnerable regions near borders with South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda. The epidemic is expanding beyond traced contacts, with 60–70% of new cases outside contact networks; the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak had over 11,000 deaths among at least 28,000 cases.

article.articleHeadline: Kaj je za porastom denge, kje se širi virus Zahodnega Nila
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is behind the rise in dengue, where is the West Nile virus spreading.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10, Slovenia reports 24 dengue fever cases this year, all imported after travel abroad; last year had 25. The NIJZ links the rise to widespread dengue circulation in tropical/subtropical regions and international travel (2023: 9; 2024: 19). Dengue is asymptomatic in about 75% of infections; when symptomatic, fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle/joint pains, and rash predominate; mild bleeding may occur; about 5% progress to dengue hemorrhagic fever or dengue shock syndrome. No dengue vaccine is available in Slovenia. West Nile virus has not been detected locally this year, but it is spreading in Italy and Greece, with a reported local case in mainland France. Malaria remains most common in sub-Saharan Africa; six Slovenian cases by end of July (nine in 2024), including a January death. Chikungunya: four cases by July; outbreaks in tropical regions, including Brazil, sub-Saharan Africa and Asia; vaccination exists elsewhere but not in Slovenia.

article.articleHeadline: Santa Fe registra un aumento del virus sincicial respiratorio, mientras desciende la influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Fe records an increase in respiratory syncytial virus, while influenza A declines.
article.articleSummary: Santa Fe, Argentina, through week 30 (to Aug 1, 2026) reports 29,145 hospitalised acute respiratory infections, with 1,537 laboratory-confirmed viral infections (5.3%). Influenza A leads with 634 cases, followed by RSV (288), metapneumovirus (230), adenovirus (145), parainfluenza (86), influenza B (80), and SARS-CoV-2 (74). Weeks 28–30 saw 4,641 IRAG inpatients, 401 confirmed for a respiratory virus (8.6%). Influenza A cases rose earlier in the season but declined relative to other viruses; the predominant A(H3N2) subtype has circulated since late 2025, with 22 confirmed cases (subclade J.2.4.1/K) and all favorable outcomes. Six influenza deaths occurred, all in patients with risk factors and none vaccinated. RSV increases since week 24, with 288 confirmed inpatients; most affected are children under 2. Dengue shows no autochthonous transmission; two imported dengue cases (DEN-3 Maldives, DEN-2 Brazil); one probable chikungunya. Enhanced arbovirus surveillance and immediate SFAI reporting urged.

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya in Argentina: 97% of cases in Noroeste Argentino
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya fever in Argentina reports 13,230 suspected cases for the current season, with 3,618 classified as confirmed, probable, or probable via epidemiological link. Travel-associated cases originated in Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, and Cuba; the first locally transmitted cases appeared in Salta, confirming local transmission amid imported cases from Bolivia. The season shows acceleration through EW 16 (peak 446), followed by a sustained decline in confirmed/probable/under-investigation cases. NOA region bears the majority of cases (3,492; 97%), especially Salta, Tucumán, Jujuy; outbreaks also reported in Catamarca, Santiago del Estero, and Buenos Aires, with detections in CABA and Córdoba. Median age 31; highest share in 45–65-year-olds, followed by 25–34 and 35–44; 54% female. Of 2,809 cases with hospitalization data, 232 (8.3%) required admission. Nine severe CHIKV cases were reported; two fatalities in Salta: a 68-year-old Embarcación resident with pneumonia and a 34-year-old Aguaray resident with diabetes and septic shock.

article.articleHeadline: Belém realiza captura e monitora morcegos para identificar circulação do vírus da raiva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belém captures and monitors bats to identify the circulation of the rabies virus.
article.articleSummary: Belém, Pará, Brazil conducts bat capture and monitoring under the Rabies Surveillance Program to detect possible rabies virus circulation among bats and strengthen prevention in animals and humans. Night captures use mist nets at vegetation-rich sites; bats are identified by species, sex, and feeding habits, with samples sent to Instituto Evandro Chagas for laboratory analysis. Tests include Direct Immunofluorescence and RT-qPCR on brain and salivary glands, reflecting viral presence in the nervous system and transmission potential. Although Belém has had no bat-related rabies transmission in over 20 years, VG3 rabies virus circulation among Brazilian bats informs risk assessment and vaccination efforts, including canine and feline vaccination. Bat presence is not inherently dangerous, but abnormal behavior warrants caution. If a bat enters a home, isolate the room or contact Zoonoses for capture; direct contact requires washing wounds with soap and seeking health care. Domestic animals have a fixed vaccination post at UVZ.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak has begun even before it was officially announced: World Health Organization.

The World Health Organization notes the timing based on genomic sequencing. Early cases were misattributed to malaria and typhoid fever. Health workers in eastern Congo are grappling to contain it, marking the most rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak among those recorded. Dr. Mohammed Yacoub Janabi, WHO Africa regional director, emphasized that genomic data and laboratory confirmation established when the outbreak started. The report provides no current case or death counts, and does not detail imported/exported cases. As of 10 August 2026.

article.articleHeadline: JJ: Vigilância em Saúde reforça prevenção contra febre maculosa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: Public Health Surveillance reinforces prevention of spotted fever.
article.articleSummary: Spotted fever (Brazilian spotted fever) risk highlighted by the Itatiba Health Department as a tick-bite–transmitted illness caused by Rickettsia rickettsii. Transmission is chiefly via the star tick; prevention is key, given a 60% fatality rate if untreated. The star tick is active year-round, with heightened attention during the dry season through November, when immature ticks (micuins) are more common and can be mistaken for dust or mud. Micuins are tiny larvae that often inhabit areas with wildlife and livestock, including capybaras, horses, and cattle, and can be found in grass, shrubs, parks, trails, and forests. Symptoms typically appear 2–14 days after exposure and include fever, nausea/vomiting, myalgia, headache, malaise, a red rash, and minor skin bleeding. The report provides prevention guidance and does not present case counts.

article.articleHeadline: Doença mão-pé-boca cresce na volta às aulas: saiba como prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, foot, and mouth disease on the rise as school resumes: learn how to prevent.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) is rising as children return to schools in São Paulo, Brazil. Coxsackievirus and Enterovirus A71 drive transmission; HFMD is highly contagious and spreads via respiratory secretions, feces, saliva, and contaminated objects. In São Paulo, 724 cases were recorded January–June this year; nationwide, 2024–2025 cases rose from 5,201 to 6,242 (about 20% increase). During the July–August seasonal peak, increases climbed 171% in 2024 and 248% in 2025. Symptoms include fever, sore throat, malaise, loss of appetite, and painful oral lesions with possible rashes on hands and feet; dehydration risk if oral intake is poor. Diagnosis is clinical; there is no antiviral treatment; management is supportive with fever and pain control and hydration. Prevention centers on handwashing, cleaning toys and surfaces, not sharing cups and utensils, and temporarily separating ill children from schools; return only when fever-free and clinically better. Dr. Caroline Peev of Sabará Hospital Infantil notes strong post-vacation transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病、新学期の始まりとともに増加：予防法を知る
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロで手足口病（エンテロウイルス71等）が季節性に増加しているが、重症度は軽度で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大の懸念は限定的。社会的関心の程度が不明なため継続観察とする。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health News 11.8: Signs of Dengue Fever in Children | The Unexpected Benefits of Pomegranate Juice
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in children: early cases often start with mild fever and fatigue, leading to misdiagnosis as common illnesses; clinicians advise hospitalization when warning signs appear to prevent shock and severe complications. The health update from Thanh Niên (Vietnam) dated 11 August 2026 covers these topics and discusses the body’s response to consuming pomegranate juice.

article.articleHeadline: سازمان بهداشت جهانی: ما در تعقیب ویروس ابولا هستیم، اما این ویروس از ما جلوتر است
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: We are pursuing the Ebola virus, but this virus is ahead of us.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with the epicenter around Bunia. The DRC Ministry of Health reports 4,294 cases and 1,960 deaths; the World Health Organization notes the outbreak began at least three months before its official declaration. No approved vaccine or specific therapy exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, complicating treatment. Dr. Mohammad Janabi, WHO Africa regional director, stated, 'We are pursuing the virus, but the virus is ahead of us.' Security instability in the region hampers response, with healthcare workers reaching only about 30% of patients, and many die at home. Cultural funeral practices and distrust of authorities further hinder control, though several treatment centers operate in the east and diagnostics have improved. The West Africa 2014–2016 outbreak remains the deadliest, causing 11,325 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:我々はエボラウイルスを追跡しているが、このウイルスは我々より先を行っている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ出血熱(ブンディブジョ株)流行で4,294例・1,960死亡という大規模被害が報告され、承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、治安不安により対応が困難な状況で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリー上ではDRC東部（ブニア周辺）のみが流行地として言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。致死率が約45.6%と非常に高く、承認済みワクチン・治療法の欠如、治安不安による医療アクセス制限（患者の約30%のみ）が深刻な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en el Congo comenzó meses antes de que fuera declarado, según la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo began months before it was declared, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Geneva, Switzerland — The Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the fastest-growing on record, began in February but was not declared until May 15, 2026, according to the World Health Organization. Genetic sequencing shows the outbreak’s start preceded declaration, with early cases misattributed to malaria and typhoid fever. Government figures put confirmed Ebola cases at about 4,200, with more than 1,900 deaths. This outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain that has no approved vaccines or treatments, unlike other Ebola variants; initial tests targeted the more common type, delaying confirmation. The response faces unpaid health worker strikes, rebel threats, traumatized communities, and misinformation. Transmission appears rapid: 60–70% of new cases occur outside monitored contacts. The WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the virus is spreading faster than the response, underscoring an alarming trajectory, surpassing the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、WHOによれば公表より数カ月前に始まっていた
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で記録上最速の拡大を見せるエボラ流行（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス、確定4,200例・死者1,900人超）が発生し、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、監視外での感染拡大が多いなど深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生事態であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngola・Genève・Switzerlandが含まれるが、記事本文はDRC東部での流行を主題としており、WHO本部所在地としてGenevaが言及されているのみ。Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる稀な株で承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、初期に致死率誤判定（マラリア・腸チフスと誤診）があった点が特に異常性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Fakta Baru Rabies Buleleng Bali, Anjing yang Tewaskan Bocah 7 Tahun Ternyata Sudah Gigit 6 Warga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Facts About Rabies in Buleleng, Bali: The Dog That Killed a 7-Year-Old Boy Has Bitten Six Residents.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Buleleng, Bali, Indonesia, linked to a stray dog that killed a 7-year-old boy and had bitten six other residents. In Bubunan Village, Seririt District, six bite victims—Kadek S (65), Ketut S (60), Kadek S (42), Komang SM (41), Gede ED (41), and Made Y (35)—reported bites and received rabies vaccines (VAR) at Puskesmas Seririt. The seventh case, Gede EWP, was not reported initially, as his family considered the wound minor. In June 2026, the Buleleng PKPP vaccinated 430 dogs in Bubunan in response to the bites. The dog was a stray that hid in a warehouse; the boy’s father, who was washing a car there, witnessed the bite. After biting Gede EWP, the dog was killed by the father. No dog sample was collected, and one bite went unvaccinated due to underreporting.

triage.headline_ja: バリ州ブレレン県の狂犬病に関する新事実：7歳男児を死亡させた犬は、住民6人にも咬みついていた
triage.triage_reason: バリでは狂犬病が流行地病として知られており、今回も単発の野良犬による咬傷事例で既に予防接種等の対応が行われているが、検体未採取や過小報告など情報不足の点があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はバリで流行地病として既知。死亡例と複数咬傷者が発生しているが、地域保健当局（Puskesmas Seririt、Buleleng PKPP）が既にワクチン接種等の対応を実施済み。犬の検体未採取や一部咬傷の未報告など情報の欠落があり、続報の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: AI gives us 16 new viruses
article.articleSummary: AI-generated bacteriophages: Stanford University and the Arc Institute used genome-language models trained on millions of natural genomes (King et al.) to design 16 functional bacteriophage genomes with diverse sequences, structures, and fitness profiles. Experimental tests yielded a cocktail of generated phages that rapidly overcame bacteria resistant to natural phages, illustrating a path toward AI-guided whole-genome design of biological function. Bacteriophages are viruses that infect bacteria and are presumed incapable of impacting humans. The work, published by science.org as Generative design of bacteriophages with genome language models, highlights potential applications for antibiotic resistance in hospital settings, while raising ethical questions about unintended consequences of AI-created life. The discussion references broader pandemics (Covid-19) and gain-of-function debates, including transparency concerns about China, underscoring governance needs as AI biology advances.

triage.headline_ja: AIが16種類の新しいウイルスを生み出す
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、AIによるバクテリオファージ設計に関する研究・倫理議論の記事であり、公衆衛生上の実発生イベントに該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はAI生成バクテリオファージの研究成果と、AI生物学の倫理・ガバナンスに関する議論を扱ったものであり、COVID-19や中国は文脈上の参照に過ぎず、実際の感染症発生地点ではない。

article.articleHeadline: São Bernardo Faz Dia D De Vacinação Contra O Sarampo Neste Sábado - ABC Agora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Bernardo Holds D-Day for Measles Vaccination This Saturday - ABC Agora.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination Day D planned in São Bernardo for Saturday, August 15, 2026, as the city intensifies immunization and updates vaccination records for children and adolescents up to 15 years. The measles vaccine is available to everyone aged 6 months to 59 years, especially those without prior doses. All Basic Health Units will operate 8:00–17:00; two plazas will host vaccination posts 9:00–15:00: Praça da Matriz and Praça Giovanni Breda. Additional vaccination posts will be set up during the week at high-traffic locations. The drive follows two locally acquired measles cases linked to the city of São Paulo; both patients recovered and are no longer transmitting. Since the campaign began August 3, about 42,000 doses have been administered. Health Secretary Dr. Jean Gorinchteyn urged residents to vaccinate to prevent transmission and safeguard the community.

triage.headline_ja: サン・ベルナルド、今週土曜日に麻疹ワクチン接種の「Dデー」を実施 - ABC Agora
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ関連で麻疹の地域内感染が2例確認されているが、両者は回復し感染性もなく、既に大規模なワクチン接種対応が進んでいるため深刻度は限定的。ただし麻疹の性質上ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり、継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は地域の予防接種キャンペーンが主題であり、麻疹症例自体は2例で既に回復・感染終息済み。危機的状況ではなく通常の公衆衛生対応と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Rede de vigilância é essencial para evitar propagação de sarampo em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surveillance network is essential to prevent the spread of measles in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in São Paulo expose transmission risk as vaccination coverage remains below the 95% threshold needed to interrupt spread. In the capital, immunization is about 75%; in Greater São Paulo, 23 of 24 confirmed cases this season were concentrated, with importations from Bolivia (February) and Guatemala (March) and a notable cluster in Vila Medeiros (seven cases) and Vila Maria (two cases) near a daycare. Children under one year, not yet eligible for vaccination, constitute the majority of infections and hospitalizations. The infection cycle is about 20 days: 10 days to first symptoms, two days of contagiousness before fever, and 12 days after fever onset; the virus spreads via respiratory droplets. Officials emphasize two pillars—vaccination and surveillance—including isolation and vaccination of contacts; a universal booster/third dose markedly improves protection. São Paulo hosts daily international events, reinforcing importation risk.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロにおける麻疹拡大防止に監視網が不可欠
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹の輸入例・クラスターが確認され、乳児を中心に入院例が発生。ワクチン接種率が集団免疫閾値を下回り、国際イベント多数開催地であることから国際的拡大リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: ボリビア・グアテマラからの輸入例が指摘されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。乳児（未接種年齢）の感染・入院が中心である点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo em São Paulo reforça alerta para vacinação e vigilância
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in São Paulo Reinforces the Call for Vaccination and Surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo highlights vaccination and surveillance gaps as outbreak risk grows. In this season, 24 confirmed measles cases, 23 in Greater São Paulo, with the capital at roughly 75% vaccination coverage—far below the 95% threshold needed to interrupt transmission. Importations include cases from Bolivia (February) and Guatemala (March), with local transmission within unvaccinated groups. A preschool cluster in the north zone led to seven cases in Vila Medeiros and two in Vila Maria; Guarulhos has two cases linked to the same cluster. Children under one year, who are not eligible for vaccination, are among the most affected and hospitalized. Experts stress vaccination and surveillance as the two pillars, plus isolation and vaccination of contacts; testing is available in the network and health teams are trained to recognize symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロでの麻疹発生、ワクチン接種とサーベイランス強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除国であったブラジルで接種率低下（75%、閾値95%未満）による地域内伝播とクラスター発生が確認され、WPRO基準を複数満たすため注視が必要。
triage.notes: 輸入例はボリビア・グアテマラ由来だが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジル国内（サンパウロ・グアルーリョス）での地域伝播が主題。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: epidemia eboli w Demokratycznej Republice Konga trwa od lutego
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been ongoing since February.
article.articleSummary: February start of Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, not May, per WHO; government reports 4,200 cases and 1,900 deaths. Sequencing shows February origin; early cases misclassified as typhoid or malaria. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. The epidemic is progressing faster than West Africa 2014-2016, which had over 11,000 deaths among 28,000 cases. The response faces 'exceptional' conditions: unpaid health workers strikes, rebel threats, conflict trauma, and natural disasters; conspiracy theories and water access challenges. Authorities say 60-70% of new cases have no traceable links, underscoring the need for rapid identification of transmission chains and isolation of contacts. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, secretions, excreta; zoonotic spillover possible.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は2月から続いている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo株エボラが流行し、4,200例・1,900死亡、ワクチン・治療薬なし、西アフリカ流行を上回る速度で拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内の流行のみが主題であり、Angolaでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株であること、60-70%の新規感染で感染経路不明という点は流行制御上の重大なリスクを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Indian expat in Dubai dies after suspected rat fever during vacation in Kerala
article.articleSummary: An Indian expatriate in Dubai died after a suspected leptospirosis (rat fever) infection contracted during a vacation in Kerala, India. The article, published 2026-08-11, references the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s description of the disease's biphasic illness: initial symptoms include fever, chills, headache, muscle aches, vomiting, and diarrhea; some patients improve briefly before relapse. In severe second phase, kidney or liver failure or meningitis can occur. The report frames this as an imported case from Kerala to Dubai, with no details on laboratory confirmation or broader outbreak status, and no additional case counts mentioned. This highlights potential travel-associated risk of rat fever and the importance of recognizing its two-phase illness in travelers returning from endemic regions.

triage.headline_ja: ドバイ在住のインド人、ケララ州での休暇中に感染したとみられるラットフィーバー（レプトスピラ症）で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単発の輸入症例（死亡1例）であり、ケララ州における流行状況や検査確定情報が不明なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はケララ州で毎年発生するエンデミック病であり、本記事は単発の輸入死亡例の報道。ドバイは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ケララ州側での症例数や地域的流行状況の続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk có trường hợp đầu tiên tử vong do sốt xuất huyết Dengue trong năm nay
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak records its first dengue fever death this year.
article.articleSummary: Dak Lak province, Vietnam, records its first dengue fever death this year: 77-year-old T.V.S., a Tan An Ward resident in Buon Ma Thuot city with type 2 diabetes. He was admitted July 30 with speech difficulty and weakness; diagnosed with respiratory failure, aspiration pneumonia, ischemic stroke, and dengue fever. Real-time RT-PCR from the Tay Nguyen Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology confirmed dengue virus type 2. He died August 3 at 04:50 from cardiorespiratory arrest; contributing conditions included pneumonia, stroke, elevated liver enzymes, hypokalemia, and frailty. By August 6, Tan An Ward had 49 dengue cases and 6 clusters; a nearby suspected case was recorded. Breteau index of 77 indicated notable transmission risk. Authorities implemented containment, addressing two outbreaks (Buon Du and Neighborhood Block 12) and conducted indoor spraying around the patient’s home. By August 10, Dak Lak reported over 3,100 dengue cases and 1 death.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラック省、今年初のデング熱による死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの地方（ダクラック省）における季節性デング熱の流行内での1死亡例であり、国際的な異常性や拡大リスクは認められないが、Breteau指数77と高く感染継続の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事は地方（ダクラック省）レベルの状況報告。基礎疾患を持つ高齢患者の死亡例であり、地域当局が防疫対応（消毒・クラスター対応）を実施済み。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、Breteau指数の高さから感染継続に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Chế Nguyễn Quỳnh Châu lan tỏa thông điệp bảo vệ con trước bệnh do não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chế Nguyễn Quỳnh Châu Spreads the Message to Protect Children from Meningococcal Disease
article.articleSummary: Vietnamese model Chế Nguyễn Quỳnh Châu, Miss Grand Vietnam 2022 first runner-up, publishes a photo campaign with her son Renzo to promote proactive protection against meningococcal disease. In Vietnam, Neisseria meningitidis serogroups A, C, Y and W are circulating, with serogroups W and C associated with higher mortality. Meningococcal disease often begins with nonspecific symptoms such as fever, fatigue, or headache, but can progress rapidly to meningitis and septicemia, potentially killing within 24 hours if not treated promptly. Even survivors may face long-term sequelae like limb loss, scarring, hearing loss, cognitive or psychological issues. Parents are urged to consult physicians about full protection. A quadrivalent meningococcal conjugate vaccine, covering serogroups A, C, Y, and W in a single dose, has undergone clinical studies in Vietnam and can provide broad protection. Don't wait; discuss vaccination to build an early shield for children.

triage.headline_ja: チェー・グエン・クイン・チャウ、子どもを髄膜炎菌感染症から守るためのメッセージを発信
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は著名人によるワクチン啓発・広報キャンペーンであり、具体的な発生・アウトブレイク情報を含まないため、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のアウトブレイクではなく、髄膜炎菌感染症予防のためのワクチン接種啓発キャンペーンに関する広報記事。ベトナムでの流行状況の記述は一般的な疫学情報であり、新規発生や異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola de rápida propagación en el Congo empezó meses antes de declararse, afirma OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo began months before it was declared, WHO says.
article.articleSummary: As of August 10, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in the eastern region with teams in Bunia, is the fastest-growing on record. The World Health Organization reports more than 4,200 cases and over 1,900 deaths. The outbreak began in February and was not declared until mid-May, according to sequencing data that linked cases to an Ebola source; early cases were misclassified as malaria and typhoid fever. WHO Africa regional director Mohamed Yakub Janabi said the virus is moving faster than responders. Incident manager Thierno Balde noted that genetic sequencing was conducted under the leadership of Steve Ahuka, head of virology at the National Biomedical Research Institute of Congo (INRB). The report highlights ongoing efforts to catch up with the outbreak in the east.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの急速拡大するエボラ出血熱の発生は、公表される数か月前に始まっていたとWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,200人超の感染、1,900人超の死亡が報告されている大規模エボラ流行であり、WHOも「史上最速の拡大」と表現しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 早期の症例がマラリアや腸チフスと誤診されていたことが流行拡大の一因とされる。WHOは対応が感染拡大速度に追いついていないと警告している。

article.articleHeadline: 被猫狗抓舔别大意 一个动作教你判断感染风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't take being scratched or licked by cats or dogs lightly — one action to assess infection risk.
article.articleSummary: In Zhejiang, China, a park encounter left a woman with high-risk rabies exposure after a stray dog licked a torn toe; she had paronychia with skin break. Rabies is nearly universally fatal once symptoms appear, and about 95% of global human cases are dog-mediated. Transmission occurs through broken skin or mucous membranes; high-risk animals include stray cats, wolves, foxes, skunks, and bats. The case highlights the 2023 Rabies Exposure Prevention and Post-Exposure Prophylaxis Work Specification. Exposure levels: Level 1—no skin injury; Level 2—scratch or minor bleeding from a high-risk animal; Level 3—severe bite/scratch with bleeding or mucosal contact, requiring wound cleansing, vaccination, and possibly passive immunization. Emphasizes prompt care; even seemingly healthy pets can spread rabies. If persistent red marks or tingling indicate possible skin barrier damage, seek evaluation at a rabies exposure clinic.

triage.headline_ja: 猫や犬に引っかかれたり舐められたりしても軽視しないで 感染リスクを見分ける一つの方法
triage.triage_reason: 個別事例に基づく啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団発生を示す内容ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 狂犬病の一般的な予防・対処法に関する啓発記事で、単一の個人事例に基づく報道。集団発生や異常な流行を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: Capivari de Baixo confirma primeiro caso com transmissão local
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Capivari de Baixo confirms the first locally transmitted case.
article.articleSummary: On 10 August 2026, Capivari de Baixo, a municipality in southern Santa Catarina, confirmed the first autochthonous dengue case of 2026. The locally transmitted case indicates ongoing transmission within the community and triggers heightened vigilance for dengue in Capivari de Baixo. The announcement underscores the importance of prevention and vector-control efforts targeting Aedes aegypti to curb spread. Health authorities note that the dengue situation across Santa Catarina remains under close surveillance, reflecting a state-wide public health focus on dengue prevention, detection, and response. The development highlights the ongoing risk of dengue in the region and the need for sustained measures to reduce Aedes aegypti populations and prevent further autochthonous cases.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱:カピバリ・デ・バイショで初の地域内感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部の一市町村における単発の地域内感染デング熱例であり、デング熱は当該地域の風土病的に流行している疾患であるため、異常性・重篤性は低く、フルRRAへ進める根拠は乏しい。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する風土病であり、単一の地域内感染例の報告は通常の公衆衛生監視活動の一部と考えられる。重症度や死亡者数の情報はなく、追加の異常性を示す情報もない。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात में चांदीपुरा वायरस के 225 संदिग्ध मामले, मरने वालों की संख्या बढ़कर 25 हुई
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Gujarat, 225 suspected Chandipur virus cases, death toll rises to 25.
article.articleSummary: Gujarat reports 225 suspected Chandipur virus cases since June 30, with 39 lab-confirmed infections and 25 deaths among confirmed patients as of August 10, 2026. Of the 225 suspects, 212 have been lab-tested; results for 13 samples are pending, so confirmed counts could rise. The outbreak began in Panchmahal district, where early July saw two young children die from Chandipur virus–related illness, prompting intensified monitoring, testing, and sandfly-control measures across affected areas. By July 20, 63 suspected cases were reported with 12 positives; eight samples remained awaiting results. Health Minister Prafull Panseeriya said authorities are scrutinizing travel histories and strengthening vector-control. Chandipur virus is vector-borne, causing acute encephalitis syndrome, especially in children, transmitted mainly by sandflies with higher activity during the monsoon. Officials emphasize rapid lab confirmation and hospital referrals for pediatric cases.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州でチャンディプラウイルスの疑い症例225件、死者数25人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 確定例39件中25人が死亡と致死率が高く、小児を中心に流行が継続しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介の急性脳炎症候群で、主に小児に重症化しやすい。ワクチンや特異的治療法がなく、ベクター対策とラボ確認の強化が続いている。国際的拡大の証拠は現時点で報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി വ്യാപകം: 10 ദിവസത്തിൽ 810 പേർക്ക് രോഗം; രണ്ടു മരണം | സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി വ്യാപകം: 10 ദിവസത്തിൽ 810 പേർക്ക് രോഗം; രണ്ടു മരണം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever widespread in the state: 810 people infected in 10 days; two deaths | Dengue fever widespread in the state: 810 people infected in 10 days; two deaths
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is widespread in the state, with Palakkad reporting 810 confirmed cases in August's first 10 days; two deaths and 2,413 suspected cases. Year-to-date, 8,466 dengue cases and 24 deaths. August counts include 105 cases on Aug 8 and 77 on another day. Dengue transmission is driven by Aedes mosquitoes breeding in rainwater, with vector control prioritized. Besides dengue, outbreaks include Hepatitis A, measles, chickenpox, chikungunya, and amoebic meningitis. Amoebic meningitis: seven August cases with one death; July: 16 cases, five deaths; year-to-date 164 cases, 43 deaths. Hepatitis A: 238 August cases; Measles: 130 August cases; on Monday, 11 cases each of measles and hepatitis A were detected. H1N1 deaths reported in Thrissur, Kannur, Kasaragod; measles deaths in Wayanad, Thiruvananthapuram, Kannur; measles accounts for the state's highest fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: 州内でデング熱が拡大：10日間で810人感染、2人死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻性・異常性の2項目に該当し、デング熱に加えA型肝炎・麻疹・水痘・チクングニア熱・アメーバ性髄膜炎など複数疾患が同時流行し死亡者も多数出ている点で公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ケララ州内でのデング熱急増に加え、アメーバ性髄膜炎（死亡率が非常に高い）、麻疹、A型肝炎、H1N1死亡例など複数の感染症が同時に流行している点で州の公衆衛生システムへの負荷が高い可能性がある。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、州内の被害規模の大きさからフルリスク評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 外卖平台审核缺位、凉菜致病菌超标 中山曝光两起网络餐饮违法案例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Takeout platforms' lax audits; pathogenic bacteria exceeding safety standards in cold dishes; Zhongshan exposes two online catering violations.
article.articleSummary: On August 10, 2026, Zhongshan Market Supervision Administration disclosed two online catering violations highlighting lax platform audits and pathogenic bacteria in cold dishes. In the first case, Wu Gui Mountain Subdistrict regulators found a takeout mini-program operated by Zhongshan City Catering Management Service Co., Ltd. using inconsistent licenses and operator names, with data errors due to a system fault, creating false platform information. Under the Online Food Safety Violations Measures, the company was fined 10,000 yuan after cooperation and rectification. In the Sanjiao Town case, 2026 online sampling detected Salmonella in Cold Cucumber Salad and Cold Tofu Strips. Investigations showed cold foods were prepared outside a dedicated cold-food area, enabling contamination. The regulator confiscated 120.3 yuan of illegal gains and fined 5,000 yuan. Authorities urge platforms to strengthen verification and operators to follow safety norms to prevent cross-contamination.

triage.headline_ja: 出前プラットフォームの審査不備、冷菜から病原菌検出 中山市が2件のオンライン飲食違反事例を公表
triage.triage_reason: 個別の食品衛生取締事例（サルモネラ検出・行政処分）であり、疾病の集団発生や公衆衛生上の危機を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症の集団発生ではなく、食品安全規制違反に関する行政処分の公表であり、パラチフス・チフス菌の実際の患者発生は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠病毒感染、流感等呼吸道传染病处于波动期 萍乡疾控发布健康提示
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 infections, influenza and other respiratory infectious diseases are in a period of fluctuation; Pingxiang CDC issues health tips.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-10, COVID-19, influenza, and other respiratory infections in Pingxiang City are in a seasonal fluctuation phase. Symptoms include fever, cough, fatigue, and sore throat; pneumonia can occur, with higher risk for the elderly and those with chronic diseases. Summer travel and indoor time in air-conditioned spaces may facilitate spread. Pingxiang City CDC advises: ventilate homes regularly; wash hands with soap and running water for at least 20 seconds and carry sanitizer; avoid touching the face; maintain regular sleep, balanced diet, hydration, and moderate activity; wear a mask and avoid sharing personal items if others are ill. Vaccination is the most effective prevention for influenza and COVID-19; elderly, children, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases should get vaccinated. Seek medical care promptly for fever, cough, sore throat, or fatigue, and mask during medical visits.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルス感染症、インフルエンザ等の呼吸器系感染症が変動期に―萍郷市疾病予防センターが健康注意情報を発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症（COVID-19、インフルエンザ）に関する通常の健康注意喚起であり、異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の影響は見られない。
triage.notes: 地方CDCによる季節性感染症に対する一般的な予防啓発記事。特定の異常発生や重症化増加を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Rede de vigilância é essencial para evitar propagação de sarampo em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surveillance network is essential to prevent measles transmission in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo, Brazil, poses an ongoing transmission risk as vaccination coverage remains about 75% in the city, well below the 95% herd-immunity target. Incubation and transmission span roughly 20 days (about 10 days to first symptoms, two days of transmission before fever, and 12 days after fever onset). Immunization reduces transmission when coverage is high; a third dose booster can bring non-protected individuals close to zero. Renato Kfouri emphasizes two pillars—vaccination and surveillance—and the need for homogeneous coverage across neighborhoods to avoid vulnerable pockets. Greater São Paulo accounted for 23 of 24 confirmed cases, including seven in Vila Medeiros and two in Vila Maria, linked to a pediatric school cluster; at least one Guarulhos case is linked to this cluster. Imported cases include one from Bolivia (February) and one from Guatemala (March). Children under one year remain at highest risk.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロにおける麻疹拡大防止に監視網が不可欠
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ市でワクチン接種率が75%と目標(95%)を大幅に下回る中、学校クラスターを含む麻疹症例が継続発生しており、社会的関心・行政関心も高いためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ボリビア・グアテマラからの輸入症例が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ブラジル国内での学校クラスター発生とワクチン接種率の地域差が主な懸念事項。
