article.articleHeadline: 台東出現今年境外移入確診登革熱首例個案 衛生局請民眾加強防蚊措施
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taitung reports the first imported dengue fever case of the year; Health Bureau urges the public to strengthen mosquito prevention measures.
article.articleSummary: First imported dengue fever case in Taitung this year: a male traveler returning from Malaysia and the Maldives developed symptoms during travel and tested positive for dengue antigen at Taoyuan Airport on entry. The Taitung County Health Bureau launched case investigation, health education, and vector-control actions, including a 50-meter perimeter survey around the case’s residence and related sites; residents are urged to practice ‘巡、倒、清、刷’ and strengthen mosquito prevention. Taiwan has 119 dengue cases through Aug 9: 7 local, 112 imported. Ongoing imported activity is seen in Indonesia (25), Vietnam (23), Maldives (15), Malaysia (12), Philippines (11), Cambodia (9), Thailand (6), India (6), Sri Lanka (4), Singapore (1). Prevention guidance includes wearing light-colored long sleeves/pants, using DEET repellents, eliminating standing water, and travelers with symptoms should seek medical care and disclose travel history; clinicians should perform NS1 tests and promptly report to the Dengue Prevention Center. Summer and monsoon increase mosquito activity.

triage.headline_ja: 台東で今年初の輸入デング熱確定例、衛生局が防蚊対策の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国外）における輸入デング熱の日常的なサーベイランス報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（台東・桃園）における輸入デング熱事例の日常的な症例対応報告。インドネシア・ベトナム・タイ・フィリピン・インドなどは台湾の輸入症例の出発国として統計的に言及されているのみで、これらの国での発生・流行が記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Caruaru realizará semana Municipal de Controle e Combate à Leishmaniose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caruaru City Hall will host Municipal Week for Leishmaniasis Control and Combat.
article.articleSummary: Caruaru, Brazil, launches the Municipal Week of Leishmaniasis Control and Combat from August 10–14, 2026. The initiative aims to strengthen prevention, expand early diagnosis, and raise awareness of animal care and community involvement in controlling leishmaniasis, a zoonotic disease transmissible to humans. Throughout the week, Environmental Surveillance teams will conduct free canine testing in various neighborhoods, alongside health education activities, educational talks, and rabies vaccination programs for dogs and cats. The effort, conducted in partnership with the Municipal Health Secretariat, Environmental Surveillance, and the Secretariat of Sustainability and Animal Welfare, emphasizes testing as a key step to identify suspected cases early, enabling appropriate follow-up and reducing disease circulation in the municipality. Owner participation is essential to protect both animals and people.

triage.headline_ja: カルアル市役所、リーシュマニア症制圧・対策週間を開催へ
triage.triage_reason: これは市による予防・啓発活動（検査・ワクチン接種プログラム）の告知であり、新規の異常な感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体による予防週間（検査・啓発・ワクチン接種）の告知であり、感染拡大や異常な発生状況を示す情報はない。定期的な公衆衛生活動として通常業務の範疇。

article.articleHeadline: جنوب السودان في مواجهة الأوبئة والكوارث المناخية.. الأمم المتحدة: 451 حادثة تعرقل العمليات الإنسانية.. توقعات بتأثر 830 ألف شخص بالفيضانات أكثر من ربعهم نازحون.. و1.7 مليون شخص بالجفاف بنهاية 2026 - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Sudan Faces Epidemics and Climate-Related Disasters; United Nations: 451 Incidents Impede Humanitarian Operations; Forecasts of 830,000 People Affected by Floods, More Than a Quarter of Them Displaced; 1.7 Million People Affected by Drought by the End of 2026 - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: South Sudan faces a compounded humanitarian emergency as Ebola risk persists from neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo, with cross-border movement heightening transmission risk though no cases are confirmed domestically. UN OCHA-led preparedness includes early detection, border screening, health worker training, medical supplies, and community awareness. Security constraints continue to hinder aid delivery, with 451 incidents blocking humanitarian operations from January through July; along the Yaï–Morobo corridor, 32 aid-worker abductions since January last year highlight access challenges. Climate shocks compound this, with floods last year affecting more than 1.3 million people and forecasts this year of floods affecting over 830,000, with more than a quarter displaced, while drought could affect about 1.7 million by year-end 2026. Health sector support: over 135,300 travelers screened at entry points this month; 300 frontline workers trained; over 7 tonnes of emergency supplies stockpiled in Yambio near the DRC border.

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダン、疫病と気候災害に直面 ― 国連:人道活動を妨げる451件の事案、洪水で83万人、旱魃で170万人が影響を受ける見通し
triage.triage_reason: 隣国DRCで継続するエボラ出血熱の越境リスクが南スーダンで警戒されており、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響というIHR基準に2つ該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は主に南スーダンにおける人道状況（洪水・旱魃・治安）とエボラ越境リスクへの備えを報じており、南スーダン国内での確定症例はない。エボラの発生源はDRCであるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。南スーダンおよびスーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo in Congo, il ritardo che ha cambiato tutto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo Ebola virus in Congo, the delay that changed everything.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyо ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) in 2026, traced to February ambulatory cases in Mongbwalu with rapid tests focusing on Zaire ebolavirus, missing Bundibugyo and enabling household- and village-level spread. WHO alert issued May 5, outbreak officially declared May 15, and Africa CDC declared a continental emergency May 18. Origin likely in Mongbwalu health zone, with spread to Rwampara and Bunia, ITURI provincial capital and key logistics hub, driven by human mobility and care-seeking. Delays arose from symptom overlap with malaria/typhoid, inadequate diagnostics for this variant, fragile health systems, conflict, and access barriers. Surveillance showed many new cases outside known contact lists, signaling hidden transmission chains. No approved vaccines or specific therapies exist for Bundibugyo; response relies on rapid diagnosis, isolation, contact tracing, PPE, safe burials, and strong community cooperation. Early suspicion and prompt action are critical to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのブンディブギョ型エボラウイルス、すべてを変えた対応の遅れ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスのアウトブレイクが発生し、WHOアラートおよびアフリカCDCによる大陸規模の緊急事態宣言が出されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 疾患タグはMalaria/Typhoidとなっているが、これは診断遅延の原因として症状が類似していたための言及であり、記事の主題はブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスのアウトブレイクである。Rwandaは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では感染拡大先として明示されておらず、隣接地域として言及されているのみのためverified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: 41岁男子吹久未清洗空调肺变白进ICU 军团菌肺炎险夺命
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 41-year-old man admitted to ICU after his lungs turned white from using an air conditioner that hadn’t been cleaned for a long time; Legionella pneumonia nearly claimed his life.
article.articleSummary: Shenzhen, China — A 41-year-old man developed Legionella pneumophila pneumonia after using a home air conditioner that had not been cleaned. On July 13 he presented with cough, dyspnea and multi-organ dysfunction; CT showed left-lung consolidation with severe hypoxemia, and he was admitted to the ICU. He received high-flow oxygen and antibacterial therapy, plus aggressive fluid removal (about 11 kg lost in three days). Despite diuresis, respiratory status worsened; July 16 CT showed progression. Lung lavage identified Legionella pneumophila within ~22 hours. The infection stemmed from the air conditioner's cooling-water system; aerosols likely inspired by the AC. He was managed with noninvasive ventilation and careful positioning; antibiotics tailored to Legionella. By July 22 fever and markers declined and CT improved; he was moved from ICU to nephrology on July 23 and discharged August 1. Advice: clean ACs regularly, ensure ventilation, and preserve water system hygiene to prevent Legionella.

triage.headline_ja: 41歳男性、長期間清掃していないエアコン使用で肺が真っ白になりICUへ搬送 レジオネラ肺炎で一時重篤
triage.triage_reason: 単一患者の個別症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。家庭用エアコンの衛生管理に関する注意喚起的記事。
triage.notes: レジオネラ症は環境由来（人-人感染なし）の単発症例であり、アウトブレイクや集団感染の報告ではない。個人の健康記事として一般的な注意喚起に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: 防范登革热、猴痘等疾病 中疾控发布健康风险提示
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC Issues Health Risk Advisory to Prevent Dengue Fever, Monkeypox, and Other Diseases
article.articleSummary: China CDC issues a health risk advisory for August 2026, urging heightened vigilance for vector-borne diseases and other hazards. Dengue fever, chikungunya fever, and Zika virus disease are highlighted as mosquito-borne threats. Ebola virus disease remains a risk in travel contexts; the public is cautioned to avoid areas with active Ebola outbreaks and to seek prompt medical care if symptomatic. In addition, fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome and Monkeypox are noted, along with food poisoning, heatstroke, and flood-related public health risks during the peak flood season. The advisory emphasizes mosquito bite prevention, early medical consultation, and avoiding travel to Ebola-affected regions. With August being the peak flooding period in China, residents should ensure drinking-water safety, hygiene, and intensified vector control in flood-affected areas to mitigate disease outbreaks.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll rises to 1,887 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reaches 1,887 deaths and 4,120 confirmed cases as of Aug. 6, per the Congolese Ministry of Communication. The eastern outbreak, declared May 15, shows a case fatality rate of 45.8%. No Ebola cases have been detected among more than 200 river boat passengers quarantined at Maluku port, 65 km from Kinshasa, after a traveler aboard the boat died with Ebola-like symptoms. The detection of Bundibugyo virus, a rarer strain, raised concern about spread to Kinshasa, but the National Institute of Biomedical Research tested suspected cases and found all negative for Bundibugyo. Authorities urge Kinshasa residents to remain calm while monitoring contacts and imported cases. Continued vigilance and testing are ongoing. Published date reference: 2026-08-11.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラ死者数1,887人に増加

triage.notes: キンシャサ近郊のマルク港での検疫措置や、ブンディブギョ株検出による首都への拡大懸念が報告されているが、検疫対象者は全員陰性で、現時点でキンシャサへの拡大は確認されていない。継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết: Hạ sốt vẫn có thể chuyển nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever: Even after fever subsides, it can still progress to severe dengue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is surging across Vietnam as the rainy season peaks, with the south bearing the heaviest burden and Hanoi reporting spread to communes. In 2026 to mid-year, Vietnam recorded nearly 42,000 dengue cases and 8 deaths, up 47.1% year-on-year. Ho Chi Minh City reported 1,130 new cases in week 31, pushing cumulative cases to 24,651. Several wards exceed 100,000 residents in incidence (An Nhơn Tây, Chánh Phú Hòa, Minh Thạnh). A 12-year-old boy from Tây Ninh survived dengue shock with severe GI bleeding, liver injury, and respiratory failure. Hanoi logged 1,259 dengue cases across 115 of 126 communes, prompting 46 teams to inspect response, vector control, and risk communication. Experts warn that severe dengue can develop after fever subsides; monitor for abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, lethargy, or breathing difficulty. Vaccination is available for ages 4 and up but does not replace vector control.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：解熱後でも重症化する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで例年見られる季節性デング熱流行が拡大しているが、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは低く、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ベトナムでは雨季に伴う季節性デング熱の増加が例年報告されており、今回の増加（前年比47.1%増）や死亡例（8名）は懸念材料だが、既知の風土病であり異常事象とは言えない。ホーチミン市・ハノイでの症例集中と重症化例が報告されている点は継続的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Estações do Metrô de São Paulo recebem campanha de vacinação contra o sarampo -- Política Distrital agora é PDNews, notícias sobre Política e Saúde do DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo Metro stations host a measles vaccination campaign -- Política Distrital is now PDNews, news about Politics and Health in the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo Municipal Health Department (SMS) launched a measles, mumps, and rubella (SCR) vaccination campaign at five Metro stations to run through August 28, 2026. Vaccines are offered at Corinthians-Itaquera (Line 3-Red) and São Mateus (Line 15-Silver Monorail) on August 17, 19, 21, from 10:00 to 20:00. Vila Prudente (Lines 2-Green and 15-Silver) provides doses August 17–21, 10:00–16:00. Vila Matilde (Line 3-Red) dates August 27–28, 10:00–16:00. Tucuruvi (Line 1-Blue) has the longest window: August 10–14 and August 17–21, 10:00–16:00. The campaign aims to reach commuters and boost vaccination coverage, highlighting SCR vaccine as essential prevention for a highly transmissible disease; Tucuruvi is prioritized due to recent measles activity in São Paulo’s North Zone. No case counts are reported. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak prevention, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの地下鉄駅で麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施 -- Política DistritalはPDNewsに

article.articleHeadline: Seroprevalence of Nipah virus specific antibodies in pigs from regions with reported human cases using recombinant nucleocapsid protein based indirect-ELISA
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus (NiV), a bat-borne zoonosis causing fatal encephalitis in South-East Asia including India, was studied in Kerala pigs using a recombinant nucleocapsid (rN) protein–based indirect-ELISA (NiV-rN-iELISA). The assay showed 84.85% positive and 85.37% negative agreement with the commercial AsurDx™ i-ELISA. Sero-surveillance of 741 pigs across seven Kerala districts during retrospective (2018–2019) and current (2024–2025) periods revealed varying NiV IgG seroprevalence, highest in Ernakulam district at 24.03% and an average of 5.67% across five districts. Hotspot analysis demonstrated significant spatial clustering of seropositivity in specific Kerala taluks, most pronounced in Ernakulam. The NiV-rN-iELISA enables routine serosurveillance at bat–pig–human interfaces to assess spillover risk, refine risk maps, and support strategic control measures.

triage.headline_ja: ヒト感染例が報告された地域の豚におけるニパウイルス特異的抗体の血清疫学調査：組換えヌクレオカプシドタンパク質を用いた間接ELISA法による評価
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、ケララ州の豚における過去（2018-2019年）および直近（2024-2025年）のニパウイルス血清疫学調査データを用いた診断法（ELISA）の性能評価に関する学術研究であり、急性の公衆衛生イベントとしての新規性はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は診断アッセイの検証と血清疫学的サーベイランスに関する研究論文であり、新規のヒトまたは動物における発生事例の報告ではない。ニパウイルスはケララ州で既知の流行地域であり、豚を介したスピルオーバーリスク評価のための基礎研究データを提供するもの。続報として実際の新規ヒト感染例やアウトブレイクが報告された場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 防范登革热、猴痘等疾病 中疾控发布健康风险提示
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC Issues Health Risk Alert on Dengue Fever, Monkeypox, and Other Diseases
article.articleSummary: China CDC issues the August 2026 Health Risk Alert covering dengue fever, chikungunya fever, Zika virus disease, Ebola virus disease, fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), monkeypox, food poisoning, heat stroke, and flood-related public health risks. Dengue, chikungunya, and Zika are transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; common symptoms include fever, fatigue, rash, headaches, myalgia/arthralgia, and conjunctival redness (Zika). Prevention emphasizes avoiding bites (long clothing, repellents such as DEET, Picaridin or IR3535, bed nets, screens) and eliminating standing water with weekly changes and proper storage. Ebola virus disease risk exists in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, Upper Uele, Chopo, South Kivu); travelers should avoid high-risk areas, wildlife, and crowds, and monitor for 21 days after return. SFTS is tick-borne and peaks Apr–Oct; emphasize tickbite prevention. Monkeypox, food poisoning, heat stroke, and flood-related risks are outlined with precautions on water/food safety and hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・サル痘等の予防を呼びかけ 中国疾病予防管理センターが健康リスク注意喚起を発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は中国CDCが毎月発表する定期的な健康リスク注意喚起（季節性感染症・熱中症・食中毒等を含む一般的な予防啓発）であり、新規の発生や異常事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は中国CDCの定期健康注意喚起であり、デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱・エボラ出血熱（DRCでの既知の流行に関する渡航者向け注意）・SFTS・サル痘等を包括的に列挙した季節性リマインダー。新規イベントの発生報告ではないためDISMISS。DRCのエボラ出血熱は既存の継続的流行状況の言及であり、新規性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Pengaruh Perubahan Iklim Terhadap Peta Malaria Afrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Impact of Climate Change on Africa's Malaria Map.
article.articleSummary: Nature’s late-July study shows climate change reshapes Africa’s malaria map. While anomalous warming generally boosts malaria, effects vary by region. Rising temperatures are projected to increase malaria risk in southern Africa and East Africa’s highlands, but may reduce transmission in current hotspots that become too hot for mosquitoes. In major West African countries—Nigeria, Burkina Faso, and Mali—cases could decline by about 5%. In very hot Sahel nations Niger, the Gambia, Guinea-Bissau, and Somalia, malaria could disappear as conditions become inhospitable for vectors. Cooler, historically non-endemic areas such as the southern parts of Africa and East Africa’s highlands face higher risk, with around 5% increases reported in the Ethiopian Highlands, Kenya, Burundi, and similar rises in Angola, Zambia, and northeastern South Africa. By 2100, malaria risk could reach 20% in the Rift Valley and southern coastal Africa. Limiting warming to 2C could avert roughly five cases per 1,000 children in southern Africa; adaptation and sustained health funding remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動がアフリカのマラリア分布地図に与える影響
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は将来の気候変動に基づくマラリアリスクの学術的モデリング研究を紹介するものであり、実際の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
